math-e1-geo1.title: Amagama ezimo kunye neekona
math-e1-geo1.concept: **Itriangile** inamacala ama-3, **i-quadrilateral** inamacala ama-4. **Isangqa** sijikelezile kwaye asinazo iikona.

math-e1-geo2.title: Ukwazi izimo ze-3D
math-e1-geo2.concept: Imo yebhokisi yi-**cuboid**, imo yekholamu ejikelezileyo yi-**cylinder**, kwaye imo yebhola yi-**sphere**.

math-e1-l1.title: Ukubala
math-e1-l1.concept: Ukuba ubala ngokukhomba into nganye, unokwazi ukuba zingaphi. Ukuba ingaphezu kwe-10, kulula ukubala ngokubotshelela ngamacandelo ama-5 okanye ama-10.

math-e1-l2.title: Ukudibanisa nokuthabatha
math-e1-l2.concept: **Ukudibanisa (+)** kukudibanisa iinombolo ezimbini, kwaye **ukuthabatha (-)** kukususa enye incinci kwenkulu.

math-e1-l3.title: Ukuthelekisa ubukhulu beenombolo
math-e1-l3.concept: Phakathi kweenombolo ezimbini, enkulu ibonakaliswa nge-**>**, kwaye encinci nge-**<**. Uphawu luvulekile ngakwinombolo enkulu.

math-e1-l4.title: Izimo ezahlukeneyo
math-e1-l4.concept: **Itriangile** inamacala ama-3, **i-quadrilateral** inamacala ama-4. **Isangqa** sijikelezile kwaye asinazo iikona.

math-e1-l5.title: Ubude kunye newotshi
math-e1-l5.concept: Ubude bulinganiswa nge-**cm**. Isalathisi esifutshane sewotshi sibonisa 'iyure', kwaye eside sibonisa 'imizuzu'.

math-e2-dat1.title: Ukuhlela, kunye nokubonisa ngetheyibhile negrafu
math-e2-dat1.concept: Ukwahlula idatha ngokweenkcukacha, ukuyibala, nokuyibonisa nge-**theyibhile** okanye **igrafu** kukuvumela ukuthelekisa ngokukhawuleza.
math-e2-dat1.example: A abantu aba-3, B aba-5, C aba-2 → abantu abangama-10 bonke

math-e2-geo1.title: Itriangile ne-quadrilateral
math-e2-geo1.concept: **Itriangile** inamacala aqondileyo ama-3 neekona ezi-3, kwaye **i-quadrilateral** inamacala aqondileyo ama-4 neekona ezi-4. Nokuba izimo ziyahluka, inani lamacala neekona liyafana.

math-e2-geo2.title: Ubude kunye nexesha
math-e2-geo2.concept: Ukuba ulungelelanisa ne-0 yesikali sombusi, inani elisekupheleni okunye libonisa ubude. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Phindaphinda inani elalathiswe sisalathisi sewotshi eside nge-5 ukufumana imizuzu.

math-e2-l1.title: Ixabiso lendawo
math-e2-l1.concept: Kwinombolo enamanani amabini, inani elisekhohlo yi-**indawo yamashumi**, elisekunene yi-**indawo yeyunithi**. Amashumi ayi-10 enza i-100.

math-e2-l2.title: Ukudibanisa nokuthabatha iinombolo ezinamanani amabini
math-e2-l2.concept: Bala iyunithi nge-iyunithi, amashumi ngamashumi. Ukuba isixa singaphezulu kwe-10, thwala, kwaye ukuba ungakwazi ukuthabatha, boleka.

math-e2-l3.title: Ukudibana kokuqala nokuphindaphinda
math-e2-l3.concept: Ukudibanisa inombolo efanayo amaxesha amaninzi kungabhalwa kafutshane ngo-**ukuphindaphinda (×)**.

math-e2-l4.title: Ubude kunye nexesha
math-e2-l4.concept: **1m = 100cm**. Ewotshini, isalathisi eside sihamba inombolo enye ngalinye emva kwemizuzu emi-5.

math-e2-l5.title: Ukufumana umgaqo
math-e2-l5.concept: Ukuba ufumana **umgaqo** wokunyuka okanye wokwehla kweenombolo, unokwazi inombolo elandelayo.

math-e3-ari1.title: Ukudibanisa nokuthabatha iinombolo ezinamanani amathathu
math-e3-ari1.concept: Bala ukusuka kwindawo yeyunithi ngokulandelelana. Ukuba ukudibanisa kudlula i-10, **thwala** kwindawo ephezulu, kwaye ukuba ungakwazi ukuthabatha, **boleka** kwindawo ephezulu.

math-e3-geo1.title: Ikona kunye nekona ethe ngqo
math-e3-geo1.concept: Umfanekiso owenziwa ngemigca emibini evela kwiqhosha elinye ubizwa ngokuba yi-**ikona**. Ikona engu-$90^\circ$ yi-**ikona ethe ngqo**, encinci kuyo yi-**ikona ebukhali**, enkulu kuyo yi-**ikona ebanzi**.
math-e3-geo1.example: $30^\circ$ ikona ebukhali · $90^\circ$ ikona ethe ngqo · $120^\circ$ ikona ebanzi

math-e3-geo2.title: Iradiyasi nedayamitha yesangqa
math-e3-geo2.concept: Ubude obusuka kwiziko lesangqa ukuya kwiqhosha elisesangqeni yi-**iradiyasi**, kwaye icandelo elidlula kwiziko yi-**idayamitha**. Idayamitha iphindwe kabini kuneradiyasi.

math-e3-l1.title: Ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula
math-e3-l1.concept: Ukuphindaphinda kukudibanisa inani elifanayo amaxesha amaninzi, kwaye **ukwahlula** kukwahlula ngokulinganayo. Ukuba uyayazi itheyibhile yokuphindaphinda, ukwahlula kuba lula.

math-e3-l2.title: Ukwazi amaqhezu
math-e3-l2.concept: Inxalenye yento epheleleyo eyahlulwe ngokulinganayo ibonisiwe nge-**iqhezu**. Inani elingezantsi yi-**idenominator**, elingaphezulu yi-**inumerator**.

math-e3-l4.title: Isangqa neekona
math-e3-l4.concept: **Ikona ethe ngqo** yi-90°. Kwisangqa, **idayamitha** iphindwe kabini ku-**iradiyasi**.

math-e3-l5.title: Itheyibhile negrafu
math-e3-l5.concept: Ukuba iziphumo zophando zilungiswa kwitheyibhile, kulula ukwazi elona likhulu, elona lincinci nesixa sonke.

math-e4-dat1.title: Ukufunda igrafu yomgca
math-e4-dat1.concept: **Igrafu yomgca** ibonisa amaxabiso atshintsha ngokwexesha ngamanqaku nemigca. Ukuba umgca uyanyuka, kwenyuka; ukuba uyehla, kwehla.

math-e4-geo1.title: Ubukhulu beekona zomfanekiso
math-e4-geo1.concept: Isixa seekona ezintathu zonxantathu si-$180^\circ$, kwaye isixa seekona ezine ze-quadrilateral si-$360^\circ$.

math-e4-geo2.title: Ii-quadrilateral nepoligoni
math-e4-geo2.concept: Ukuba isibini esinye samacala ajongene siyafana, yi-**trapezoid**; ukuba izibini zombini ziyafana, yi-**parallelogram**; ukuba onke amacala amane alingana, yi-**rhombus**. Icandelo elidibanisa amakona angakufutshane yi-**diagonal**.

math-e4-l1.title: Amanani amakhulu
math-e4-l1.concept: Funda uze ubhale amanani amakhulu ngeeyunithi zamawaka alishumi (10000). Idijithi nganye imela ubukhulu be-**place value**.

math-e4-l2.title: Ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula amanani amakhulu
math-e4-l2.concept: Wahlula inani eliphindayo uphindaphinde uze udibanise. Kwisahlulo, qikelela isiphumo uze uqinisekise.

math-e4-l3.title: Ukudibanisa nokukhupha amaqhezu nedesimali
math-e4-l3.concept: Amaqhezu anee-denominator ezifanayo adibaniswa aze akhutshwe **ii-numerator** kuphela. Kwidesimali, lungelelanisa iindawo zedesimali ubale.

math-e4-l4.title: Iidigri nemifanekiso
math-e4-l4.concept: Isixa seekona ezintathu zonxantathu si-**180°**, kwaye isixa seekona ezine ze-quadrilateral si-**360°**.

math-e4-l5.title: Igrafu yebha nomndilili
math-e4-l5.concept: Funda idatha ufumane izixa nemahluko. **Umndilili** yixabiso lezixa zonke elahlulwe ngenani.

math-e5-dat1.title: Ukufumana umndilili
math-e5-dat1.concept: **Umndilili** yixabiso lezixa zedatha zonke elahlulwe ngenani ledatha.

math-e5-dat2.title: Ithuba
math-e5-dat2.concept: **Ithuba** lokuba into yenzeke libonisiwe linani phakathi kwe-0 (akunakwenzeka) kunye ne-1 (kuya kwenzeka ngokuqinisekileyo). Ithuba=(inani leemeko ezifunwayo)÷(inani leemeko zonke).
math-e5-dat2.example: Amabhola e-A ama-3, amabhola e-B ama-2 → ithuba le-A $\frac{3}{5}=0.6$

math-e5-geo1.title: Umjikelezo kunye nendawo
math-e5-geo1.concept: Imbombo enxande: indawo=ubude×ububanzi, unxantathu: isiseko×ubude÷2, i-parallelogram: isiseko×ubude, i-trapezoid: (icala eliphezulu+icala eliphantsi)×ubude÷2, i-rhombus: idayagonali×idayagonali÷2.

math-e5-geo2.title: Ukuthelekana nokulingana
math-e5-geo2.concept: Iimilo ezimbini ezinemo nobungakanani obufanayo ezinokubekwa enye phezu kwenye zibizwa ngokuba **ziyathelekana**. Imilo ethi xa igoqwe ngomgca omnye ihlangane ngokupheleleyo yi-**imilo enomgca wokulingana**, kwaye lo mgca yi-**i-axis yokulingana**.

math-e5-l1.title: Ukudibanisa nokunciphisa iziqendu ezinezihlukanisi ezahlukeneyo
math-e5-l1.concept: Ukuba izihlukanisi zahlukile, qala **wenze isihlukanisi esifanayo**. Kulula ukusebenzisa isiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinci kwizihlukanisi ezibini njengesihlukanisi esifanayo.

math-e5-l2.title: Ukuphindaphinda amanani edesimali
math-e5-l2.concept: Susa iphoyinti ledesimali uze uphindaphinde njengamanani endalo, uze ubeke kwakhona iphoyinti ledesimali ngobungakanani bamanani asemva kwephoyinti ledesimali kwizinto eziphindaphindiweyo.

math-e5-l3.title: Izihlukanisi neziphindaphindi
math-e5-l3.concept: **Isihlukanisi** linani elenza elinye inani lahlulwe ngokuthe ngqo, **isiphindaphindi** liphindaphindo lelo nani ngo-1, 2, 3...

math-e5-l4.title: Indawo nevolumu
math-e5-l4.concept: Imbombo enxande ngu-**ubude × ububanzi**, unxantathu ngu-**isiseko × ubude ÷ 2**, kwaye ivolumu yebhokisi enxande ngu-**ubude × ububanzi × ubude obuphezulu**.

math-e5-l5.title: Umlinganiselo nezinga
math-e5-l5.concept: **Izinga** liyixabiso lobungakanani obuthelekiswayo obwahlulwe ngobungakanani obusisiseko. Ukuphindaphinda izinga ngo-100 kunika **ipesenti (%)**.

math-e6-ari1.title: Ukubala okuxubileyo kwamanani endalo
math-e6-ari1.concept: Ukuba ukudibanisa, ukususa, ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula kuxubene, bala **ngaphakathi kwamabekelo** kuqala, emva koko **ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula**, ekugqibeleni **ukudibanisa nokususa** usuka ekhohlo.

math-e6-ari2.title: Ukuyisa phezulu, ukuyisa phansi, ukuyisa eduze kakhulu
math-e6-ari2.concept: **Ukuyisa phezulu** kunyusa yonke into engezantsi kwendawo oyifunayo, **ukuyisa phansi** kulahla yonke into. **Ukuyisa eduze kakhulu** kunyusa ukuba indawo ngqo engezantsi ngu-5 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye kulahla ukuba ngu-4 okanye ngaphantsi.
math-e6-ari2.example: 3472 kwiyunithi ye-100: ukuyisa phezulu 3500, ukuyisa phansi 3400, ukuyisa eduze kakhulu 3500

math-e6-dat1.title: Igrafu yebhendi nenesangqa
math-e6-dat1.concept: **Igrafu yebhendi** kunye **negrafu yesangqa** ithatha isipheleleyo njengo-100% kwaye ibonisa izinga lecandelo ngalinye. Inani lecandelo=isipheleleyo×izinga.

math-e6-geo1.title: Umjikelezo wesangqa nendawo yesangqa
math-e6-geo1.concept: Umjikelezo wesangqa=idayamitha×i-pi, indawo yesangqa=ingqamdla×ingqamdla×i-pi. I-pi malunga no-$3.14$.

math-e6-geo2.title: Ibhokisi enxande nekhyubhu
math-e6-geo2.concept: Ivolumu=ubude×ububanzi×ubude obuphezulu, indawo yomphezulu=(isiphumo sokudibanisa sendawo zeentlangothi ezintathu)×2. Ibhokisi enxande inemiphezulu emi-6, imiphetho eli-12, kunye namakona ama-8.

math-e6-l1.title: Ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula iziqendu namanani edesimali
math-e6-l1.concept: Ukuphindaphinda iziqendu kuphindaphinda izihlukaniswa kunye nezihlukanisi. Ukwahlula iziqendu kuphindaphinda **ngokuphambeneyo**.

math-e6-l2.title: Ulingano lomlinganiselo nokwabelana ngomlinganiselo
math-e6-l2.concept: Kulingano lomlinganiselo, **isiphumo sokuphindaphinda samanani angaphakathi = isiphumo sokuphindaphinda samanani angaphandle**. Ukwahlula isipheleleyo ngomlinganiselo kukwabelana **ngomlinganiselo**.

math-e6-l3.title: Ipesenti
math-e6-l3.concept: **Ipesenti (%)** lizinga xa ubungakanani obusisiseko bubonwa njengo-100. Ukuphindaphinda idesimali ngo-100 kuyenza ibe yi-%.

math-e6-l4.title: Isangqa neemilo ezinamacala amaninzi
math-e6-l4.concept: Umjikelezo wesangqa ngu-**idayamitha × 3.14**, indawo yesangqa ngu-**ingqamdla × ingqamdla × 3.14**.

math-e6-l5.title: Umndilili nokucwangcisa idatha
math-e6-l5.concept: **Umndilili** ngumdibaniso ÷ inani, **i-median** linani eliphakathi, **imowudi** linani elivela rhoqo.

math-el-ai1.title: Idatha yombhalo nomfanekiso
math-el-ai1.concept: Uxwebhu lubonakaliswa yi-vector yamaxesha amagama avela, kwaye umfanekiso yi-matrix yamaxabiso eepikseli. Xa i-dot product ye-vector inkulu, amaxwebhu afana ngakumbi.

math-el-ai2.title: Ukubikezela nokwenza ngcono
math-el-ai2.concept: Ithambeka lomgca wokuthambeka, umndilili wezikwere zeempazamo (ilahleko), kunye ne-gradient descent $x_{new}=x-\eta f'(x)$ zisetyenziselwa ukuphucula ukubikezela.

math-el-cul1.title: Imathematika kubugcisa nobomi bemihla ngemihla
math-el-cul1.concept: Umlinganiselo wegolide malunga no-1.618, inoti enye ye-octave ephezulu inemvakalelo ephindwe kabini, inani lamathuba amachaphaza amathandathu e-braille ngu-$2^6-1=63$, kwaye iningi linani elidlula isiqingatha sizonke.

math-el-cul2.title: Imathematika kuluntu nakwindalo
math-el-cul2.concept: Sihlalutya imiba yoluntu nendalo ngemathematika sisebenzisa umndilili wedatha kunye nezinga lokwanda. Izinga lokwanda=(ubungakanani obongezelelekileyo)÷(ixabiso lokuqala)×100.
math-el-cul2.example: Ukusuka kwi-40 ukuya kwi-50 → ukwanda ngama-25%

math-el-econ1.title: Inzala, izinga lenkcenkceshelo, irhafu
math-el-econ1.concept: Inzala elula=imali ephambili×izinga lenzala×ixesha, inzala edibeneyo yimali ephambili×(1+izinga lenzala)^ixesha. Izinga lenkcenkceshelo lixabiso leyunithi enye yemali yangaphandle, kwaye irhafu iphindaphinda ixabiso ngomlinganiselo.
math-el-econ1.example: 10000 won, inzala edibeneyo ye-10% ngonyaka iminyaka emi-2 → 12100 won

math-el-econ2.title: Imfuno, unikezelo kunye nokwenza ngcono
math-el-econ2.concept: Ukulingana kuphelele apho amajika emfuno nonikezelo adibana khona. Ubuninzi bengeniso R=pq kunye nokuguquguquka kufunyanwa ngemisebenzi kunye nemveliso.

math-el-job1.title: Ukuguqulwa kweeyunithi nomlinganiselo
math-el-job1.concept: 1 m=100 cm, 1 kg=1000 g, iyure e-1=imizuzu engama-60. Ixabiso elisikiweyo=ixabiso×(1−izinga lesaphulelo), ukuxuba ngomlinganiselo a:b, A yi-$\frac{a}{a+b}$ yesipheleleyo.

math-el-job2.title: Indawo, amathuba, izinga lokwanda
math-el-job2.concept: Sifumana ubungakanani bezinto ezifunekayo ngendawo, inani leziibini ezinokwenzeka ngomthetho wokuphindaphinda, kwaye izinga lokwanda ngo-(ubungakanani obongezelelekileyo)÷(ixabiso lokuqala)×100.
math-el-job2.example: Iihempe ezi-4, iibhulukhwe ezi-3 → iindlela ezili-12

math-el-res1.title: Iindlela zophando
math-el-res1.concept: Uphando lomsebenzi wemathematika lwenziwa ngeendlela ezifana nophando lweencwadi, uphando lweemeko, uvavanyo lwemathematika, kunye nophando lophuhliso.
math-el-res1.example: Ukuphosa idayisi ngokwakho ukufumana umgaqo → uvavanyo lwemathematika

math-el-res2.title: Inkqubo yophando neenqobo zophando
math-el-res2.concept: Uphando lwenziwa ngolu ncwadiso: ukukhetha isihloko → icebo → ukwenza → ukuyibonisa → ukubonisa. Iinqobo zophando kukubonisa imithombo nokungatshintshi iziphumo.
math-el-res2.example: Emva kokukhetha isihloko kuza icebo lophando

math-el-sta1.title: Imiba yeenkcukacha-manani nesampulu
math-el-sta1.concept: I-standard deviation yimpande yesikwere yomndilili wezikwere zeenguqu (i-variance). Isampulu ikhethwa ngokukhetha okungenamgaqo, ukukhetha ngamanqanaba, ukukhetha ngamaqela, ukukhetha ngokucwangcisiweyo, njalo njalo.

math-el-sta2.title: Uqikelelo novavanyo lwengcamango
math-el-sta2.concept: Umda wempazamo wekhefu lokuthembela eli-95% ngu-$1.96\times\frac{σ}{\sqrt{n} }$. Ukuba ixabiso eliphelele le-statistic yovavanyo $z=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu}{σ/\sqrt{n} }$ likhulu kune-1.96, ingcamango engenanto iyaliwa kwinqanaba lokubaluleka eli-5%.

math-h1-fnc1.title: Imisebenzi edibeneyo neguqulweyo
math-h1-fnc1.concept: Kumsebenzi odibeneyo $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$, bala umsebenzi ongaphakathi kuqala. Umsebenzi oguqulweyo ngumsebenzi apho $f(x)=y$, $f^{-1}(y)=x$.

math-h1-geo1.title: Iimilo kwiplani yolungelelwaniso
math-h1-geo1.concept: Umgama phakathi kwamanqaku amabini $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$, indawo ephakathi ngumndilili wolungelelwaniso, kwaye ithambeka li-$\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

math-h1-geo2.title: Ulinganiso lesangqa
math-h1-geo2.concept: Ulinganiso lesangqa elinoziko $(a, b)$ nonxantathu $r$ yi-$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Ibanga phakathi kwenqaku $(x_0,y_0)$ nomgca $ax+by+c=0$ li-$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$.

math-h1-l1.title: Ukwahlula iipolynomial kunye nomgaqo wengqekembe
math-h1-l1.concept: Intsalela yokwahlula $P(x)$ ngo-$x-a$ yi-$P(a)$, kwaye ukuba $P(a)=0$ ngoko $x-a$ yinto eyahlulayo.

math-h1-l2.title: Amanani entsinganiso kunye nokuhlula iilinganiso zequadratic
math-h1-l2.concept: $i^2=-1$, kwaye ukuba i-discriminant $D=b^2-4ac<0$ zinezimali ezingeyonyani. Izimali ezingeyonyani zolinganiso lwequadratic olunee-coefficients ezizizo zivela ngamawele ezi-conjugate.

math-h1-l3.title: Ukungalingani kwequadratic
math-h1-l3.concept: Isisombululo sifundwa ngegrafu yomsebenzi wequadratic nendawo yayo kumgca ongu-$x$. $(x-a)(x-b)<0$ kuphakathi kwezimali ezibini, kwaye $>0$ kungaphandle kwazo.

math-h1-l4.title: Ukucwangciswa kunye nokudibanisa
math-h1-l4.concept: Ukuba i-odolo ibalulekile, yi-permutation $_nP_r$; ukuba ayibalulekanga, yi-combination $_nC_r$. Kwingxelo ethi 'ubuncinci enye', susa isiganeko esiphikisayo kwisiphelo sizonke.

math-h1-l5.title: Ulinganiso lomgca nesangqa
math-h1-l5.concept: Ibanga phakathi kwenqaku nomgca $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$, isangqa $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, kwaye umgca othintelayo uthe nkqo kunxantathu.

math-h1-mat1.title: Intsingiselo yeematriks nemisebenzi
math-h1-mat1.concept: **Imatriks** ngumlungelelaniso wamanani ngohlobo lwescwe. Ukudibanisa, ukuthabatha kunye nokuphindaphinda ngenani lokwenyani kubalwa ngamacandelo asesikweni esinye; ixabiso le-(i, j) lemveliso $AB$ lisisixa semveliso yamacandelo omqolo i ka-$A$ nekholam j ka-$B$ ngokulandelelana.

math-h1-pol1.title: Ukwahlula ngeenkalo kunye nolinganiso lwesithathu nolwesine
math-h1-pol1.concept: Ulinganiso lwedigri yesithathu neyesine lusonjululwa ngokwahlula ngeenkalo (**factorization**) usebenzisa i-synthetic division okanye ukutshintshela, emva koko ufumane amaxabiso apho inkalo nganye ilingana no-0. Jonga ngediscriminant ukuba izinto ezi-quadratic zinezimali zokwenyani.

math-h1-set1.title: Iiseti kunye neengxelo
math-h1-set1.concept: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$, kwaye iseti enamalungu angu-n inee-subset ezingu-$2^n$. Ingxelo ethi 'ukuba p ngoko q' i-contrapositive yayo inobunyani obufanayo nengxelo yokuqala, kodwa i-converse ayisoloko injalo.

math-h2-geo1.title: Unxantathu kunye nemisebenzi ye-trigonometry
math-h2-geo1.concept: Umthetho we-sine $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$, umthetho we-cosine $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$, indawo yonxantathu $\frac12ab\sin C$.

math-h2-geo2.title: Umlinganiselo weeradian kunye ne-sector
math-h2-geo2.concept: $180^\circ=\pi$ iiradian. Kwi-sector enonxantathu $r$ nengile esembindini $\theta$ (iiradian), ubude bearc buyi-$r\theta$, kwaye indawo yi-$\frac12r^2\theta$.

math-h2-l1.title: Ii-exponent kunye nee-logarithm
math-h2-l1.concept: $\log_a b=x \iff a^x=b$. Isixa seelogarithm sisemveliso yamanani, umahluko ungumahluko wamanani. Ukukhula kwe-exponential kubhalwa ngo-$a\cdot r^t$.

math-h2-l2.title: Imisebenzi ye-trigonometry
math-h2-l2.concept: $\pi$ ii-radian $=180^\circ$. Iimpawu ze-$\sin,\ \cos,\ \tan$ ziyahluka kwikota nganye. I-$y=a\sin bx+c$ inexabiso eliphezulu $|a|+c$ nexesha $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$.

math-h2-l4.title: Umda nokuqhubeka komsebenzi
math-h2-l4.concept: Kwisimbo se-$\frac00$, yenza izinto ezibalayo uze wenze lula, kwaye kwi-$x\to\infty$ yahlula ngegama eliphezulu. Ukuba iyaqhubeka, umda wasekhohlo, umda wasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi zonke ziyalingana.

math-h2-l5.title: Imveliso nokusetyenziswa kwayo
math-h2-l5.concept: $(x^n)'=nx^{n-1}$. I-$f'(a)$ lithambeka lomgca ochukumisayo, kwaye ngophawu lwe-$f'$ ungazi ukunyuka, ukwehla namaxabiso aphezulu nawaphantsi. Isantya yimveliso yendawo.

math-h2-seq1.title: Isiphumo sokudibanisa solandelelwano kunye ne-∑
math-h2-seq1.concept: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ ithetha $a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n$. $\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$, $\sum(a_k+b_k)=\sum a_k+\sum b_k$.

math-h3-cal1.title: Imveliso yemisebenzi eyahlukeneyo
math-h3-cal1.concept: Umsebenzi odibeneyo wahlulwa njenge-(imveliso yomsebenzi wangaphandle)×(imveliso yomsebenzi wangaphakathi), kwaye isiphumo sokwahlula njenge-$\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2}$. $(e^x)'=e^x$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$, $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$.

math-h3-cnt1.title: Ukucwangciswa nokudityaniswa kokuphindaphindwayo kunye ne-binomial theorem
math-h3-cnt1.concept: Inani le-**ukucwangciswa kokuphindaphindwayo** okucwangcisa emgceni kuvumela ukuphindaphinda ngamaxabiso apho inani lokhetho liphindaphindwa kangangenani leendawo. Ukucwangciswa ngezinto ezifanayo kwahlula i-factorial yeyonke nge-factorial yezinto ezifanayo, kwaye **ukudityaniswa kokuphindaphindwayo** ngu-$_nH_r={}_{n+r-1}C_r$. Kwi-$(x+1)^n$, i-coefficient ye-$x^k$ ngu-$_nC_k$.

math-h3-geo1.title: Amajika e-conic
math-h3-geo1.concept: Iziko le-parabola $y^2=4px$ ngu-$(p,0)$, kwi-ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$, $c^2=a^2-b^2$, kwaye kwi-hyperbola, $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

math-h3-geo2.title: Ii-vector zeplani
math-h3-geo2.concept: Ubukhulu be-vector $(x,y)$ ngu-$\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, i-dot product ngu-$x_1x_2+y_1y_2$, kwaye ukuba ii-vector ezimbini zithe nkqo enye kwenye, i-dot product ngu-0.

math-h3-l1.title: I-integral engachazwanga nechaziweyo
math-h3-l1.concept: $\int x^n dx=\frac{x^{n+1} }{n+1}+C$, $\int_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)-F(a)$. Ukutshintshiselana imida ephezulu nephantsi kutshintsha uphawu, kwaye isithuba sinokwahlulwa.

math-h3-l2.title: Ukusetyenziswa kwe-integral echaziweyo
math-h3-l2.concept: Indawo ifunyanwa ngokudibanisa i-$|f(x)|$. Icandelo legrafu elingaphantsi kwe-$x$-axis lahlulwe ngokwahlukileyo, kwaye phakathi kwamajika amabini dibanisa (ophezulu)−(ophantsi). I-integral yesantya ngumgama ohambiweyo.

math-h3-l3.title: Uthotho lwejiyometri
math-h3-l3.concept: Ukuba $|r|<1$, $\sum ar^{n-1}=\frac{a}{1-r}$ iyadibana, kwaye ukuba $|r|\ge 1$, iyahlukana. Isetyenziswa kwiidesimali eziphindaphindayo nasekushukumeni okuphindaphindayo.

math-h3-l4.title: Ubunokwenzeka Obuxhomekeke Nokuzimela
math-h3-l4.concept: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. Ukuba zizimele, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, kwaye iimvavanyo ezizimeleyo zi-$_nC_k\,p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$.

math-h3-l5.title: Ukwahlulwa Kwebinomial Nokwahlulwa Okuqhelekileyo
math-h3-l5.concept: Umndilili we-$B(n,p)$ ngu-$np$, i-variance ngu-$np(1-p)$. Ukwahlulwa okuqhelekileyo kuqhelaniswa nge-$Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$, kwaye kulinganayo malunga nomndilili.

math-h3-pro1.title: Umgaqo Wokudibanisa Wobunokwenzeka Nesiganeko Esongezelelayo
math-h3-pro1.concept: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Ubunokwenzeka besiganeko esongezelelayo (complement) ngu-$P(A^c)=1-P(A)$.

math-l1.title: Ukufumana Ixabiso Lentetho
math-l1.concept: Ukufaka inani endaweni yobumba kuthiwa **ukufaka (substitution)**. Isiphumo sokubala emva kokufaka sisiphi **ixabiso lentetho**. Xa ufaka inani elingaphantsi kwe-zero, sebenzisa iibhraketi ukunciphisa iimpazamo.

math-l2.title: Iimpawu Zokulingana
math-l2.concept: Ukulingana kufana **nesikali**. Ukongeza okanye ukuthabatha inani elifanayo macala omabini, ukuphindaphinda okanye ukwahlula (ngenani elingelilo i-0) kugcina isikali silinganisile.

math-l3.title: Ukusombulula Ii-equation Zomgca
math-l3.concept: Thutha amagama aneno $x$ kwelinye icala, amanani kwelinye icala (**ukuthutha / transposition**). Uphawu luyatshintsha xa uthutha. Okokugqibela yahlula ngenani eli phambi kwe-$x$, kwenzeke!

math-l4.title: Ukusombulula Iingxaki Ngee-equation
math-l4.concept: Iingxaki zamagama zisonjululwa ngolu hlobo: **beka into efunwayo njenge-$x$** → guqula izivakalisi zibe yi-equation → sombulula → hlola ukuba impendulo iyahambelana neemeko.
math-l4.example: Phindaphinda inani elithile ngo-$3$ wongeze $2$ kube yi-$14$ → $3x+2=14$ → $x=4$

math-m1-crd1.title: Inqwelomoya Yolungelelwaniso
math-m1-crd1.concept: Indawo yenqaku ibonakaliswa nge-(x-coordinate, y-coordinate). Ngokwemiqondiso, kumiselwa i-quadrant 1 ukuya kwe-4, kwaye ukubonakalisa ngokubhekele i-x-axis kutshintsha uphawu lwe-y-coordinate.

math-m1-fac1.title: Ukwahlulwa Kwezinto Eziyinhloko, i-GCD Ne-LCM
math-m1-fac1.concept: Ukubonisa inani lendalo njengemveliso yamanani aphambili kuthiwa **ukwahlulwa kwezinto eziyinhloko**. Elona likhulu kwabaqeqeshi abafanayo yi-**GCD**, elona lincinci lamaphindaphindo afanayo yi-**LCM**.

math-m1-geo1.title: Iimpawu Zee-engile Nee-polygon
math-m1-geo1.concept: Ii-engile ezichasene ngencopho zilinganayo, kwimigca ehambelanayo ii-engile ezihambelanayo nezibhekene zilinganayo. Isibalo se-engile zangaphakathi ze-$n$-gon ngu-$180^\circ\times(n-2)$.

math-m1-geo2.title: Isecta Nokulinganiswa Kwezinto Ezinemilinganiselo Emithathu
math-m1-geo2.concept: Ubude bearc $=2\pi r\times\frac{a}{360}$, indawo yesecta $=\pi r^2\times\frac{a}{360}$, umthamo wesphere $=\frac43\pi r^3$, umthamo we-cone $=\frac13\pi r^2h$.

math-m1-neg1.title: Ukubala Ngeenombolo Ezipheleleyo Nee-rational
math-m1-neg1.concept: Ukudibanisa amanani amabini anophawu olufanayo, dibanisa amaxabiso aphelele; xa ephawu lahlukileyo, thabatha umahluko wamaxabiso aphelele uze ufake uphawu lwelona likhulu. Ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula: uphawu olufanayo luyi-+, olwahlukileyo luyi-−.

math-m1-prp1.title: Ukulingana Ngokuthe Ngqo Nokuchaseneyo
math-m1-prp1.concept: **Ukulingana ngokuthe ngqo (direct proportion)** kuyi-y=ax, **ukulingana okuchasene (inverse proportion)** kuyi-$y=\frac{a}{x}$. Kwidirect proportion, y÷x iyahlala ifana, kwi-inverse x×y iyahlala ifana.
math-m1-prp1.example: Direct proportion apho y=6 xa x=2: y=3x

math-m1-sta1.title: Amaxabiso omndilili kunye nenkqubo yobudlelwane
math-m1-sta1.concept: **I-median** liyixabiso eliphakathi xa kulandelelaniswe ngobukhulu, **i-mode** liyixabiso elibonakale amaxesha amaninzi. **Inkqubo yobudlelwane**=(inkqubo)÷(inkqubo iyonke).

math-m2-geo1.title: Iimpawu zetriangile nequadrilateral
math-m2-geo1.concept: Iikona ezimbini zesiseko setriangile ye-isosceles ziyalingana. Kwi-parallelogram, isixa seekona ezimbini ezikufutshane yi-$180^\circ$, kwaye icandelo elidibanisa iindawo eziphakathi zamacala amabini etriangile lilingana ne-$\frac12$ yecala elisele.

math-m2-geo2.title: Ukufana kunye nethiyori kaPythagoras
math-m2-geo2.concept: Kwiziqwenga ezifanayo, umlinganiselo wamacala ahambelanayo uyafana kwaye umlinganiselo weendawo sisikwere somlinganiselo wokufana. Kwitriangile ene-right angle, $a^2+b^2=c^2$.

math-m2-l1.title: Imithetho ye-exponent kunye ne-polynomial
math-m2-l1.concept: Xa isiseko sifanayo kwimveliso, yongeza ii-exponent, kwaye kwamandla amandla phindaphinda ii-exponent. Kwi-polynomial, qokelela amagama anoonobumba abafanayo ubale.

math-m2-l2.title: Iisistim zezibalo ezilinganayo
math-m2-l2.concept: Susa unobumba omnye kwizibalo ezimbini ukufumana isisombululo. Khetha indlela yokongeza nokuthabatha okanye yokufaka ngokuhambelana nemeko.

math-m2-l3.title: Ukungalingani kwe-linear
math-m2-l3.concept: Sombulula njengeempawu zokulingana, kodwa ukuphindaphinda okanye ukwahlula ngenombolo engalunganga kutshintsha icala lophawu lokungalingani.

math-m2-l4.title: Imisebenzi ye-linear kunye neegrafu
math-m2-l4.concept: Kwi-$y=ax+b$, i-$a$ yi-slope kwaye i-$b$ yi-$y$-intercept. Imigca ehambelanayo ine-slope efanayo.

math-m2-l5.title: Inani leendlela kunye nethuba
math-m2-l5.concept: Ithuba lilingana ne-(inani leendlela ezenzekayo)÷(inani leendlela zonke). Izehlo ezizimeleyo ezenzeka ngaxeshanye ziyaphindaphindwa, kwaye 'ubuncinane' kusetyenziswa isehlo esongezelelweyo.

math-m2-lfn1.title: Imisebenzi ye-linear kunye nezibalo ze-linear
math-m2-lfn1.concept: Kumsebenzi we-linear y=ax+b, i-a yi-slope kwaye i-b yi-y-intercept. Indawo apho iigrafu ezimbini zidibana khona yisisombululo sezibalo ezimbini ezidityanisiweyo.

math-m2-rec1.title: Ii-decimal ezijikelezayo
math-m2-rec1.concept: I-decimal apho inani elifanayo liqhubeka lijikeleza emva kweendawo zedesimali ibizwa ngokuba yi-**decimal ejikelezayo** kwaye inxalenye ephindaphindayo ibizwa ngokuba yi-**isiqendu esijikelezayo**. Ukuba isahlukanisi seqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa sikwi-2 okanye ku-5 kuphela, yi-decimal elinciphileyo.

math-m3-geo1.title: Imilinganiselo ye-trigonometry
math-m3-geo1.concept: Kwitriangile ene-right angle, $\sin A$ yi-(ukuphakama)÷(i-hypotenuse), $\cos A$ yi-(isiseko)÷(i-hypotenuse), kwaye $\tan A$ yi-(ukuphakama)÷(isiseko).

math-m3-geo2.title: Iimpawu zesangqa
math-m3-geo2.concept: Ikona ye-inscribed kwi-arc enye ilingana ne-$\frac12$ yekona ephakathi. I-tangent ime ngqo kwirediyasi, kwaye kwi-quadrilateral ebhalwe kwisangqa, isixa seekona ezichasayo yi-$180^\circ$.

math-m3-l1.title: Iingcambu zesikwere kunye ne-real numbers
math-m3-l1.concept: $\sqrt{a}$ yinombolo engalunganga engekho ngaphantsi kwe-0 ekwisikwere ngu-$a$. Susa izikwere ezigqibeleleyo ngaphakathi kwesiqhelo, uze ubeke i-rationalize kwisiqhelo se-denominator.

math-m3-l2.title: Iifomula zokuphindaphinda kunye ne-factorization
math-m3-l2.concept: $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$, $(a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2$. I-factorization kukusebenzisa iifomula zokuphindaphinda ngokubuyela umva.

math-m3-l3.title: Izibalo ze-quadratic
math-m3-l3.concept: Sombulula ngokwenza ifom $AB=0$ nge-factorization. Inani lezingcambu lingaziwa nge-discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$, kwaye ungasebenzisa nobudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu neekoefishenti.

math-m3-l4.title: Imisebenzi ye-quadratic kunye neegrafu
math-m3-l4.concept: I-vertex ye-$y=a(x-p)^2+q$ yi-$(p,\ q)$, kwaye uphawu lwe-$a$ lumisela icala lokugoba. Ungafumana i-vertex ngokutshintshela kwi-perfect square.

math-m3-l5.title: Amaratio e-trigonometry
math-m3-l5.concept: Kwi-triangle ene-engile ye-90°, $\sin A=\frac{\text{ecaleni ngokuchaseneyo} }{\text{i-hayipotenyusi} }$, $\cos A=\frac{\text{ecaleni elikufutshane} }{\text{i-hayipotenyusi} }$, $\tan A=\frac{\text{ecaleni ngokuchaseneyo} }{\text{ecaleni elikufutshane} }$.

math-m3-sta1.title: I-variance kunye ne-standard deviation
math-m3-sta1.concept: **Ukuphambuka**=(ixabiso)−(umndilili). **I-variance** ngumndilili wezikwere zokuphambuka, kwaye **i-standard deviation** yingcambu yesikwere ethe tye ye-variance. Ixabiso lisenkulu, idatha isasazeke kude nomndilili.

alg_arithFirstExceeds.prompt: Kulandelelwano lwemathematika elinegama lokuqala ${a}$ nomahluko oqhelekileyo ${d}$, isiphumo sokudibanisa sokusuka kwigama lokuqala ukuya kwigama le-$n$ sibizwa ngokuba yi-$S_n$. Xa $S_n>{N}$, lithini ixabiso elincinci lenani lendalo $n$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Bhala $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$ njengentetho yesikwere ye-$n$.
Sombulula ukungalingani kwesikwere okanye faka i-$n=1,2,3,\dots$ ngokulandelelana ukufumana apho kuqala ukudlula.
alg_arithFirstExceeds.explanation: $S_n=\frac{n(2\times{ab}+(n-1)\times{d})}{2}$, kwaye xa $n=1,2,\dots,{m1}$, i-$S_n$ yonke ayidluli ku-${N}$ (ixabiso eliphezulu ${s1}$), kwaye $S_{{ans}}={s2}>{N}$, ngoko i-$n$ efunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

alg_arithGeoMix.prompt: Amanani amathathu $x$, $y$, $z$ enza uluhlu lwe-arithmetic ngalolu landelelwano olunomahluko oqhelekileyo olungileyo kwaye $x+y+z={S}$. Ngoko amanani amathathu $x$, $y$, $z+{k}$ enza uluhlu lwe-geometric ngalolu landelelwano. Umahluko oqhelekileyo yintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba umahluko oqhelekileyo ngu-$d$, $x=y-d$, $z=y+d$ kwaye $3y=S$.
Faka kwimeko ye-geometric sequence $y^{2}=x(z+k)$ wenze i-quadratic equation ye-$d$.
alg_arithGeoMix.explanation: $y=\frac{{S}}{3}={y}$ kwaye $x={y}-d$, $z={y}+d$, ngoko ${y}^{2}=({y}-d)({y}+d+{k})$, oko kukuthi $d^{2}+{k}d-{yk}=0$. Kuba umahluko oqhelekileyo ulungile, $d={ans}$.

alg_arithSumMax.prompt: Kwi-arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, xa $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, lingakanani elona xabiso likhulu lesixa $S_n$ selungu lokuqala ukuya kwelesi-$n$? ($n$ linani lendalo) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Jonga uphawu lomahluko oqhelekileyo; isixa siyanda kuphela ngelixa amalungu elungile.
Emva kokufumana ilungu lokuqala nomahluko oqhelekileyo, fumana isixa ukuya ngqo ngaphambi kwelungu lokuqala elingaphantsi okanye elilingana no-$0$.
alg_arithSumMax.explanation: Ilungu lokuqala li-${a1}$, umahluko oqhelekileyo ngu-${d}$, ngoko $a_n>0$ xa $n\le{nm}$ kwaye $a_{{nm1}}\le0$. Ngoko ixabiso eliphezulu li-$S_{{nm}}=\frac{{nm}(2\times{a1}+({nm}-1)\times({d}))}{2}={ans}$.

alg_arithTwoTerms.prompt: Kwi-arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, xa $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{{r}}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana umahluko oqhelekileyo $d$ nge-$a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$.
$a_r=a_p+(r-p)d$.

alg_arithTwoTermsQ.prompt: Kwi-arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, xa $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{{r}}$? (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngeqhezu njenge-3/4)
hints: Fumana umahluko oqhelekileyo $d$ nge-$a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$.
$a_r=a_p+(r-p)d$.

alg_circumradius.prompt: Kunxantathu ABC, $\overline{B C}={side}$ kwaye xa ${cond}$, ubude beradiyasi ye-circumcircle kanxantathu ABC bungakanani? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa umthetho we-sine $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$ ($a=\overline{B C}$).
Ukuba inikwe ixabiso le-cosine, sebenzisa into yokuba $\sin A>0$ ukufumana u-$\sin A$ kuqala.

alg_collatz.prompt: Xa ulandelelwano $\{a_n\}$ luchazwa nge-$a_1={s}$, kwaye ukuba $a_n$ linani elilinganayo, $a_{n+1}=\frac{a_{n}}{2}$, kwaye ukuba $a_n$ linani elingalinganiyo, $a_{n+1}={odd}$, lelona nani lincinci lendalo $n$ elenza $a_n=1$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana ngokulandelelana usuka ku-$a_1$, usebenzisa i-equation ehambelana nokuba lilinganayo okanye alilinganiyo.
Bala inani lelungu apho u-$1$ avela okokuqala.
alg_collatz.explanation: Ukufumana amalungu ngokulandelelana kunika ${work}$, ngoko u-$1$ uvela okokuqala kwilungu lesi-${ans}$.

alg_cosLawSide.prompt: Kunxantathu ABC, $\overline{B C}={a}$, $\overline{C A}={b}$ kwaye xa ${cond}$, ubude be-$\overline{A B}$ bungakanani? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa umthetho we-cosine $c^{2}=a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab\cos C$.
$\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos120^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$, kwaye ubude bulungile.

alg_coterminal.prompt: Phakathi kweekona ezihambelana ne-terminal side nekona enobukhulu ${theta}$, yeyiphi ikona ephezulu okanye elingana no-$0^\circ$ nangaphantsi kwe-$360^\circ$ ngeedigri? (Bhala inani leedigri kuphela)
hints: Iikona ezinomkhono ofanayo wokugqibela ziyahluka nge-$360^\circ\times n$ (okanye $2n\pi$).
Ukuba inikwe ngee-radian, qala uyiguqulele kwiidigri ($\pi=180^\circ$).

alg_digitsPow.prompt: Xa ${given}$, fumana inani lamadijithi e-${N}$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba inani eliphelele elilungileyo $M$ linamadijithi angu-$k$, $k-1\le\log M<k$.
Bala i-common logarithm ye-${N}$ usebenzisa amaxabiso anikiweyo.
alg_digitsPow.explanation: $\log({N})={lg}$ kwaye ngenxa yokuba inxalenye epheleleyo yi-${ip}$, linani elinamadijithi angu-${ans}$.

alg_expEquation.prompt: Sisixa sini sazo zonke izimvo zokwenyani ze-equation ${eq}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuthatha amagama anee-exponent ezifanayo njenge-$t$ kwenza i-quadratic equation enombolo $t>0$.
Emva kokufumana ixabiso le-$t$, buyisela ukuya kumaxabiso e-$x$ ngamnye.
alg_expEquation.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba ${work}$, isixa sezimvo zokwenyani si-${ans}$.

alg_expFuncParams.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)=a\cdot b^{x}$ ($a\ne0$, $b>0$, $b\ne1$), xa $f({p})={u}$, $f({q})={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$f({r})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane u-$b$ ngo-$\frac{f(q)}{f(p)}=b^{q-p}$.
Kuba $b>0$, u-$b$ umiselwa ngokungqongqo, uze ufumane u-$a$.

alg_expFuncParamsQ.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)=a\cdot b^{x}$ ($a\ne0$, $b>0$, $b\ne1$), xa $f({p})={u}$, $f({q})={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$f({r})$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane u-$b$ ngo-$\frac{f(q)}{f(p)}=b^{q-p}$.
Kuba $b>0$, u-$b$ umiselwa ngokungqongqo, uze ufumane u-$a$.

alg_expInequality.prompt: Phakathi kwesisombululo senxaki ${ineq}$, zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Yenza ii-base zifane uze uthelekise ii-exponent. Ukuba i-base inkulu kune-$1$, isalathiso senxaki asitshintshi.
Sombulula i-quadratic inequality ye-exponent uze ubale izisombululo ezipheleleyo.
alg_expInequality.explanation: Ngokubonisa konke njengamandla e-base ${b}$, inxaki ye-exponent yi-${work}$, kwaye izimvo ezimbini zale quadratic zi-${rts}$, ngoko iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ ezifezekisa oku zi-${xs}$ kwaye zizonke zi-${ans}$.

alg_expMaxMin.prompt: Xa uluhlu lwe-$x$ lu-${s}\le x\le {t}$, lelona xabiso likhulu lomsebenzi ${f}$ liyintoni? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane ixabiso eliphezulu nelona lincinci le-exponent $g(x)$ (iqhosha eliphezulu lomsebenzi we-quadratic neziphelo zombini).
Ukuba i-base inkulu kune-$1$, okukhulu u-$g$ kokukhona umsebenzi we-exponential; ukuba incinci kune-$1$, okuncinci u-$g$ kokukhona umsebenzi.

alg_expShiftA.prompt: Xa inqaku elisegrafini yomsebenzi ${f}$ li-$({p}, {q})$, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo elungileyo $a$ ($a\ne1$)? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Faka ulungelelwaniso lweqhosha kwi-equation, kwaye kusala amandla ka-$a$ aye-1.
Kuba $a>0$ nokuba i-exponent ayingu-$0$, u-$a$ umiselwa ngokungqongqo.

alg_expSum.prompt: Kwinombolo yokwenyani $x$, xa ${given}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${ask}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Thatha $t=$ (ilungu lokuqala lentetho enikiweyo), ngoko ilungu lesibini li-$\frac{1}{t}$.
Sika okanye uhlanganise intetho enikiweyo kathathu ukuyidibanisa nentetho efunwayo.
alg_expSum.explanation: Ukuthatha u-$t$ njengelungu lokuqala lentetho enikiweyo nokusebenzisa iifomula zokuphindaphinda, ${work}$.

alg_geoSumRatio.prompt: Masibe isixa selungu lokuqala ukuya kwelesi-$n$ le-geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ siyi-$S_n$. Xa $S_{{n1}}={u}$, $S_{{n2}}={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$S_{{n3}}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Njenge-$S_{2m}=S_m+r^{m}S_m$, isixa senxalenye yasemva silingana nesixa senxalenye yangaphambili esiphindaphindwe nge-$r^{m}$.
Ukuba ufumana ixabiso le-$r^{{n1}}$ kuqala, awufuni u-$r$ ngokwakhe.

alg_geoTwoTerms.prompt: Kwi-geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ enomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo olungileyo, xa $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{{r}}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: (Ilungu langasemva)÷(ilungu langaphambili) yi-$r$ iphindaphindwe ngamaxesha ahambelana nomahluko wamanani.
Ngemeko yokuba umlinganiselo uyinombolo elungileyo, u-$r$ uyamiselwa.

alg_geoTwoTermsQ.prompt: Kwi-geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ enomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo olungileyo, xa $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{{r}}$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: (Ilungu langasemva)÷(ilungu langaphambili) yi-$r$ iphindaphindwe ngamaxesha ahambelana nomahluko wamanani.
Ngemeko yokuba umlinganiselo uyinombolo elungileyo, u-$r$ uyamiselwa.

alg_growthYears.prompt: Kugcinwa imali ngenzala edityanisiweyo yonyaka ye-${rate}\%$, apho inzala yongezwa kwimali esekwe unyaka ngamnye. Fumana ngenani eliphelele ukuba emva kweminyaka emingaphi isixa esipheleleyo siba okokuqala amaxesha angu-${k}$ okanye ngaphezulu emali esekwe. Qaphela: amaxabiso e-common logarithm yi-${given}$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Isixa esipheleleyo emva kweminyaka engu-$n$ singamaxesha ayi-$(1+\frac{r}{100})^{n}$ emali esekwe.
Ukuthatha i-common logarithm macala omabini kunika u-$n\log(1+\frac{r}{100})\ge\log k$.
alg_growthYears.explanation: Ukuthatha i-common logarithm macala omabini e-$({one})^{n}\ge {k}$ kunika $n\ge\\frac{{lk}}{{l1}}={q}$, ngoko elona nani lendalo lincinci $n$ li-${ans}$.

alg_inverseGraph.prompt: Xa inqaku elisegrafini yomsebenzi ochasayo womsebenzi ${f}$ li-$({p}, {q})$, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo elungileyo $a$ ($a\ne1$)? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi ochasayo idlula kwiqhosha $(p, q)$, igrafu yomsebenzi wokuqala idlula kwiqhosha $(q, p)$.
Faka eli qhosha kumsebenzi wokuqala ukufumana intetho ye-$a$.
alg_inverseGraph.explanation: Kuba inqaku elisegrafini yomsebenzi ochasayo li-$({p},{q})$, inqaku elisegrafini yomsebenzi wokuqala li-$({q},{p})$. ${work}$.

alg_inversePoints.prompt: Amanqaku amabini asegrafini yomsebenzi ochasayo womsebenzi $f(x)=a^{x}+b$ ($a>1$, $b$ yinombolo epheleleyo) ngu-$({p1}, {q1})$, $({p2}, {q2})$. Lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi ochasayo idlula kwiqhosha $(p, q)$, igrafu ye-$f$ idlula kwiqhosha $(q, p)$.
Faka amanqaku amabini kwi-$f$ wenze ii-equation ezimbini, uze uzisuse omnye komnye ukususa u-$b$ ukuze ube yi-equation ye-$a$. Khetha isisombululo apho $a>1$.
alg_inversePoints.explanation: Amanqaku amabini asegrafini ye-$f$ ngu-$({q1},{p1})$, $({q2},{p2})$. Ngenxa yokuba ${work}$, $a+b={ans}$.

hints: Ngokusebenzisa ifomula yokutshintsha ibase $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$, ii-logarithm ezikufutshane ziyancitshiswa.
Nciphisa imveliso yonke ibe yi-logarithm enye, uze uchaze i-argument ngesimo samandla.

alg_logChainQ.prompt: Fumana ixabiso elilandelayo. ${expr}$ (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ngokusebenzisa ifomula yokutshintsha ibase $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$, ii-logarithm ezikufutshane ziyancitshiswa.
Nciphisa imveliso yonke ibe yi-logarithm enye, uze uchaze i-argument ngesimo samandla.

alg_logDomain.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ ezikwi-domain yomsebenzi ${f}$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ingxoxo ye-logarithm kufuneka ibe lilungileyo, kwaye into engaphakathi kwesiqhelo ayingaphantsi kwe-$0$.
Hlalutya ukungalingani ukufumana uluhlu lwe-$x$, uze ubale iinombolo ezipheleleyo ngaphakathi kwalo.

alg_logEquation.prompt: Linantoni ixabiso le-$x$ yesisombululo sokwenyani sesibalo ${eq}$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Qala ujonge imeko yengxoxo ${dom}$.
Hlanganisa ii-logarithm zibe yi-logarithm enye uze usete isibalo se-quadratic ngengxoxo.
alg_logEquation.explanation: Kwimeko yengxoxo, ${dom}$. ${work}$, kwaye phakathi kwazo eyanelisa imeko yengxoxo yi-$x={ans}$.

alg_logExpress.prompt: Xa $\log_{2}3=a$, $\log_{2}5=b$, ixabiso le-$\log_{2}{N}$ libhalwa ngefom $xa+yb+z$ ($x, y, z$ ziinombolo zi-rational). Ixabiso le-$x+y+z$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Iinombolo ezili-prime ze-${N}$ ngu-$2, 3, 5$ kuphela. Zibhale njengamandla.
Sebenzisa $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$, $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, kwaye usebenzise ukuba $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logExpressQ.prompt: Xa $\log_{2}3=a$, $\log_{2}5=b$, ixabiso le-$\log_{2}{N}$ libhalwa ngefom $xa+yb+z$ ($x, y, z$ ziinombolo zi-rational). Ixabiso le-$x+y+z$ lithini? (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Iinombolo ezili-prime ze-${N}$ ngu-$2, 3, 5$ kuphela. Zibhale njengamandla.
Sebenzisa $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$, $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, kwaye usebenzise ukuba $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logInequality.prompt: Phakathi kwezisombululo zokungalingani ${ineq}$, zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Qala ujonge imeko yengxoxo (ingxoxo kufuneka ibe lilungileyo).
Ukuba isiseko singaphantsi kwe-$1$, xa ususa i-logarithm, icala lophawu lokungalingani liyatshintsha.

alg_obtuseCount.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo zendalo $x$ ezenza ukuba kubekho itriangile ene-obtuse angle enemigama emithathu engu-${a}$, ${b}$, $x$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze yenze itriangile, icala elide kakhulu kufuneka libe lifutshane kunesixa samacala amabini asele.

Ukuze ibe nekona ye-obtuse, isikwere secala elide kakhulu kufuneka sibe sikhulu kunesixa sezikwere zamacala amabini asele. Hlula kwimeko apho $x$ lelona cala lide kwaye kwimeko apho icala elinobude ${b}$ lelona lide.

alg_rationalExp.prompt: Fumana ixabiso elilandelayo. ${expr}$ (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Bhala isiseko njengamandla enombolo ethile.
Sebenzisa umthetho wamandla $(a^{m})^{n}=a^{m\times n}$ njengo-$(c^{q})^{\frac{p}{q}}=c^{p}$, kwaye tshintshela amandla angalunganga ku-$a^{-n}=\frac{1}{a^{n}}$.

alg_realRootCount.prompt: Kwinombolo epheleleyo $n$ engu-$2$ okanye ngaphezulu, inani le-real numbers $x$ ezanelisa $x^{n}=A$ libizwa ngokuba yi-$f(n)$. Xa $A={rad}$, ixabiso le-$f(2)+f(3)+\cdots+f({N})$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Cinga ngokwahlula xa $n$ iyalingana nexa ingalingani.
Ngokuxhomekeke kuphawu lwe-$A$, kwi-$n$ elinganayo $f(n)=2$ okanye $0$, kwaye kwi-$n$ engalinganiyo $f(n)=1$.
alg_realRootCount.explanation: Ukuba $A$ iyalunga, kwi-$n$ elinganayo $f(n)=2$, kwi-$n$ engalinganiyo $f(n)=1$; ukuba $A$ ayilunganga, kwi-$n$ elinganayo $f(n)=0$, kwi-$n$ engalinganiyo $f(n)=1$. Ukubala inani le-$n$ elinganayo nengalinganiyo, ${work}$.

alg_recAffine.prompt: Xa ulandelelwano $\{a_n\}$ luchazwa nge-$a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{{k}}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana amaxabiso e-$a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ ngokulandelelana.
Bhala inani lelungu nexabiso etheyibhileni, usebenzise umthetho inyathelo ngalinye ukuya ku-$a_{{k}}$. Ukuba kuvela amaqhezu, wanciphise.

alg_recAffineQ.prompt: Xa ulandelelwano $\{a_n\}$ luchazwa nge-$a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{{k}}$? (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngeqhezu njenge-3/4)
hints: Fumana amaxabiso e-$a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ ngokulandelelana.
Bhala inani lelungu nexabiso etheyibhileni, usebenzise umthetho inyathelo ngalinye ukuya ku-$a_{{k}}$. Ukuba kuvela amaqhezu, wanciphise.

alg_recParam.prompt: Xa ulandelelwano $\{a_n\}$ luchazwa nge-$a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}=pa_n+{q}$ ($n\ge1$, $p$ linani elilungileyo) kwaye $a_3={t}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$p$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Zama ukuchaza u-$a_2$, $a_3$ ngo-$p$.
U-$a_3$ uba yi-quadratic ye-$p$. Khetha isisombululo esilungileyo.
Bhala inani elingaphakathi komsantsa njengamandla enani elithile.
Sebenzisa iipropati ezifanelekileyo phakathi kwe-$\sqrt[n]{a}\sqrt[n]{b}=\sqrt[n]{a\times b}$, $\frac{\sqrt[n]{a}}{\sqrt[n]{b}}=\sqrt[n]{\frac{a}{b}}$, $\sqrt[m]{\sqrt[n]{a}}=\sqrt[mn]{a}$.

alg_sectorForward.prompt: Kwi-sector enoradiyasi ye-${r}$ cm nekona esembindini ye-${th}$, xa ubude be-arc bungu-$a\pi$ cm kwaye indawo ingu-$b\pi$ cm$^{2}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b$? (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngeqhezu njenge-3/4)
hints: Ukuguqula ikona esembindini ibe ngee-radian, ubude be-arc $l=r\theta$, indawo $S=\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta$.
Qala ufumane ukuba u-$\theta$ ungamaxesha amangaphi e-$\pi$.

alg_sectorPerimArea.prompt: Kukho ii-sector ezimbini ezinomjikelezo we-${P}$ cm nendawo ye-${S}$ cm$^{2}$ (ikona esembindini incinci kune-$2\pi$). Phakathi kwazo, iradiyasi ye-sector enoradiyasi enkulu ingakanani ngee-cm? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba iradiyasi $r$, ubude be-arc $l$, umjikelezo yi-$2r+l$ kwaye indawo yi-$\frac{1}{2}rl$.
Ukususa u-$l$ kwenza i-quadratic equation ye-$r$.
alg_sectorPerimArea.explanation: Ukusuka ku-$2r+l={P}$, $\frac{1}{2}rl={S}$, ukususa u-$l$ kunika ${work}$, ngoko iradiyasi enkulu yi-${ans}$ cm.

alg_seqIntTerms.prompt: Xa ilungu eliqhelekileyo loluhlu $\{a_n\}$ li-$a_n=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$, zingaphi amalungu ayinombolo epheleleyo? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Wahlula i-numerator nge-denominator ukuze ibe sisimo se-$a_n=k+\frac{c}{n+r}$ ($k$ yinombolo epheleleyo, $c$ yinombolo engatshintshiyo).
Bala abahluli benombolo engatshintshiyo abanokuba yi-denominator $n+r$ (kwinani lendalo $n$, $n+r\ge{r1}$).
alg_seqIntTerms.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba ${work}$, amalungu ayinombolo epheleleyo azizonke zi-${ans}$.

alg_seriesPattern.prompt: Fumana ixabiso lesixa esilandelayo. ${expr}$ (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana umgaqo uze uchaze ilungu eliqhelekileyo $a_k$ ngo-$k$.
Bala usebenzisa iifomula ezinje nge-$\sum k$, $\sum k^{2}$ (ukuba uphawu luyatshintshana, ubeke ngamabini).

alg_sigmaSquare.prompt: Kuluhlu olubini $\{a_n\}$, $\{b_n\}$, xa $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_k^{2}={A}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_kb_k={B}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}b_k^{2}={C}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}({comb})^{2}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Sika okungaphakathi kwebhrakethi uze uwandise.
Sebenzisa ubuntlobo be-$\sum$ ($\sum(pa_k+qb_k)=p\sum a_k+q\sum b_k$) ukuyichaza ngezixa ezintathu ezinikiweyo.

alg_sigmaSubseq.prompt: Xa ilungu eliqhelekileyo loluhlu $\{a_n\}$ li-$a_n={an}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$\sum_{k=1}^{{m}}a_{{idx}}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Intetho efakwa endaweni ye-$n$ ye-$a_n$ yi-${idx}$. Yifake uyenze intetho ye-$k$.
Sebenzisa u-$\sum k=\frac{m(m+1)}{2}$, $\sum k^{2}=\frac{m(m+1)(2m+1)}{6}$, $\sum c=cm$.

alg_sigmaTelescope.prompt: Fumana ixabiso lesixa esilandelayo. ${expr}$ (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Yahlula ilungu ngalinye libe ngamaqhezu ongezelelweyo. Umzekelo: $\frac{1}{k(k+1)}=\frac{1}{k}-\frac{1}{k+1}$
Xa udibanisa, amalungu angaphambili nangasemva ayancitshiswa ngokulandelelana kwaye kusala amalungu ambalwa okuqala nawokugqibela.

alg_sumToTerm.prompt: Xa isixa selungu lokuqala ukuya kwelesi-$n$ loluhlu $\{a_n\}$ li-$S_n={expr}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a_{1}+a_{{k}}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, kwaye xa $n\ge2$, $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Ungathathi njengokuqinisekileyo ukuba ixabiso lokufaka $n=1$ kwi-equation ye-$a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ lilingana no-$S_1$.

alg_survey.prompt: Umgama phakathi kweendawo A, B ungu-${d}$ m. Ngokubonwa kwenye indawo C, $\angle CAB=\alpha$, $\angle CBA=\beta$ kwaye $\sin\alpha={sa}$, $\sin\beta={sb}$ ($\alpha$, $\beta$ ziikona ezibukhali). Umgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya ku-C ungakanani ngee-m? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuba $\angle C=180^\circ-\alpha-\beta$, $\sin C=\sin(\alpha+\beta)$.

Kwi-$\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta$, fumana i-cosine nge-$\cos=\sqrt{1-\sin^{2}}$. Emva koko sebenzisa umthetho we-sine $\frac{\overline{A C}}{\sin\beta}=\frac{\overline{A B}}{\sin C}$.
alg_survey.explanation: Kuba ${work}$, umgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya ku-C yi-${ans}$ m.

alg_trigGraphParam.prompt: Xa umsebenzi $y=a{fn}\,bx+c$ ($a>0$, $b>0$) unexabiso eliphezulu li-${M}$, elona lincinci li-${m}$, kwaye ixesha lijikelezo li-${per}$, lingakanani ixabiso lemveliso yeenombolo ezintathu ezingatshintshiyo $abc$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ixabiso eliphezulu li-$a+c$, elona lincinci li-$-a+c$.
Sebenzisa into yokuba ixesha lijikelezo li-$\frac{2\pi}{b}$ ukufumana u-$b$.

alg_trigIdentity.prompt: Kwinombolo yokwenyani $\theta$, xa ${given}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${E}$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$. Ukusika macala omabini entetho enikiweyo kubonisa u-$\sin\theta\cos\theta$.
Sika intetho enikiweyo ukufumana ixabiso le-$\sin\theta\cos\theta$. Ukuba intetho efunwayo yenye intetho yesikwere, yichaze ngendlela efanayo usebenzisa u-$\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

alg_trigPeriod.prompt: Ukuba ixesha elilungileyo elincinci kakhulu lomsebenzi ${f}$ li-$k\pi$, lithini ixabiso le-$k$? (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ixesha le-$y=\sin bx$, $y=\cos bx$ li-$\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$, kwaye ixesha le-$y=\tan bx$ li-$\frac{\pi}{|b|}$.

Ukuba kukho ixabiso eliphelele, icandelo elinegethivu legrafu liyagoqwa phezulu kwaye ixesha liba sisiqingatha. Zama ukuguqula izikwere njenge-$\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos2x}{2}$, $\cos^{2}x=\frac{1+\cos2x}{2}$.

alg_trigPoint.prompt: Ukuba umgca wokuqala ukwicala elilungileyo le-$x$-axis kwaye inqaku elinye emgqeni wokugqibela likwi-P$({xp}, {yp})$, kwaye ubungakanani bekona buyi-$\theta$, lithini ixabiso le-${E}$? (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane umgama $r=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$ osuka kwindawo ekuqaleni O ukuya kwinqaku P (xa ulungelelwaniso lwenqaku P lu-$(x, y)$).
$\sin\theta=\frac{y}{r}$, $\cos\theta=\frac{x}{r}$, $\tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}$.

alg_trigRootCount.prompt: Kwi-$0\le\theta<2\pi$, zingaphi iimpande zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ze-equation ${eq}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba ubeka $k\theta=\phi$, uluhlu lwe-$\phi$ lu-$0\le\phi<2k\pi$.
Bala inani lamanqaku okunqamlezana kwegrafu ye-$y=\sin\phi$ njalo njalo nomgca othe tye $y=$ (into engatshintshiyo) kwixesha ngalinye.

alg_trigSpecial.prompt: Fumana ixabiso elilandelayo. ${expr}$ (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngomlinganiselo onje ngo-3/4)
hints: Guqula ikona ibe ngekona engengaphantsi kwe-$0^\circ$ kwaye engaphantsi kwe-$360^\circ$ (ikona enomgca ofanayo wokugqibela).
Sebenzisa $\sin30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\tan45^\circ=1$ kunye neempawu kwikota nganye.

bm_absIneq.prompt: Phakathi kwesisombululo sokungalingani ${ineq}$, zingaphi onke amanani aphelele $x$ apho $-{N}\le x\le {N}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ucacise ukuba ixabiso eliphelele lincinci okanye likhulu kunenani elithile.
Ukuba lincinci, yiguqule ibe yi-$-c<A<c$; ukuba likhulu, ibe yi-$A<-c$ okanye $A>c$, ufumane uluhlu lwe-$x$, uze ubale amanani aphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu olunikiweyo.
bm_absIneq.explanation: Ekususeni uphawu lwexabiso eliphelele, isisombululo sika-${ineq}$ si-${sol}$. Phakathi kwazo, amanani aphelele asusela kwi-$-{N}$ ukuya kwi-${N}$ onke ama-${ans}$.

bm_circleLine.prompt: Isangqa: ${circ}$, umgca: ${line}$. Zingaphi onke amanani aphelele $m$ enza ukuba badibane kumanqaku amabini ahlukeneyo? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukufaka i-equation yomgca kwi-equation yesangqa kwenza i-equation yesikwere ye-$x$.
Ukuze badibane kumanqaku amabini ahlukeneyo, le equation yesikwere kufuneka ibe neempande ezimbini zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo. Fumana uluhlu lwe-$m$ kwi-discriminant $D>0$, uze ubale amanani aphelele.
bm_circleLine.explanation: Ukufaka i-equation yomgca kwi-equation yesangqa kunika ${sub}=0$. Ukuba i-discriminant ngu-$D$, $\frac{D}{4}={d4}$, ngoko kwi-$D>0$, ${cond}$. Ekubeni ${chk}$, amanani aphelele $m$ onke amanani aphelele asusela kwi-$-{hi}$ ukuya kwi-${hi}$, ngoko ama-${ans}$.

bm_compUnknown.prompt: Kwimisebenzi emibini $f(x)={f}$, $g$, xa umsebenzi odibeneyo $(g\circ f)(x)={h}$, lithini ixabiso le-$g({k})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukufumana ixabiso le-$g({k})$, fumana i-$x$ xa $f(x)={k}$.
Faka loo $x$ kumsebenzi odibeneyo $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$.
bm_compUnknown.explanation: Kwi-$f(x)={k}$, $x={x0}$. Ekubeni $(g\circ f)({x0})=g(f({x0}))=g({k})$, ixabiso lika-${h}$ xa $x={x0}$ ngu-${ans}$.

bm_countDigits.prompt: Kukho amakhadi angu-${n}$ ngamnye abhalwe inani elahlukileyo, kwaye amanani akwamakhadi ngu-${ds}$. Kuthathwa amakhadi amathathu abekwe emgceni omnye enza inani eliphezulu elinamanani amathathu. Mangaphi amanani ayinani elilinganayo? (Ikhadi lokuqala alinakuba nguziro. Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Idijithi yeeyunithi kufuneka ibe yinani elilinganayo. Qala ngokumisela idijithi yeeyunithi, uze uzalise ezinye.

Yahlula kwimeko apho idijithi yeeyunithi inguziro nalapho inani elilinganayo lingeloziro, uze ubale ngenani lokulungiselelwa. Xa inani elilinganayo elingeloziro likwiyunithi, idijithi yokuqala ayinakuba nguziro.
bm_countDigits.explanation: Xa idijithi yeeyunithi inguziro: iindawo ezimbini eziseleyo zikhethwa kumakhadi aseleyo angu-${n1}$ zibekwe emgceni, ngoko zi-${zex}$. Xa idijithi yeeyunithi iliinani elilinganayo elingeloziro: idijithi yeeyunithi ikhethwa phakathi kwamakhadi angu-${nz}$ anenani elilinganayo elingeloziro, idijithi yokuqala ikhethwa phakathi kwamakhadi angu-${n2}$ aseleyo ngaphandle koziro, kwaye indawo ephakathi ikhethwa phakathi kwamakhadi angu-${n2}$ aseleyo, ngoko zi-${oex}$. Ngomgaqo wesibalo, ${z}+{o}={ans}$.

bm_discK.prompt: Phakathi kwamanani apheleleyo $k$ enza ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi wequadratic $y={f}$ ihlangane ne-axis ye-$x$ kwiindawo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo, mangaphi akwi-$-{N}\le k\le {N}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuhlangana kwegrafu ne-axis ye-$x$ kwiindawo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo kuyafana nokuba i-equation yequadratic $y=0$ ibe nezimvo ezimbini zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo.
Fumana uluhlu lwe-$k$ olwenza i-discriminant $D$ ibe ngaphezu koziro, uze ubale amanani apheleleyo kuluhlu olunikiweyo.
bm_discK.explanation: Ukuze kubekho izimvo ezimbini zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo, i-discriminant $D={D}>0$ kufuneka, ngoko ${cond}$. Amanani apheleleyo $k$ afezekisa oku kwi-$-{N}\le k\le {N}$ ali-${ans}$ ewonke.

bm_funcCount.prompt: Iseti $X$ yiseti yawo onke amanani endalo angaphezulu kwe-${m}$ okanye alingana nayo, kwaye iseti $Y$ yiseti yawo onke amanani endalo angaphezulu kwe-${n}$ okanye alingana nayo. Phakathi kwemisebenzi $f$ ukusuka ku-$X$ ukuya ku-$Y$, mingaphi enalo $f(1)=1$ kwaye ingeyiyo umsebenzi omnye-kumnye? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $f(1)=1$, ixabiso lomsebenzi lalo lilungu ngalinye eliseleyo lingakhethwa ngokukhululekileyo kumalungu e-$Y$.
Fumana ngokuthi (yonke imisebenzi evumelana nemeko) $-$ (leyo ingumsebenzi omnye-kumnye). Kumsebenzi omnye-kumnye, amalungu ahlukeneyo anamaxabiso ahlukeneyo.
bm_funcCount.explanation: Imisebenzi enalo $f(1)=1$ ingu-${tot}$ kuba amalungu aseleyo angu-${m1}$ ngalinye linokuba namaxabiso angu-${n}$, kwaye phakathi kwayo imisebenzi emnye-kumnye ingu-${inj}$ kuba amalungu aseleyo kufuneka abe namaxabiso ahlukeneyo angeyo-1. Ngoko ${tot}-{inj}={ans}$.

bm_ineqSystem.prompt: Phakathi kwesisombululo esifanayo seenxaki ezimbini zomgca ${i1}$ kunye ${i2}$, mangaphi amanani apheleleyo $x$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Zisombulule ngokwahlukeneyo inxaki nganye ukuze kuqala kufumaneke uluhlu lwe-$x$.
Bonisa inxalenye apho oluhlu lubini luhlangana kumgca wamanani, uze ubale amanani apheleleyo ngaphakathi. Xa wahlula okanye uphindaphinda ngenani elingalunganga, uphawu lwenxaki luyajika.
bm_ineqSystem.explanation: Ukusombulula inxaki yokuqala kunika ${s1}$, kwaye ukusombulula yesibini kunika ${s2}$. Amanani apheleleyo akuluhlu oluhlangeneyo ngu-${ints}$, ngoko ali-${ans}$ ewonke.

bm_lineParPerp.prompt: Kukho umgca $L:{L}$ kwaye indawo $\mathrm{P}$ inemigca ehleliweyo $({x0},{y0})$. Ukuba i-$y$-intercept yomgca odlula kwindawo $\mathrm{P}$ ophuma ngokuhambelana no-$L$ ngu-$s$, kwaye i-$y$-intercept yomgca odlula kwindawo $\mathrm{P}$ othe nkqo ku-$L$ ngu-$t$, ixabiso lika-$s+t$ yintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuthambeka komgca ofana no-$ax+by+c=0$ ngu-$-\frac{a}{b}$, kwaye isiphumo semithambeko yemigca emibini ethe nkqo ngu-$-1$.
Umgca ohambelanayo unee-coefficient ezifanayo ze-$x$ ne-$y$, kwaye umgca othe nkqo unesimo se-$bx-ay=k$ ($k$ yinto engatshintshiyo). Faka imigca ehleliweyo yendawo P ukufumana u-$k$.
bm_lineParPerp.explanation: Umgca ohambelanayo ngu-${par}$ kwaye ukufaka u-$x=0$ kunika u-$s={s}$. Umgca othe nkqo ngu-${perp}$ kwaye ukufaka u-$x=0$ kunika u-$t={t}$. Ngoko $s+t={ans}$.

bm_matUnknown.prompt: Kwiimatriki $A={A}$, $B={B}$, $C={C}$, xa ${ex}=C$ iyabamba, ixabiso lesixa $x+y$ samanani okwenyani $x$, $y$ yintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze iimatriki ezimbini zilingane, amalungu asezindaweni ezifanayo kufuneka alingane.
Misa i-equation yomgca usebenzisa elungu elinalo $x$ ukufumana u-$x$, uze ufumane u-$y$ ngendlela efanayo.
bm_matUnknown.explanation: Ukuthelekisa amalungu ane-$x$ kunika ${eqx}$, ngoko $x={xv}$, kwaye ukuthelekisa amalungu ane-$y$ kunika ${eqy}$, ngoko $y={yv}$. Ngoko $x+y={ans}$.

bm_polyExpand.prompt: Xa ukwandiswa kwentetho ${expr}$ kulungiswe ngokwehla kwamandla ka-$x$, sisixa sini se-coefficient ye-$x^2$ nenombolo engatshintshiyo? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Andisa imveliso nganye ngokwahlukeneyo uze ubuthe amagama afanayo.
Kulula ukusebenzisa ifomula yokuphindaphinda $(ax+b)^2=a^2x^2+2abx+b^2$. Ungalibali uphawu neecoefficient ezingaphambili.
bm_polyExpand.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba $({e1}){op}({e2})$, ukulungisa kunika ${total}$. I-coefficient ye-$x^2$ yi-${c2}$, inombolo engatshintshiyo yi-${c0}$, ngoko isixa si-${ans}$.

bm_polyFactor.prompt: Isiphumo sokwahlula i-quadratic ${Pex}$ ibe zizinto yi-$(ax+b)(cx+d)$. Xa $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$ ziinombolo ezipheleleyo, $a>0$, $c>0$, $a\le c$, kwaye ukuba $a=c$ ngoko $b\le d$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b+c+d$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Cinga ngezibini zeenombolo ezipheleleyo ezinokwenza inombolo engatshintshiyo $bd$ ne-coefficient ye-$x^2$ $ac$.
Khetha umgqatswa omnye uze uwandise, uqinisekise ukuba i-coefficient ye-$x$ ilingana no-$ad+bc$.

bm_propRange.prompt: Kwiimeko ezimbini ze-$x$ yenombolo yokwenyani $p:{pc}$, $q: m\le x\le {n}$, lelona xabiso likhulu lenombolo epheleleyo $m$ eyenza ukuba umhlathi $p\to q$ ube yinyani liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba umhlathi $p\to q$ uyinyani, iseti yenyaniso ye-$p$ iqukiwe kwiseti yenyaniso ye-$q$.
Qala ufumane uluhlu lwe-$x$ olufezekisa u-$p$, uze wenze isiphelo saso sasekhohlo sibe phezulu okanye silingane no-$m$.
bm_propRange.explanation: Iseti yenyaniso ye-$p$ yi-$\{x\mid {lo}{rl}x{rl}{hi}\}$. Ukuze iqukiwe kwiseti yenyaniso ye-$q$ $\{x\mid m\le x\le {n}\}$, kufuneka $m\le {lo}$ kwaye ${hi}\le {n}$. Ngoko elona xabiso likhulu lenombolo epheleleyo $m$ li-${ans}$.

bm_quadRange.prompt: Kumsebenzi we-quadratic $f(x)={f}$, xa ixabiso eliphezulu le-$f(x)$ kwi-${s}\le x\le {t}$ li-$M$ kwaye elona lincinci li-$m$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$M+m$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Guqula ibe sisimo se-$f(x)=a(x-p)^2+q$ ufumane iqhosha eliphezulu.
Kuba i-$x$-coordinate yeqhosha eliphezulu iphakathi kwesithuba, thelekisa amaxabiso omsebenzi kwiqhosha nakwiziphelo zombini.
bm_quadRange.explanation: Kuba $f(x)={vf}$, iqhosha eliphezulu li-$({h},{k})$ kwaye liphakathi kwesithuba. Amaxabiso omsebenzi kwiziphelo zombini ngu-$f({s})={fs}$, $f({t})={ft}$, ngoko ixabiso eliphezulu $M={M}$, elona lincinci $m={m}$ kwaye $M+m={ans}$.

bm_quadRoots.prompt: Kwi-equation ${eq}$ ye-$x$, xa izimvo zokwenyani ezimbini ezahlukeneyo, ukusuka kwesona sincinci, zingu-$\alpha$, $\beta$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$\beta-2\alpha$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Shenxisa onke amagama asekunene aye ekhohlo wenze isimo se-(quadratic)$=0$.
Yahlula ibe zizinto ufumane izimvo ezimbini, uze ufake esincinci njenge-$\alpha$, esikhulu njenge-$\beta$.
bm_quadRoots.explanation: Ukulungisa kunika ${std}=0$ kwaye ukwahlula ibe zizinto kunika ${fac}=0$, ngoko $\alpha={al}$, $\beta={be}$. Ngoko $\beta-2\alpha={ans}$.

bm_setOps.prompt: Iseti epheleleyo $U$ yiseti yawo onke amanani endalo angaphantsi okanye alingana no-${n}$, kwaye kwii-subset ezimbini ze-$U$, u-$A$ yiseti yazo zonke izahluli ze-${a}$ kwaye u-$B$ yiseti yazo zonke iziphindaphindo ze-${b}$. Sisixa sini samalungu onke eseti $A\cap B^{c}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Zama ukubhala u-$A$ no-$B$ ngokubhala amalungu. Cinga ngo-$B$ ngaphakathi kwe-$U$ kuphela.
I-$B^{c}$ yinto eseleyo ngokususa amalungu e-$B$ kwi-$U$. Khetha kuphela amalungu e-$A$ angengomalungu e-$B$.
bm_setOps.explanation: Kuba $A=\{{As}\}$, $B=\{{Bs}\}$, $A\cap B^{c}=\{{Rs}\}$ kwaye isixa samalungu si-${ans}$.

bm_transform.prompt: Ulungelelwaniso lweqhosha $\mathrm{P}$ li-$({a},{b})$. Iqhosha $\mathrm{P}$ lihanjiswa nge-${p}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-${q}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$ ukwenza iqhosha $\mathrm{Q}$, iqhosha $\mathrm{Q}$ lijongwa ngokwe-axis ye-$x$ ukwenza iqhosha $\mathrm{R}$, kwaye iqhosha $\mathrm{R}$ lijongwa ngokomgca $y=x$ ukwenza iqhosha $\mathrm{S}(m,n)$. Lingakanani ixabiso le-$2m+n$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuhambisa: $(x,y)\to(x+p,\,y+q)$, ukujonga ngokwe-axis ye-$x$: $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$, ukujonga ngokomgca $y=x$: $(x,y)\to(y,x)$.
Fumana iqhosha ngalinye ngokulandelelana.

ca1_absNotDiff.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, zingaphi zonke iinombolo zokwenyani $k$ apho u-$f$ ungenakwahlulwa ngokwe-derivative kwi-$x=k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: I-$|g(x)|$ iyagoba kumanqaku apho uphawu lwe-$g(x)$ lutshintsha. Jonga ukuba uphawu lutshintsha kwisimvo na (isimvo esiphindiweyo).
Ukuba ukuphindaphindeka kwesimvo ngasinye kungu-odd, ayinakwahlulwa kuloo ndawo; ukuba kulingana, iyakwazi.
ca1_absNotDiff.explanation: Phakathi kwezimvo ze-equation ezingaphakathi kwexabiso eliphelele, ezo zinokuphindaphindeka okungu-odd zi-${oddr}$, kwaye ezo zilinganayo zi-${evenr}$. Kwizimvo ezinokuphindaphindeka okungu-odd, uphawu luyatshintsha kwaye ii-derivative zasekhohlo nezasekunene ziyahluka, ngoko azinakwahlulwa; kwizimvo ezilinganayo ziyakwazi. Ngoko amanqaku afunwayo ayi-${ans}$.

ca1_areaCubicAxis.prompt: Sisixa sini sendawo yamacandelo amabini ajikelezwe yikhaphu $y={f}$ ne-axis ye-$x$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Fumana i-$x$ yamanani okudibana kwekhaphu ne-axis ye-$x$ (izimvo ezintathu ze-cubic).
Kwinxalenye nganye, jonga ukuba ikhaphu ingaphezulu okanye ingaphantsi kwe-axis ye-$x$, kwaye ukuba ingaphantsi, tshintsha uphawu ngaphambi kokudibanisa.
ca1_areaCubicAxis.explanation: Amanqaku okudibana kwekhaphu ne-axis ye-$x$ ngu-$x={rs}$. Kwisithuba $[{r1},{r2}]$, $\int y\,dx={i1}$, kwisithuba $[{r2},{r3}]$, $\int y\,dx={i2}$, ngoko isixa sendawo si-$\left|{i1}\right|+\left|{i2}\right|={ansf}$.

ca1_areaLineParam.prompt: Xa indawo yomfanekiso ojikelezwe yikhaphu $y={cur}$ nomgca $y=mx$ ($0<m<{a}$) ingu-${S}$, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo engatshintshiyo $m$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: I-$x$ yamanani okudibana kwekhaphu nomgca ngu-$0$, ${a}-m$.
Chaza ixabiso le-integral ye-(ikhaphu)−(umgca) phakathi kwamanqaku amabini okudibana ngo-$m$, uze usombulule i-equation apho eli xabiso li-${S}$.
ca1_areaLineParam.explanation: I-$x$ yamanani okudibana ngu-$0$, ${a}-m$, kwaye indawo yi-$\int_0^{{a}-m}\{({a}-m)x-x^2\}dx=\frac{({a}-m)^3}{6}$. Ngenxa yokuba oku li-${S}$, ${a}-m={d}$, oko kukuthi $m={ans}$.

ca1_areaParabolaLine.prompt: Sisixa sini sendawo yomfanekiso ojikelezwe yiparabola $y={f}$ nomgca $y={g}$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Dibanisa ii-equation ezimbini ukufumana i-$x$ yamanani okudibana $\alpha<\beta$.
Dibanisa i-(equation engaphezulu)−(equation engaphantsi) ukusuka ku-$\alpha$ ukuya ku-$\beta$.
ca1_areaParabolaLine.explanation: Ukudibanisa ii-equation ezimbini kunika i-$x$ yamanani okudibana ${al}$, ${be}$, kwaye umahluko wee-equation ezimbini yi-${dif}$. Ukudibanisa i-(igrafu engaphezulu)−(igrafu engaphantsi) kwesi sithuba, indawo yi-${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_areaTangentParabola.prompt: Sisixa sini sendawo yomfanekiso ojikelezwe yitangenti kwiqhosha eliyi-$x$ ye-${a}$ kwiparabola $y={f}$, leparabola, kunye ne-axis ye-$y$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane i-equation yetangenti. Itangenti ikwicala elinye leparabola (ngaphezulu okanye ngaphantsi).
Dibanisa ixabiso eliphelele le-(iparabola)−(itangenti) ukusuka ku-$x=0$ ukuya ku-$x={a}$.
ca1_areaTangentParabola.explanation: I-equation yetangenti yi-$y={tl}$ kwaye umahluko weparabola netangenti yi-${dif}$. Ukudibanisa ixabiso eliphelele lomahluko ukusuka ku-$x=0$ ukuya ku-$x={a}$, indawo yi-${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_contProduct.prompt: Kumsebenzi ${pw}$ nakwi-$g(x)={gd}$ (onke oonobumba abavela kwi-equation ye-$g$ ziinombolo ezingatshintshiyo), xa $f(x)g(x)$ iqhubeka kuwo onke amanani okwenyani $x$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$g({kq})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze $f(x)g(x)$ iqhubeke nakwiindawo apho u-$f$ ongaqhubekiyo, ixabiso lika-$g$ kuloo ndawo kufuneka libe njani?
Misela iinombolo ezingatshintshiyo ezivela kwi-equation ye-$g$ ngemeko yokuba $g=0$ kuloo ndawo.
ca1_contProduct.explanation: U-$f$ ubonisa ukutsiba kwexabiso kwi-${ptxt}$, ngoko ukuze $f(x)g(x)$ iqhubeke, kufuneka $g=0$ kula manqaku. Ukumisela iinombolo ezingatshintshiyo ngale meko kunika $g(x)={gfull}$ kwaye $g({kq})={ans}$.

ca1_contRadical.prompt: Xa umsebenzi ${pw}$ uqhubeka kwi-$x={c}$, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo engatshintshiyo $k$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuze uqhubeke kwi-$x={c}$, ixabiso le-limit xa $x\to {c}$ kufuneka libe ngu-$k$.
Susa umsantsa kwi-numerator okanye kwi-denominator, uze unciphise isiqhamo esiqhelekileyo.
ca1_contRadical.explanation: Ukuze uqhubeke, $k=\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$. Ngokususa umsantsa nokunciphisa kwi-$x\ne {c}$, $f(x)={rat}$, ngoko ixabiso le-limit xa $x\to {c}$ li-$k={ansf}$.

ca1_contTwoJoint.prompt: Xa umsebenzi ${pw}$ uqhubeka kuwo onke amanani okwenyani $x$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b$ kwiinombolo ezingatshintshiyo $a$, $b$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Iindawo apho ungaqhubeki khona zi-$x={p1}$, $x={p2}$ apho i-equation itshintsha.
Misela ii-equation zokuba amaxabiso e-equation yasekhohlo neyasekunene alingana kwindawo nganye.
ca1_contTwoJoint.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba amaxabiso e-equation zombini kufuneka alingane kwi-$x={p1}$, $x={p2}$, kufunyanwa ii-equation ezimbini, kwaye ukuzisombulula kunika $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Ngoko $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_defIntAbs.prompt: Lingakanani ixabiso le-$\int_{{p}}^{{q}}|{g}|\,dx$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Fumana indawo apho uphawu lwe-equation engaphakathi kwexabiso eliphelele lutshintsha khona, oko kukuthi isimvo apho ixabiso le-$x$ liphakathi kwesithuba.
Yahlula isithuba kuloo ndawo, susa ixabiso eliphelele kwisithuba ngasinye, uze udibanise.
ca1_defIntAbs.explanation: I-equation engaphakathi kwexabiso eliphelele itshintsha uphawu kwi-$x={zs}$, ngoko isithuba siyahlulwa. Kwinxalenye nganye uphawu luzinzile, ngoko ukudibanisa amaxabiso apheleleyo e-definite integral yenxalenye nganye kunika ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_defIntFindBound.prompt: Kwinombolo elungileyo $a$, xa $\int_{{lo}}^{a}\left({g}\right)dx={V}$, lingakanani ixabiso lika-$a$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana i-indefinite integral uze uchaze u-$\int_{{lo}}^{a}$ njenge-polynomial ye-$a$.
Kwi-equation efunyenweyo, fumana isisombululo apho $a>{lo}$. Kuba yintetho enyukayo, kukho isisombululo esinye kuphela.
ca1_defIntFindBound.explanation: I-indefinite integral enye yi-$G(x)={G}$, ngoko $G(a)-G({lo})={V}$, kwaye kwi-$a>{lo}$ eli xabiso liyanda ngo-$a$, ngoko kukho isisombululo esinye kuphela. Ukusombulula kunika $a={ans}$.

ca1_defIntSplit.prompt: Kumsebenzi oqhubekayo $f(x)$, xa $\int_{{a0}}^{{p}}f(x)\,dx={A}$, $\int_{{a0}}^{{q}}f(x)\,dx={B}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({mf}\right)dx$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa iipropati ze-definite integral $\int_a^b f\,dx+\int_b^c f\,dx=\int_a^c f\,dx$ kunye no-$\int_b^a f\,dx=-\int_a^b f\,dx$.
Chaza i-integral ye-$f$ efunwayo ngamaxabiso amabini anikiweyo, uze udibanise inxalenye engatshintshiyo ngokwahlukeneyo.
ca1_defIntSplit.explanation: Kwisithuba esifunwayo, $\int f(x)\,dx={I}$. Item engatshintshiyo ibalwa njenge-$\int c\,dx=c\times(\text{ubude obunomkhomba wesithuba})$ uze udibanise. Ngoko ixabiso li-${ans}$.

ca1_defIntSymm.prompt: Lingakanani ixabiso le-$\int_{-{a}}^{{a}}\left({g}\right)dx$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Isithuba silinganayo ngokweziko. I-integral yamagama anamandla angaqhelekanga e-$x$ ingu-$0$.
Andisa intetho ushiye amagama anamandla alinganayo kuphela, uze ubale ngo-$2\int_0^{a}$.
ca1_defIntSymm.explanation: Ukulungisa intetho kunika i-definite integral yamagama angaqhelekanga engu-$0$, kwaye amagama alinganayo yi-${evp}$. Ngoko $2\int_0^{a}\left({evp}\right)dx={ansf}$.

ca1_derivSignMin.prompt: Kumsebenzi we-polynomial $f$, xa ${given}$, sisixa sini samaxabiso onke ka-$x$ apho u-$f$ unexabiso eliphantsi? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Amaxabiso aphezulu nawaphantsi avela kumanqaku apho uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ lutshintsha. Kwisimvo esiphindiweyo (isinto sesikwere) uphawu aluguquki.
Jonga uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ ngasekhohlo nangasekunene kwesimvo ngasinye, uze ufumane amanqaku apho utshintsha ukusuka kwi-$-$ ukuya kwi-$+$.
ca1_derivSignMin.explanation: Amanqaku apho uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ lutshintsha ukusuka kwi-$-$ ukuya kwi-$+$ ngamanqaku axabiso eliphantsi. Ukwenza itheyibhile yophawu kubonisa ukuba la manqaku yile xa $x$ yi-${mins}$, kwaye isixa si-${ans}$.

ca1_diffLimitPoly.prompt: Xa $f(x)={f}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${lim}$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ungayitshintshela intetho ibe sisimo se-derivative ye-$f$, $\lim\frac{f(a+\Delta)-f(a)}{\Delta}$. Yongeza ususe ukwenza ukuba isimo se-$f(x)-f({a})$ sivele kwinumerator.
Qala ufumane ixabiso le-$f({a})$ okanye le-$f'({a})$, uze udibanise ngokufanelekileyo kwintetho.
ca1_diffLimitPoly.explanation: Qala ufumane i-$f'(x)$, ngoko $f'({a})={d1}$ kwaye $f({a})={d0}$. Ukuchaza i-limit nge-derivative, ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_diffParam.prompt: Xa umsebenzi ${pw}$ unokwahlulwa ngokwe-derivative kwi-$x={c}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b$ kwiinombolo ezingatshintshiyo $a$, $b$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba unokwahlulwa, uqhubeka kwi-$x={c}$, kwaye i-derivative esekhohlo nesekunene iyalingana.
Misela ii-equation ezimbini: ukulingana kwamaxabiso omsebenzi kwi-$x={c}$ nokulingana kwamaxabiso e-derivative.
ca1_diffParam.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba uqhubeka kwi-$x={c}$, amaxabiso eentetho ezimbini ayalingana, kwaye ngenxa yokuba unokwahlulwa, amaxabiso e-derivative yazo nawo ayalingana. Ukusombulula ii-equation ezimbini kunika $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, ngoko $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_extremaCoef.prompt: Umsebenzi we-cubic $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$, $c$ ziinombolo ezingatshintshiyo) unexabiso eliphezulu kwi-$x={m}$ nexabiso eliphantsi kwi-$x={n}$, kwaye $f({z})={w}$. Sisixa sini sexabiso eliphezulu nexabiso eliphantsi? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kumanqaku exabiso eliphezulu nelona liphantsi, $f'(x)=0$, ngoko $a$, $b$ unokufumana ngo-$f'({m})=f'({n})=0$.
Emva kokufumana $a$, $b$, misela $c$ ngemeko $f({z})={w}$. Okokugqibela bala ixabiso eliphezulu $f({m})$ nelona liphantsi $f({n})$ uze uwadibanise.
ca1_extremaCoef.explanation: Ukusuka ku-$f'({m})=f'({n})=0$, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, kwaye ukusuka ku-$f({z})={w}$, $c={cv}$. Ixabiso eliphezulu li-$f({m})={fm}$, elona liphantsi li-$f({n})={fn}$, ngoko isixa si-${ans}$.

ca1_indefInitial.prompt: Xa i-derivative yomsebenzi $f(x)$ ngu-$f'(x)={d}$ kwaye $f({p})={q}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$f({r})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: $f(x)$ yi-indefinite integral ye-$f'(x)$. Fumana u-$f(x)$ ngokubandakanya inombolo yokudibanisa $C$.
Emva kokumisela $C$ ngemeko $f({p})={q}$, fumana ixabiso le-$f({r})$.

ca1_indefSecond.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)$, $f''(x)={d}$ kwaye $f'({p})={s}$, $f({q})={w}$. Lingakanani ixabiso le-$f({r})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukudibanisa u-$f''$ kanye kunika u-$f'$, kwaye kanye kwakhona kunika u-$f$. Ukudibanisa ngalinye kudala inombolo enye yokudibanisa.
Misela inombolo yokuqala ngemeko $f'({p})={s}$, neyesibini ngemeko $f({q})={w}$.
ca1_indefSecond.explanation: Ukudibanisa u-$f''$ nokumisela inombolo ngemeko $f'({p})={s}$ kunika $f'(x)={g1}$, kwaye ukudibanisa kwakhona nokumisela inombolo ngemeko $f({q})={w}$ kunika $f(x)={g0}$. Ngoko $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_ineqParam.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, lelona xabiso lincinci lenombolo yokwenyani $a$ eyenza ukuba inxaki $f(x)+a\ge 0$ ihlale ichanekile kwisithuba ${dom}$ yintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze $f(x)+a\ge0$ ihlale ichanekile, ixabiso elincinci le-$f(x)$ kwesi sithuba kufuneka libe ngaphezulu okanye lilingane no-$-a$.
Fumana ixabiso elincinci le-$f(x)$ esithubeni ngokuthelekisa amaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi namaxabiso emisebenzi esiphelweni sesithuba.
ca1_ineqParam.explanation: Ixabiso elincinci le-$f(x)$ kwesi sithuba li-${mn}$. Ukuze $f(x)+a\ge0$ ihlale ichanekile, $a\ge {mn2}$, ngoko elona xabiso lincinci lika-$a$ li-${ans}$.

ca1_integralEq.prompt: Xa umsebenzi we-polynomial $f(x)$ unjalo kuzo zonke ii-real number $x$ ukuba $f(x)={rhs}$, ixabiso le-$f({k})$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt$ yi-constant engaxhomekekanga ku-$x$. Yibeke njenge-$c$ ukuze ubhale u-$f(x)$ nge-$c$.
Faka loo $f(x)$ kwi-$\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ ukufumana u-$c$.
ca1_integralEq.explanation: Xa sibeka $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ (constant), u-$f(x)$ uba yi-quadratic equation equnga u-$c$. Kwi-equation yokuba ixabiso lokudibanisa ukusuka ku-$0$ ukuya ku-$1$ lilingana no-$c$, $c={c}$, kwaye $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralFuncExtremum.prompt: Xa $f(t)={f}$, lithini ixabiso elincinci lasekuhlaleni lomsebenzi $G(x)=\int_{{s}}^{x}f(t)\,dt$? (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ngenxa yokuba $G'(x)=f(x)$, ukunyuka nokwehla kwe-$G$ kumiselwa luphawu lwe-$f(x)$.
Ubuncinci basekuhlaleni bubakho kwi-$x$ apho uphawu lwe-$f(x)$ lutshintsha ukusuka ku-$-$ ukuya ku-$+$, kwaye ixabiso lalo libalwa nge-$\int_{s}^{x}f(t)\,dt$.
ca1_integralFuncExtremum.explanation: Inqaku apho uphawu lwe-$G'(x)=f(x)$ lutshintsha ukusuka ku-$-$ ukuya ku-$+$ yi-$x={z}$. Ixabiso elincinci lasekuhlaleni yi-$G({z})=\int_{{s}}^{{z}}f(t)\,dt={ansf}$.

ca1_integralFuncFind.prompt: Xa umsebenzi we-polynomial $f(x)$ wanelisa $\int_{{c}}^{x}f(t)\,dt={F}$ ($a$ yi-constant) kuzo zonke ii-real number $x$, ixabiso le-$f({k})$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Xa $x={c}$, i-integral ekwicala lasekhohlo ngu-$0$, ngoko usebenzise oku ukufumana u-$a$.
Emva koko khupha amacala omabini ngokubhekisele ku-$x$ ukufumana u-$f(x)$.
ca1_integralFuncFind.explanation: Xa $x={c}$, icala lasekhohlo ngu-$0$, ngoko $a={av}$. Ukukhupha amacala omabini kunika $f(x)={fx}$, ngoko $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralLimit.prompt: Kumsebenzi we-polynomial $f(x)={f}$, ixabiso le-${lim}$ lithini? (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Zombini i-denominator ne-numerator ziyasondela ku-$0$. Zama ukusebenzisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-definite integral ne-indefinite integral $\frac{d}{d x}\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=f(x)$.
Ngo-$F$ apho $F'(x)=f(x)$, bhala $\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=F(x)-F(a)$, kwaye ifom yenkcazo ye-derivative iyavela.
ca1_integralLimit.explanation: Ngo-$F$ apho $F'(x)=f(x)$, ukubhala i-integral njenge-$F(\text{upper limit})-F(\text{lower limit})$ kwenza ukuba umda ube yifom ye-derivative ye-$F$, kwaye ixabiso lawo yi-${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_ivtCount.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezenza ukuba i-equation ${fx}=0$ ibe nengcambu yokwenyani kwithuba elivulekileyo $({m},{n})$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Lo msebenzi uyanyuka kuyo yonke ithuba. Ngoko iimpawu zamaxabiso omsebenzi kwiziphelo zombini zethuba kufuneka zahluke.
Bhala imeko yokuba iimpawu ze-$f({m})$, $f({n})$ ziyachasana, oko kukuthi $f({m})f({n})<0$, njengokungalingani kuka-$a$.
ca1_ivtCount.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba $f(x)={fx}$ inyuka ngenxa ye-$f'(x)>0$, imeko efunekayo nenelisayo yokuba nengcambu yokwenyani kwithuba yi-$f({m})f({n})<0$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezenelisa oku zi-${alo}<a<{ahi}$, ngoko zi-${ans}$.

ca1_kinCoefFind.prompt: Indawo yenqaku P ehamba kumgca wenombolo ngexesha $t$ yi-$x(t)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ziyi-constants). Xa isantya senqaku P ngexesha $t={p}$ singu-$0$ kwaye ukukhawuleza yi-${q}$, indawo yenqaku P ngexesha $t={k}$ ithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Isantya yi-$v(t)=x'(t)$, ukukhawuleza yi-$a(t)=v'(t)$. Bhala iimeko ezimbini njengezibalo: $v({p})=0$, $a({p})={q}$.
Sombulula izibalo ezimbini kunye ukufumana u-$a$, $b$, uze ubale ixabiso le-$x({k})$.

ca1_limCoefPoly.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ngamanani angatshintshiyo), xa ${lim}={L}$, ixabiso le-$f(1)$ liyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Kuba umda ukhona kwaye inani elingaphantsi wehla ube ngu-$0$, inani elingasentla nasso kufuneka sibe ngu-$0$ kwi-$x={c}$.
Emva koko umda ngu-${rel}$, ngoko sebenzisa ulingano lokuba eli xabiso li-${L}$ kunye nemeko yesiqulatho elingasentla uze wenze iinkqubo zoqwalaselo ngo-$a$, $b$.
ca1_limCoefPoly.explanation: Kuba inani elingasentla kufuneka sibe ngu-$0$ kwi-$x={c}$, $f({c})={m0}$. Emva koko umda ngu-${rel}$ kwaye eli xabiso li-${L}$, ngoko ukudibanisa ezi zilingano zombini kunika $a={av}$, $b={bv}$ kwaye $f(1)={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefRational.prompt: Xa $\lim_{x\to {c}}\frac{{num}}{{den}}={L}$, ixabiso le-$a+b$ liyintoni kumanani angatshintshiyo $a$, $b$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze umda ube khona kwi-$x={c}$ apho inani elingaphantsi wehla ube ngu-$0$, inani elingasentla nasso kufuneka sibe ngu-$0$ kwi-$x={c}$.
Chaza u-$b$ ngo-$a$ ukuze inani elingasentla sibe nesinye isiqinisi ${xc}$, uze wenze ulingano lokuba umda wesiqulatho esincitshisiweyo ulingana nexabiso elinikiweyo (${L}$).
ca1_limCoefRational.explanation: Kuba umda ukhona kwaye inani elingaphantsi wehla ube ngu-$0$ kwi-$x={c}$, inani elingasentla kufuneka sibe ngu-$0$ kwi-$x={c}$. Emva kokucitshisa isiqinisi esiqhelekileyo sesiqulatho elingasentla nelingaphantsi, kwimeko yokuba umda ulingana nexabiso elinikiweyo (${L}$), $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Ngoko ke $a+b={ans}$.
