ca1_limDerivForm.prompt: Kumsebenzi onokwahlulwa $f(x)$, xa $f({a})={s}$ kwaye $f'({a})={t}$, ixabiso le-${lim}$ liyintoni? (Bhala njengeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Yongeza uze uthabathe okanye ubeke ezingxoweni inani elingasentla ukuze kuvele ifom ye-$f(x)-f({a})$ (okanye ifom ye-$f(a+h)-f(a)$).
Inkcazo ye-derivative ngu-$\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{f(x)-f({a})}{{xa}}=f'({a})$.
ca1_limDerivForm.explanation: Ngokwenza ifom ye-$f(x)-f({a})$ kwinani elingasentla nokusebenzisa inkcazo ye-derivative, kuba $f({a})={s}$ kwaye $f'({a})={t}$, umda li-${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_limExistence.prompt: Kumsebenzi ${pw}$, xa ixabiso le-$\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$ likhona, ixabiso lomqondo ongatshintshiyo $a$ liyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze umda ube khona, umda wasekhohlo nowasekunene xa $x\to {c}$ kufuneka ulingane.
Faka amaxabiso aphantsi kwe-$x={c}$ kulingano lwe-$x<{c}$ nakulingano lwe-$x>{c}$, uze uchaze imida emibini ngo-$a$.
ca1_limExistence.explanation: Umda wasekhohlo lixabiso lolingano lwe-$x<{c}$ xa $x\to {c}$, umda wasekunene lixabiso lolingano lwe-$x>{c}$. Kuba la maxabiso mabini kufuneka alingane, $a={ans}$.

ca1_limInfRatio.prompt: Ixabiso le-$\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ liyintoni? (Bhala njengeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthelekise iidigri zamalungu aphezulu esiqulatho elingasentla nelingaphantsi. Ukuba idigri yesiqulatho elingasentla iphantsi kunelingaphantsi, umda ngu-$0$.
Zama ukwahlula inani elingaphantsi nesiqulatho elingasentla ngamandla amakhulu e-$x$.
ca1_limInfRatio.explanation: Xa $x\to\infty$, inani elingasentla sikhethwa yifom ye-${nl}$, elingaphantsi sikhethwa yi-${dl}$, ngoko umda ulingana nomda womlinganiselo wamalungu amabini $\frac{{nl}}{{dl}}$, kwaye eli xabiso li-${ansf}$.

ca1_limPiecewise.prompt: Kumsebenzi ${pw}$, ixabiso le-{ask} liyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ulingano lomsebenzi $f$ luyatshintsha kwi-$x={k}$. Qala ubone ukuba ixabiso elingena kwi-$f$ liyasondela ku-${k}$ lisuka kwicala elincinci okanye elikhulu.
Fumana ixabiso kwi-$x={k}$ kulingano lwecala elikhethiweyo. Ixabiso lomsebenzi $f({k})$ ngokwalo alinasingxam nomda.
ca1_limPiecewise.explanation: Umda xa $x\to {k}^{-}$ li-${lv}$, umda xa $x\to {k}^{+}$ li-${rv}$ (ixabiso lomsebenzi kwi-$x={k}$ li-${e}$, kodwa alinasingxam nomda). Ngokujonga ukuba ixabiso langaphakathi kwisiqulatho elifunwayo lisondela ku-${k}$ lisuka kwicala eliphi, nokubhala la maxabiso ngokufanelekileyo, impendulo li-${ans}$.

ca1_limRadical.prompt: Lingakanani ixabiso le-$\lim_{x\to\infty}\left({expr}\right)$? (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngeqhezu njenge-3/4)
hints: Kumahluko phakathi kweentetho ezinomsantsa, okanye phakathi kwentetho enomsantsa nentetho yomgca, phindaphinda i-numerator ne-denominator nge-(intetho enomsantsa)+(intetho eseleyo) ukususa umsantsa.
Emva kokususa umsantsa, wahlula i-numerator ne-denominator ngo-$x$ uze uthumele u-$x\to\infty$.
ca1_limRadical.explanation: Ukususa umsantsa kwi-numerator kutshintsha intetho ibe sisimo se-$\frac{{numr}}{{den2}}$. Ukwahlula i-numerator ne-denominator ngo-$x$, i-numerator isondela ku-${nc}$ kwaye i-denominator isondela ku-${dc}$, ngoko ixabiso le-limit li-${ans}$.

ca1_maxMinFind.prompt: Xa ixabiso eliphezulu lomsebenzi $f(x)={f}$ ($a$ yinombolo engatshintshiyo) kwisithuba esivaliweyo $[{s},{t}]$ li-${M}$, lelona xabiso lincinci kwesi sithuba liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kwisithuba esivaliweyo, fumana ixabiso eliphezulu nelona lincinci ngokuthelekisa amaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi ngaphakathi kwesithuba namaxabiso omsebenzi kwiziphelo zombini.
Fumana ixabiso eliphezulu ugcine u-$a$ kuyo ukumisela u-$a$, uze ufumane ixabiso elincinci ngendlela efanayo.
ca1_maxMinFind.explanation: Ukuthelekisa amaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi ngaphakathi kwesithuba namaxabiso omsebenzi kwiziphelo, ixabiso eliphezulu li-${mx0}+a$ kwaye lilo li-${M}$, ngoko $a={av}$. Ixabiso elincinci li-${mn0}+a={ans}$.

ca1_monoGiven.prompt: Xa umsebenzi we-cubic $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ziinombolo ezingatshintshiyo) uyancipha kwisithuba esivaliweyo $[{m},{n}]$ kwaye uyanda kwizithuba ezibini $(-\infty,{m}]$, $[{n},\infty)$ ngokwahlukeneyo, lingakanani umahluko phakathi kwexabiso eliphezulu nelincinci le-$f(x)$ kwisithuba $[{m},{n}]$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: $f'(x)=0$ kumanqaku $x={m}$, $x={n}$ apho u-$f$ etshintsha ekwandeni ukuya ekuncipheni nasekuncipheni ukuya ekwandeni.

$f'(x)$ yi-quadratic enezimvo ezingu-$x={m}$, $x={n}$, ngoko yibhale njenge-$f'(x)=($i-coefficient yetem yesikwere$)\times{fm}{fn}$ ukufumana u-$a$, $b$. Kwisithuba esincipha, ixabiso eliphezulu nelincinci livela kweliphi icala?
ca1_monoGiven.explanation: Kuba $f'(x)=0$ kwi-$x={m}$, $x={n}$ apho kutshintsha ukwanda nokuncipha, $f'(x)={d3}{fm}{fn}$. Ukuthelekisa ii-coefficient kunika $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Kuba uyancipha kwisithuba, ixabiso eliphezulu li-$f({m})={fmv}$, elincinci li-$f({n})={fnv}$ kwaye umahluko wazo yi-${ans}$.

ca1_mvtBound.prompt: Umsebenzi onokwahlulwa $f(x)$ unokuba ${lo}\le f'(x)\le {hi}$ kuwo onke amanani okwenyani $x$, kwaye ${cond}$. Lelona xabiso liphezulu le-$f({b})$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ngethiyori yexabiso eliphakathi, kukho u-$c$ apho $f(b)-f(a)=f'(c)(b-a)$. Sebenzisa ixabiso eliphezulu le-$f'(c)$.
Ukuba kukho amanqaku amabini aziwayo, cinga ngeliseleyo ngakumbi kwindawo efunwayo.
ca1_mvtBound.explanation: Indawo eyaziwayo esondele kakhulu kwi-$f({b})$ efunwayo yi-$x={na}$ ($f({na})={nm}$) kwaye umgama ngu-${gap}$. Ngethiyori yexabiso eliphakathi, $f({b})-({nm})=f'(c)\times{gap}\le {hi}\times{gap}$, ngoko $f({b})\le {ans}$. Kuba lo mmandla unokufunyanwa ngokwenene ngomsebenzi onomthambeko oqhubeka ungu-${hi}$, elona xabiso liphezulu li-${ans}$.

ca1_mvtC.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo yokwenyani $c$ (apho $c$ likhulu kuno-${a}$ kwaye lincinci kuno-${b}$) efezekisa ithiyori yexabiso eliphakathi kwisithuba $[{a},{b}]$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: U-$c$ wethiyori yexabiso eliphakathi ufezekisa $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}=f'(c)$.
Qala ufumane izinga eliphakathi lotshintsho, uze ukhethe isimvo se-$f'(c)=($izinga eliphakathi lotshintsho$)$ esingaphakathi kwesithuba esivulekileyo.
ca1_mvtC.explanation: Izinga eliphakathi lotshintsho li-$\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}={sl}$, kwaye isisombululo se-$f'(c)={sl}$ esisesithubeni $({a},{b})$ sinye kuphela: $c={ans}$.

ca1_noExtremum.prompt: Kumsebenzi we-cubic $f(x)={f}$, zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezenza ukuba u-$f$ angabi namaxabiso aphezulu okanye aphantsi? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba umsebenzi we-cubic awunalo ixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi kuthetha ukuba uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ aluguquki.
Bhala i-discriminant $D\le 0$ ye-quadratic equation $f'(x)=0$ njengenxaki ye-$a$ uze ubale izisombululo ezipheleleyo.
ca1_noExtremum.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ akufuneki lutshintshe, i-discriminant $D\le 0$ ye-$f'(x)=0$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezifezekisa oku zi-${lo}\le a\le {hi}$, ngoko zi-${ans}$.

ca1_optimBox.prompt: Kwiphepha elimile okwengxande elinobubanzi be-${W}$ cm nobude be-${H}$ cm, kunqunyulwa izikwere ezinecala elifanayo kumakona omane, kuze kugotywe inxalenye eseleyo yenziwe ibhokisi ende engenasigqubuthelo. Elona xabiso likhulu lomthamo webhokisi liyintoni ngee-cm³? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Thatha ubude becala elinye lesikwere esinqunyulwayo njenge-$x$ uze uchaze umthamo webhokisi ngo-$x$ njengomsebenzi we-$V(x)$.
Umthamo wona mkhulu kwixabiso lesisombululo se-$V'(x)=0$ elisoluhlu lwe-$0<x<(\text{icala elifutshane})\div 2$.
ca1_optimBox.explanation: Ukuba ubude becala elinye lesikwere esinqunyulwayo yi-$x$ cm, $V(x)=x({W}-2x)({H}-2x)$ ($0<x<{hh}$), kwaye ukusombulula u-$V'(x)=0$, ubuninzi bukwi-$x={x}$ apho kutshintsha ukusuka ekwandeni ukuya ekuncipheni. Umthamo omkhulu yi-${ans}$ cm³.

ca1_optimProfit.prompt: Xa kuvelisiwa iiyunithi ezingu-$x$ ($0\le x\le {X}$) ngosuku kwaye zonke ziyathengiswa, iindleko ezipheleleyo zi-$C(x)={cost}$ (iiyunithi ze-10 000 won), kwaye ixabiso lokuthengisa leyunithi nganye li-${price}$ (iiyunithi ze-10 000 won). Lelona xabiso likhulu lenzuzo yosuku (imali ethengiswayo ukususa iindleko ezipheleleyo) liyintoni ngeeyunithi ze-10 000 won? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Thatha inzuzo njenge-$P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ uze usombulule u-$P'(x)=0$.
Thelekisa hayi kuphela ixabiso lomsebenzi kwi-$x$ ephezulu, kodwa nakwiziphelo zesithuba $x=0$, $x={X}$.
ca1_optimProfit.explanation: $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ kwaye kwi-$P'(x)=0$ indawo ephezulu esithubeni yi-$x={xs}$. Kule ndawo nakwiziphelo, $P({xs})={ans}$, $P(0)={p0}$, $P({X})={pX}$, ngoko ixabiso eliphezulu li-${ans}$ (iiyunithi ze-10 000 won).

ca1_powerFindN.prompt: Kwinani lendalo $n$, $f(x)={f}$. Xa $f'({a})={V}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$n$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: I-derivative ye-$x^n$ yi-$nx^{n-1}$.
Chaza u-$f'(x)$ ngo-$n$, uze ucinge ukuba ixabiso litshintsha njani njengoko u-$n$ ekhula.
ca1_powerFindN.explanation: $f'(x)={cc}\cdot n\cdot x^{n-1}-{kk}$, ngoko $f'({a})={cc}\cdot n\cdot{a}^{n-1}-{kk}$. Eli xabiso liyanda njengoko u-$n$ ekhula, ngoko linani elinye kuphela lendalo $n$ elinexabiso le-${V}$, $n={ans}$.

ca1_powerTangentN.prompt: Kwikhaphu $y={fx}$ ($n$ linani lendalo eliphezulu okanye elilingana ne-$2$), xa i-$y$-intercept yetangenti kwiqhosha eliyi-$x$ ye-${a}$ ingu-${V}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$n$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: I-derivative ye-$x^n$ yi-$nx^{n-1}$, ngoko umthambeko wetangenti uchazwa ngo-$n$.
Ukuba i-$y$-intercept yetangenti ichazwa ngo-$n$, ixabiso layo eliphelele liyanda njengoko u-$n$ ekhula.
ca1_powerTangentN.explanation: Kwi-$f(x)={fx}$, $f'(x)={cc}nx^{n-1}$, ngoko i-$y$-intercept yetangenti yi-$f({a})-{a}f'({a})=(1-n)\cdot{ccp}\cdot{a}^n$. Ixabiso eliphelele leli xabiso liyanda njengoko u-$n$ ekhula, ngoko linani elinye kuphela $n$ elinexabiso le-${V}$, $n={ans}$.

ca1_prodAbstract.prompt: Kwimisebenzi emibini onokwahlulwa $f(x)$, $g(x)$, $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, $g({a})={u}$, $g'({a})={w}$. Xa $h(x)={hx}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$h'({a})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Umgaqo wemveliso: $\{f(x)g(x)\}'=f'(x)g(x)+f(x)g'(x)$.
Ukuba imveliso inemisebenzi emithathu okanye ngaphezulu, yahlula omnye ngexesha uze udibanise amagama.

ca1_returnTime.prompt: Iqhosha P elihamba kumgca wamanani liqala kwisiseko ngexesha $t=0$, kwaye isantya ngexesha $t$ ($t\ge0$) yi-$v(t)={v}$. Yeyiphi isantya seqhosha P ngexesha apho libuya khona okokuqala kwisiseko emva kokuqala? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Indawo yi-indefinite integral yesantya, kwaye kuba indawo yokuqala ingu-$0$, $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds$.
Fumana elona xabiso lincinci elilungileyo le-$t$ elenza $x(t)=0$ uze uyifake kwi-$v(t)$.
ca1_returnTime.explanation: $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds={xt}$ kwaye amaxabiso alungileyo e-$t$ apho $x(t)=0$ yi-${rs}$. Kwixabiso elincinci $t={t0}$, $v({t0})={ans}$.

ca1_rootCountK.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ ezenza ukuba i-equation $f(x)=k$ ibe nezimvo zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ezingqo-${nr}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Cinga ngenani lamanqaku okudibana kwegrafu ye-$y=f(x)$ nomgca othe tye $y=k$.
Fumana ixabiso eliphezulu nelona liphantsi lengingqi, uze umisele ukuba kwiluphi uluhlu lwe-$k$ apho amanqaku okudibana angu-${nr}$.
ca1_rootCountK.explanation: Ukufumana amaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi ngo-$f'(x)=0$ kunika ${ext}$. Ukuze kubekho izimvo zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ezingu-${nr}$, kufuneka ${rng}$, ngoko iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ zingu-${ans}$.

ca1_tangentFromPoint.prompt: Yimalini imveliso yeemithambeko zeetangenti ezimbini ezityhilwe kwindawo $({p},{q})$ ukuya kwikhaphu $y={f}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba i-$x$ yendawo yokuchukumisa ngu-$t$, itangenti yi-$y=f'(t)(x-t)+f(t)$, kwaye lo mgca kufuneka ube ne-$y={q}$ xa $x={p}$.
Kule meko ufumana i-quadratic equation ye-$t$, ufumane izimvo ezibini, uze ubale umthambeko $f'(t)$.
ca1_tangentFromPoint.explanation: Ukuba i-$x$ yendawo yokuchukumisa ngu-$t$, kwimeko apho itangenti inayo $y={q}$ xa $x={p}$ kufumaneka i-quadratic equation kwaye izimvo zi-$t={t1}, {t2}$. Imithambeko yi-$f'({t1})$ kunye ne-$f'({t2})$, kwaye imveliso yazo yi-${ans}$.

ca1_tangentIntercept.prompt: Kwindawo ekwikhaphu $y={f}$ enombolo ye-$x$ ethi ${a}$, i-$y$ yendawo apho itangenti ihlangana ne-axis ye-$y$ yintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Umthambeko wetangenti yi-derivative $f'({a})$ kwindawo yokuchukumisa.
Kwi-equation yetangenti $y-f({a})=f'({a})\{x-({a})\}$, fumana ixabiso le-$y$ xa $x=0$.

ca1_tangentIntersect.prompt: Itangenti kwindawo ekwikhaphu $y={f}$ enombolo ye-$x$ ethi ${a}$ ihlangana nekhaphu kwakhona kwenye indawo engeyiyo indawo yokuchukumisa. I-$y$ yaloo ndawo yintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: I-$x$ yamanqaku okudibana kwetangenti nekhaphu yizimvo ze-(i-equation yekhaphu)−(i-equation yetangenti)$=0$, kwaye le equation inesimvo esiphindiweyo xa $x={a}$.
Isixa sezimvo ezintathu ze-cubic equation sinokwaziwa ngo-coefficient ye-$x^2$, ngoko fumana esinye isimvo uze ucalule kwi-equation yekhaphu.
ca1_tangentIntersect.explanation: (Ikhaphu)−(itangenti)$=0$ yi-cubic equation enesimvo esiphindiweyo xa $x={a}$, kwaye isixa sezimvo ezintathu sigqitywa ngobudlelwane phakathi kwezimvo ne-coefficients. Esinye isimvo si-$x={s}$, kwaye ukucalula kwi-equation yekhaphu kunika i-$y$ ye-${ans}$.

ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.prompt: Kukho imigca emibini echukumisa ikhaphu $y={f}$ enomthambeko ongu-${m}$. Sisixa sini se-$y$-intercept zale migca mibini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Xa umthambeko u-${m}$, i-$x$ yendawo yokuchukumisa isisombululo se-$f'(x)={m}$.
Kwindawo nganye yokuchukumisa $(s, f(s))$, i-$y$-intercept yi-$f(s)-s\cdot{m}$.
ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.explanation: Ukusombulula i-equation $f'(x)={m}$ kunika i-$x$ zeendawo zokuchukumisa ${s1}$, ${s2}$. Ukufumana i-$y$-intercept yetangenti nganye uze uzidibanise kunika ${ans}$.

ca1_throwImpact.prompt: Ibhola yaphoswa phezulu isuka kumgama ophakamileyo we-${h0}$ m ukusuka emhlabeni, kwaye emva kwemizuzwana engu-$t$ ukuphakama kwebhola kwakungu-$h(t)={h}$ (m). Ukukhawuleza kwebhola ngomzuzu wokuwela emhlabeni kungaphi ngee-m/s? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Umzuzu wokuchukumisa umhlaba yixabiso lika-$t$ elilungileyo apho $h(t)=0$. Isantya yi-$h'(t)$.
Sombulula $h(t)=0$ ukufumana isimvo esilungileyo, uze ubale ixabiso elipheleleyo lesantya ngelo xesha.
ca1_throwImpact.explanation: Isimvo esilungileyo se-$h(t)=0$ yi-$t={T}$ imizuzwana kwaye $h'(t)={v0}-10t$, ngoko $h'({T})={vv}$. Ukukhawuleza lixabiso elipheleleyo lesantya, ngoko li-${ans}$ m/s.

ca1_totalDistPos.prompt: Indawo yenqaku P elihamba kumgca wamanani ngexesha $t$ ($t\ge0$) yi-$x(t)={f}$. Yimalini umgama ohanjwe yinqaku P ukusuka ngexesha $t=0$ ukuya ku-$t={T}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Umgama ohanjiweyo awusiso utshintsho lwendawo, kodwa isixa semigama kwisithuba ngasinye emva kokwahlula ngexesha apho isalathiso sitshintsha.
Qala uqinisekise ukuba amaxesha apho $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ ayaqala ngaphakathi kwesithuba $(0,{T})$.
ca1_totalDistPos.explanation: Ukufumana amaxesha apho $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ kunika amaxesha apho isalathiso sitshintsha esithubeni, ${turns}$. Ukwahlula isithuba kula maxesha kunye nokudibanisa amaxabiso apheleleyo otshintsho lwendawo kunika umgama ohanjiweyo ${ans}$.

ca1_totalDistVel.prompt: Isantya seqhosha P elihamba kumgca wamanani ngexesha $t$ ($t\ge0$) yi-$v(t)={v}$. Umgama ohanjwe liqhosha P ukusuka ngexesha $t=0$ ukuya ku-$t={T}$ yimalini? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Umgama ohanjiweyo lixabiso le-integral yesantya $|v(t)|$.
Yahlula isithuba kumaxesha apho $v(t)=0$ uze udibanise ngokuhambelana nophawu.
ca1_totalDistVel.explanation: Ixesha apho uphawu lwesantya lutshintsha ngaphakathi kwesithuba yi-${zs}$. Ukwahlula isithuba kula maxesha, uphawu luzinzile kwinxalenye nganye, ngoko ukudibanisa amaxabiso apheleleyo e-$\int v(t)\,dt$ kunika ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_twoRootsK.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, yisixa sini samaxabiso onke enombolo yokwenyani $k$ eyenza ukuba i-equation $f(x)=k$ ibe nezimvo zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ezingqo-${nr}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Cinga ngomda apho inani lezimvo zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo litshintsha khona, oko kukuthi xa umgca othe tye $y=k$ uchukumisa igrafu kwiqhosha eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi.
Phakathi kwamaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi kwimeko yokuchukumisa, jonga ngoyilo lwegrafu ukuba lelo lenza izimvo zibe zingqo-${nr}$.
ca1_twoRootsK.explanation: Amaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi yi-${ext}$. Ngokujonga inani lamanqaku okudibana xa umgca othe tye uchukumisa igrafu kwiqhosha naxa ungachukumisi, $k$ efanelekileyo yi-${kk}$, kwaye isixa sazo si-${ans}$.

ca1_velZeroAccel.prompt: Xa indawo yeqhosha P elihamba kumgca wamanani ngexesha $t$ ($t\ge0$) yi-$x(t)={f}$, kwamaxesha amabini apho isantya seqhosha P siba ngu-$0$, lingakanani ukukhawuleza ngexesha lamva? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Isantya yi-derivative yendawo ngokwe-$t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, kwaye ukukhawuleza yi-derivative yesantya, $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Fumana izimvo ezimbini ze-$v(t)=0$, uze ufake esilandelayo kwi-$a(t)$.
ca1_velZeroAccel.explanation: $v(t)=x'(t)$ kwaye izimvo ezimbini ze-$v(t)=0$ zi-$t={t1}$, $t={t2}$. Ixabiso le-$a(t)=v'(t)$ ngexesha lamva $t={t2}$ li-${ans}$.

ca2_addTheorem.prompt: Xa ${ga}$, ${gb}$ kwaye ${ra}$, ${rb}$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Fumana amaxabiso eetrigonometric function eseleyo ngokusebenzisa amaxabiso anikiweyo no-$\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$. Uphawu lumiselwa yi-quadrant apho ikona ikhona.
Faka amaxabiso afunyenweyo kwithiyori yokudibanisa.

ca2_areaCurves.prompt: Xa indawo ejikelezwe yimigrafu emibini $y={f}$, $y={g}$ nemigca emibini $x={a}$, $x={b}$ ingu-$S$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Isalathiso: i-axis ye-$x$ yi-$y=0$.) (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Dibanisa umahluko wokususa i-equation yegrafu esezantsi kwi-equation yegrafu esentla kwisithuba.

Sebenzisa u-$(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ ukufumana ii-indefinite integral ze-exponential, trigonometric nemisebenzi ye-rational, kwaye sebenzisa i-substitution ukuba isimo sidibeneyo.
ca2_areaCurves.explanation: Kwisithuba $[{a},{b}]$, u-$y={f}$ ungaphezulu, ngoko $S=\int_{{a}}^{{b}}({f}-{gg})\,dx={wk}$. Ngoko ixabiso le-${ask}$ li-${res}$.

ca2_ballDistance.prompt: Ibhola yehliswa ukusuka ekuphakameni kwe-${h}$ m. Ngalo lonke ixesha xa ibhola ichukumisa umhlaba, iphinda ibuye iye kuphakamo oluphindwe ngo-${ratio}$ lokuwa kwangaphambili, ize iwe kwakhona, kwaye oku kuyaphindaphindwa ngokungapheliyo. Sisixa sini somgama ohanjwe libhola ngee-m? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Cinga ngokwahlukeneyo ngomgama wokuqala wokuwa we-${h}$ m, nomgama wokunyuka nokubuya ngasemva ngalo lonke ixesha (ngamaxesha ama-2 okunyuka).
Ubude bokunyuka benza uluhlu lwe-geometric apho ilungu lokuqala li-(ukuphakama kokuqala)×(umlinganiselo wokubuya).
ca2_ballDistance.explanation: Isixa sobude bokunyuka si-${up}$ m, kwaye umgama wokunyuka nokubuya ngamaxesha ama-2 aloo, ngoko umgama ophelele yi-${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_ballReverse.prompt: Ibhola yehliswe ukusuka ekuphakameni okuthile, kwaye ngalo lonke ixesha xa ichukumisa umhlaba, iphinda ibuye iye kuphakamo oluphindwe ngo-${ratio}$ lokuwa kwangaphambili, ize iwe kwakhona, kwaye oku kuyaphindaphindwa ngokungapheliyo. Xa ukuphakama kokubuya kwe-${nb}$ kuyi-${H}$ m, sisixa sini somgama ohanjwe libhola ngee-m? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuba ukuphakama kokuqala kuyi-$h$ m, ukuphakama kokubuya ngalo lonke ixesha kuphindwe ngo-${ratio}$ wokuwa kwangaphambili, ngoko ukuphakama kokubuya kwe-$n$ kuyi-$h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{n}$.
Qala ufumane u-$h$, uze ufumane umgama opheleleyo ngesixa somgama wokuqala wokuwa $h$ nomgama wokunyuka nokubuya (amaxesha ama-2 okunyuka).
ca2_ballReverse.explanation: Ukuba ukuphakama kokuqala kuyi-$h$ m, ${H}=h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{{nb}}$, ngoko $h={h}$. Isixa sobude bokunyuka si-${up}$ m, ngoko umgama opheleleyo yi-${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_chainTable.prompt: Kwimisebenzi emibini onokwahlulwa $f$, $g$, ${tbl}$. Xa $h(x)={hx}$, fumana ixabiso le-$h'({a})$. (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngeqhezu njenge-3/4)
hints: Jonga ukuba u-$h$ yimveliso, umlinganiselo okanye isixa esidibeneyo, uze usebenzise ifomula ye-derivative efanelekileyo.
Fumana amaxabiso omsebenzi nee-derivative ezifunekayo kwi-$x={a}$ etafileni uze uzifake. Kumsebenzi odibeneyo, ixabiso lomsebenzi wangaphakathi liba yindawo yokufaka kumsebenzi wangaphandle.

ca2_commonTangent.prompt: Iikhaphu ezimbini $y={f}$, $y={g}$ ziyadibana kwindawo ye-$x={x0}$ kwaye zinetangenti eqhelekileyo kuloo ndawo. Fumana ixabiso le-$ab$ kwiinombolo ezingatshintshiyo $a$, $b$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba iikhaphu ezimbini ziyadibana kwi-$x={x0}$, amaxabiso omsebenzi ayalingana, kwaye ukuba itangenti ifana, ii-derivative ziyalingana.
Dibanisa ii-equation ezimbini ze-$a$, $b$ ukufumana u-$a$, $b$.
ca2_commonTangent.explanation: U-$y={f}$ unexabiso lomsebenzi i-${F}$ kwi-$x={x0}$ kunye ne-derivative i-${D}$, ngoko ${wk}$. Ngoko $ab={ans}$.

ca2_derivExpLog.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, fumana ixabiso le-$f'({x0})$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane u-$f'(x)$ usebenzisa u-$(e^{x})'=e^{x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ nomgaqo we-derivative yomsebenzi odibeneyo.
Ukuba ixabiso lokufaka linesimo se-$\ln m$, sebenzisa u-$e^{\ln m}=m$.

ca2_doubleAngle.prompt: Xa ${cd}$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa u-$\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$, $\cos2\alpha=\cos^{2}\alpha-\sin^{2}\alpha$ no-$\sin^{2}\alpha+\cos^{2}\alpha=1$.

Ukuba inikwe u-$\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha$, sika macala omabini. Ukuba $\tan\alpha=t$, $\sin2\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos2\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$, kwaye ukuba $\tan\frac{\alpha}{2}=t$, $\sin\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$.

ca2_eExponent.prompt: Xa $\lim_{{to}}{ex}=e^{k}$, fumana ixabiso le-$k$. (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngeqhezu njenge-3/4)
hints: Yenza ibe sisimo se-$\lim_{h\to0}(1+h)^{\frac{1}{h}}=e$.
Wahlula uphinde uphindaphinde i-exponent ukuze i-$h$ ye-base ne-exponent zibe ngenxa yokuchasana.

ca2_expLogLimit.prompt: Fumana umda olandelayo. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Guqula intetho ukuze usebenzise $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{e^{x}-1}{x}=1$ kunye ne-$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}=1$.
Phindaphinda uze wahlule ukuze izinto ezilinganayo zibonakale kwisihlukanisi nakwisahlulwa.
ca2_expLogLimit.explanation: Ukuba uyiguqula ukuze usebenzise imida esisiseko, ${wk}$, ngoko ke umda ngu-${res}$.

ca2_extremaPair.prompt: Umsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ unexabiso eliphezulu lasekhaya elinye kuphela nexabiso eliphantsi lasekhaya elinye kuphela. Xa kukho ubuninzi ku-$x=\alpha$ kunye nobuncinci ku-$x=\beta$, fumana ixabiso le-$\alpha-\beta$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana i-$x$ apho $f'(x)=0$, uze ujonge ukuba uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ lutshintsha njani ngaphambi nasemva kwayo.
Ukuba uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ lusuka kokuncameleyo luye kokungancameleyo, kukho ubuninzi; ukuba lusuka kokungancameleyo luye kokuncameleyo, kukho ubuncinci.
ca2_extremaPair.explanation: Ekubeni $f'(x)={fp}$, kukho ubuninzi ku-$x={mx}$ nobuncinci ku-$x={mn}$. Ngoko ke $\alpha-\beta=({mx})-({mn})={ans}$.

ca2_geoConvCount.prompt: Fumana isiphumo sokudibanisa wonke amanani aphelele $x$ enza ukuba oku kulandelayo kudibane. ${obj}$ (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ulandelelwano $\{r^{n}\}$ lujikelezela xa $-1<r\le 1$, kwaye uthotho olungenasiphelo lwejiyometri $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}r^{n}$ ludibana xa $-1<r<1$.
Bhala imeko yokudibana njengokungalingani kwe-$x$, uze ufumane yonke inani eliphelele elanelisa oko kungalingani, uze uwadibanise.
ca2_geoConvCount.explanation: Kwimeko yokudibana, ${rg}$. Amanani aphelele $x$ alanelisa oku ngu-${lst}$, ngoko isiphumo sokudibanisa sibe ngu-${ans}$.

ca2_geoSeriesParam.prompt: Xa uthotho olungenasiphelo $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$ ludibana kwaye isiphumo sokudibanisa sele ${S}$, fumana ixabiso lommiselo ongatshintshiyo $r$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Isiphumo sokudibanisa sothotho olungenasiphelo lwejiyometri ngu-(igama lokuqala)÷(1-isiseko esiqhelekileyo).
Qala ufumane igama lokuqala nesiseko esiqhelekileyo kwigama jikelele lothotho.
ca2_geoSeriesParam.explanation: Ekubeni igama lokuqala lingu-${fa}$ nesiseko esiqhelekileyo singu-${ratio}$, isiphumo sokudibanisa ${sumf}={S}$. Ukusombulula oku kunika $r={res}$.

ca2_implicitDeriv.prompt: Xa $y$ ingumsebenzi we-$x$, fumana ixabiso le-${what}$ kwindawo $ {pt} $ kwijika ${eq}$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Yahlula macala omabini entetho ngokubhekisele ku-$x$, uphindaphinde amagama aqulathe i-$y$ ngo-$\frac{ dy }{ dx }$.
Faka ulungelelwaniso lwendawo kwintetho ehlukaniswe, uze usombulule ukufumana i-$\frac{ dy }{ dx }$. Ukuba kungumahluko wesibini, hlukanisa intetho ehlukaniswe kwakhona ngokubhekisele ku-$x$.
ca2_implicitDeriv.explanation: Ukuhlula macala omabini ngokubhekisele ku-$x$ nokubeka $y'=\frac{ dy }{ dx }$, ${wk}$, ngoko ke ixabiso lingu-${res}$.

ca2_integralBasic.prompt: Xa $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({fx}\right)dx$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\int e^{x}dx=e^{x}$, $\int\sin x\,dx=-\cos x$, $\int\cos x\,dx=\sin x$, $\int\frac{1}{x}dx=\ln|x|$, $\int\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}dx=\tan x$.
Qaphela ukuba $\int f(kx)\,dx=\frac{1}{k}F(kx)$, uze ufake amaxabiso omda ophezulu nophantsi uze ususe.

ca2_inverseDeriv.prompt: Ukuba umsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ unyuka kuyo yonke inani lokwenyani, kwaye umsebenzi okhanyayo wawo ngu-$g(x)$, fumana ixabiso le-$g'({b})$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane i-$a$ eyanelisa $f(a)={b}$.
Umthetho wokuhlula womsebenzi okhanyayo: $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'(a)}$.

ca2_limitPair.prompt: Kwiinombolo ezingatshintshiyo $a$, $b$, xa ${eq}$, fumana ixabiso le-$ab$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba i-limit ikho kodwa i-denominator ibe ngu-$0$ kwi-limit, i-numerator kufuneka ibe ngu-$0$ nayo. Qala ufumane ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-$a$ no-$b$ ngale meko.
Emva kokufaka loo budlelwane, yenza i-numerator ibe zizinto, susa umsantsa okanye utshintshe u-$1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$ ukufumana ixabiso le-limit, uze uyilinganise nexabiso elinikiweyo.

ca2_lineAngle.prompt: Xa ubukhulu bekona ebukhali eyenziwa yimigca emibini $ {l1} $, $ {l2} $ bungu-$\theta$, fumana ixabiso le-$\tan\theta$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ikona $\alpha$ eyenziwa ngumgca onomthambeko $m$ kunye nesalathiso esiyimfuneko se-axis ye-$x$ ifezekisa $\tan\alpha=m$. Ukuguqula i-equation ibe sisimo se-$y=mx+k$ kubonisa umthambeko.
Sebenzisa ithiyori yokudibanisa i-tangent yomahluko weekona ezimbini, kwaye kuba yikona ebukhali, thatha ixabiso eliphezulu.

ca2_monotoneParam.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezenza ukuba umsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ wande kwiseti yonke yamanani okwenyani? (Xa $f'(x)\ge 0$ kuwo onke amanani okwenyani $x$, kuthiwa uyanda.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze umsebenzi onokwahlulwa wande kuwo onke amanani okwenyani, kufuneka $f'(x)\ge0$ kuwo onke u-$x$.
Fumana uluhlu lwe-$a$ apho ixabiso elincinci le-$f'(x)$ (okanye i-discriminant) lingaphezulu okanye lilingana no-$0$, uze ubale iinombolo ezipheleleyo.
ca2_monotoneParam.explanation: ${wk}$. Ngoko iinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezifezekisa imeko zi-${lst}$, kwaye zizonke zi-${ans}$.

ca2_motionReverse.prompt: Indawo yeqhosha P elihamba kumgca wamanani ngexesha $t$ ($t>0$) yi-$x(t)={xt}$. Fumana ukukhawuleza ngexesha apho isantya seqhosha P siba ngu-$0$ okokuqala. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Isantya yi-derivative yendawo ngokwe-$t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, kwaye ukukhawuleza yi-$a(t)=v'(t)$.
Fumana elona nani lilungileyo lincinci $t$ elenza $v(t)=0$, uze ulifake kwi-$a(t)$.
ca2_motionReverse.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba ${wk}$, ukukhawuleza ngexesha apho isantya siba ngu-$0$ okokuqala yi-${res}$.

ca2_paramDeriv.prompt: Kwikhaphu $x={xt}$, $y={yt}$, xa $t={t0}$, fumana ixabiso le-${what}$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: I-derivative yomsebenzi ochazwe nge-parameter: $\frac{ dy }{ dx }=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}$.
Fumana i-second derivative ngokuchaza u-$\frac{ dy }{ dx }$ ngo-$t$, uyiphethe ngokwe-$t$, uze wahlule ngo-$\frac{ dx }{ dt }$.

ca2_partialSumSeries.prompt: Xa isixa semigaqo ukusuka kwelokuqala ukuya kwelesi-$n$ seseti $\{a_n\}$ siyi-$S_n=\frac{{sa}}{{sb}}$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, kwaye xa $n\ge 2$, $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Qala uhlule ukuba ixabiso elifunwayo lilungu okanye isixa seseriyisi. Isixa seseriyisi engapheliyo yi-limit ye-$S_n$ yesixa esithile, kwaye ilungu lifunyanwa nge-$S_n-S_{n-1}$.

ca2_partsEval.prompt: Xa $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Kwimveliso engaphakathi kwe-integral, thatha icala elilula ngokwahlula njenge-$u$, kwaye elo lilula ukudibanisa njenge-$v'$, uze wenze i-integration by parts $\int uv'dx=uv-\int u'v\,dx$.
Ukuba kuyimfuneko, yenza i-integration by parts kwakhona. Bala amaxabiso emisebenzi yetrigonometry kwiziphelo zesithuba.
ca2_partsEval.explanation: Ngokwenza i-integration by parts, ${wk}$, ngoko ixabiso le-${ask}$ li-${res}$.

ca2_partsFormula.prompt: Umsebenzi $f$ uyahlulwa, kwaye $f'$ iqhubeka. Xa ${given}$, fumana ixabiso le-${tg}$. (Ungabhala ngedesimali okanye ngomlinganiselo onje ngo-3/4)
hints: Indlela yokudibanisa ngamacandelo: $\int_{a}^{b}u\,v'\,dx=\left[uv\right]_{a}^{b}-\int_{a}^{b}u'\,v\,dx$.
Beka $f'(x)$ njenge-$v'$, kwaye uvakalelo oluphindaphindiweyo njenge-$u$.

ca2_quotientDeriv.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, fumana ixabiso le-$f'({x0})$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa umthetho wokuhlula wesiphumo $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^{2}}$.
Fumana amaxabiso e-$u$, $v$ kunye ne-$u'$, $v'$ xa $x={x0}$, uze uwafake.

ca2_riemann.prompt: Xa $L=\lim_{n\to\infty}{pre}\sum_{k=1}^{n}{body}$, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Cinga ngayo njengesiphumo semiphakamo emxande ngokwahlula umahluko ube ngamacandelo angu-$n$ alinganayo, uze utshintshe $\frac{k}{n}$ ibe $x$ ukuze ufumane isimbo sentegreyali echaziweyo.
Imida yentegreyali ichazwa yimida yexabiso le-$\frac{k}{n}$ xa $k=1$ nxa $k=n$.
ca2_riemann.explanation: Ukuguqula uthotho lube yintegreyali echaziweyo, $L={wk}$. Ngoko ke ixabiso le-${ask}$ lingu-${res}$.

ca2_rootCount.prompt: Fumana inani lemizi eyahlukeneyo yenyani yesiqinisekiso ${eq}$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Beka icala langasekhohlo libe yi-$f(x)$, uze uqwalasele inani lamanqaku okunqamlezana kwejika $y=f(x)$ nomgca othe tye $y=k$ ($k$ yinto engaguquguqukiyo yangasekunene).

Hlola ukunyuka nokwehla kwe-$f$, uqinisekise amaxabiso aphezulu naphantsi kunye namaxabiso xa $x\to\pm\infty$, uze uthelekise ukuba $k$ inxulumene njani nawo. Qikelela ixabiso le-$e$ ngokuthi $2.7<e<2.8$.
ca2_rootCount.explanation: Ekubeni ${fpx}$, ngokuhlola ukunyuka nokwehla, amaxabiso aphambili ngu-${ext}$, kwaye imida ngu-${lim}$. Ngenxa yokuba ${cm}$, amanqaku okunqamlezana kwejika $y=f(x)$ nomgca $y=k$ ngama-${ans}$, kwaye imizi yenyani ikwangama-${ans}$.

ca2_rootCountParam.prompt: Fumana inani lamanani aphelele $k$ aphumela ekubeni isiqinisekiso ${eq}$ sibe nemizi yenyani eyahlukeneyo engu-${nr}$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Beka icala langasekhohlo libe yi-$f(x)$, uze ufumane uluhlu lwe-$k$ olwenza ukuba ijika $y=f(x)$ nomgca $y=k$ zinqamlezane kumanqaku angu-${nr}$, usebenzisa ukunyuka nokwehla kunye namaxabiso aphambili egrafu.
Ukuba amaxabiso aphambili aqulathe i-$e$, yiqikelele ngokuthi $2.7<e<2.8$, uze ubale amanani aphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu.
ca2_rootCountParam.explanation: Ekubeni ${fpx}$, amaxabiso aphambili ngu-${ext}$, kwaye ukuze kubekho amanqaku okunqamlezana angu-${nr}$, kufuneka ${rg}$. Amanani aphelele $k$ kolu luhlu ngu-${lst}$, ngoko ke zi-${ans}$.

ca2_seqGeoLimit.prompt: Fumana umda walandelelwano olulandelayo. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Amandla anesiseko esinexabiso eliphelele elikhulu kakhulu kwisihlukanisi nakwisahlulwa ayinqumela umda.
Ukuba wahlula isahlulwa nesihlukanisi ngala mandla, amagama anesiseko esinexabiso eliphelele elincinci aya ku-$0$.
ca2_seqGeoLimit.explanation: Ukuba wahlula isahlulwa nesihlukanisi ngegama elinesiseko esinexabiso eliphelele elikhulu kakhulu ${dom}$, amanye amagama aya ku-$0$ kwaye kuseleyo kuphela icandelo lezinto ezibhaliweyo, okuyi-${wk}$. Ngoko ke umda ngu-${res}$.

ca2_seqLimit.prompt: Fumana umda walandelelwano olulandelayo. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Yahlula isahlulwa nesihlukanisi ngegama eliphezulu kwisihlukanisi, okanye ukuba kukho impande, yenze irasyonali kuqala.
Xa $n\to\infty$, amagama anjenge-$\frac{1}{n}$, $\frac{1}{n^{2}}$ aya ku-$0$.
ca2_seqLimit.explanation: Ukuba usenza lula intetho, ${wk}$, ngoko ke umda ngu-${res}$.

ca2_seqSumLimit.prompt: Fumana ixabiso lomda elilandelayo. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{2}=\frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{3}=\left\{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right\}^{2}$ ukubhala isixa njenge-polynomial ye-$n$.
Xa $n\to\infty$, thelekisa kuphela iikoefishenti zamagama anamandla aphezulu kwinani eliphezulu nelisezantsi.
ca2_seqSumLimit.explanation: Xa isixa sibhalwa njengentetho ye-$n$, ${wk}$, ngoko ixabiso lomda yi-${res}$.

ca2_subsTransform.prompt: Kumsebenzi oqhubekayo $f$, xa ${gv}$, fumana ixabiso le-${tg}$. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Yibeke intetho ephakathi kwe-integral njenge-$u$, uze utshintshe ithuba ne-$dx$ zibe zezika-$u$.
Jonga ukuba ithuba elitshintshiweyo lifana nelithuba le-integral enikiweyo.

ca2_substitution.prompt: Fumana ixabiso le-definite integral $\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuba intetho edibana njengeqela ngaphakathi kwe-integral (ngaphakathi kweebrakethi, kwisiqhelo, kwi-exponent, kwi-denominator, njalo njalo) ibekwa njenge-$u$, i-$du$ ihambelana nomnye umlinganiselo.
Ungalibali ukuba ithuba le-integral nalo litshintshela kwiixabiso ze-$u$ ngokuthatha indawo.

ca2_tangentLine.prompt: Fumana i-$y$-coordinate yenqaku apho i-tangent kwinqaku $ {pt} $ kwi-curve ${cv}$ idibana ne-$y$-axis. (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjengo-3/4)
hints: I-derivative kwinqaku lokuchukumisa yi-slope ye-tangent.
Faka $x=0$ kwi-equation ye-tangent $y-y_0=m(x-x_0)$.
ca2_tangentLine.explanation: Ii-coordinate zenqaku lokuchukumisa $ {pt} $, i-slope $m={sl}$, ngoko i-tangent yi-$y={tl}$, kwaye i-$y$-intercept yi-${res}$.

ca2_tangentTriangle.prompt: Fumana indawo yetriangile ebotshelelwe yi-tangent kwinqaku $ {pt} $ kwi-curve ${cv}$, ne-$x$-axis ne-$y$-axis. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane i-equation ye-tangent, uze ufumane amanqaku apho idibana khona neeaxis ezimbini (ii-intercepts).
Isiseko nobude betriangile zi-$|x\text{-intercept}|$, $|y\text{-intercept}|$.
ca2_tangentTriangle.explanation: I-tangent yi-$y={tl}$, i-$x$-intercept ${xi}$, i-$y$-intercept ${yi}$, ngoko indawo yi-$\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={res}$.

ca2_telescope.prompt: Fumana isixa se-infinite series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ii-factor ze-denominator zilandelelana ngomsantsa ofanayo. Zama ukuhlula ngeqhezu elingeyonxalenye.

$\frac{1}{A(A+d)}=\frac{1}{d}\left(\frac{1}{A}-\frac{1}{A+d}\right)$, kwaye ukuba kukho ii-factor ezintathu, $\frac{1}{A(A+1)(A+2)}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{A(A+1)}-\frac{1}{(A+1)(A+2)}\right)$. Khangela amagama asalayo emva kokurhoxisa kwisixa esinxalenye.
ca2_telescope.explanation: Ukuhlula ngamaqhezu angeyonxalenye nokufumana isixa esinxalenye, emva kokurhoxisa ${wk}$, ngoko isixa yi-${res}$.

ca2_trigDeriv.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, fumana ixabiso le-$f'({x0})$. (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjengo-3/4)
hints: Fumana i-$f'(x)$ usebenzisa $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$, $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$, kunye nemithetho yemveliso, yequotient, neyomsebenzi obhaliweyo.
Faka $x={x0}$ kwi-$f'(x)$ efunyenweyo uze ubale ixabiso lomsebenzi we-trigonometry.

ca2_trigLimit.prompt: Fumana ixabiso lomda elilandelayo. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1$, $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\tan x}{x}=1$ kunye ne-$1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$.
Kumda onge-$x\to c$, beka $t=x-c$ uze utshintshele ku-$t\to0$. Ukuba $x\to\infty$, zama ukubeka $h=\frac{1}{x}$.
ca2_trigLimit.explanation: Emva kokuguqula ukuze kusetyenziswe imida esisiseko, ${wk}$, ngoko ixabiso lomda yi-${res}$.

ca2_trigLimitUnknown.prompt: Fumana ixabiso le-positive integer $a$ eyenza ukulingana ${eq}$ kuyinyani. (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Bhala ixabiso lomda xa $x\to0$ ngo-$a$.
Beka intetho efunyenweyo ilingane nexabiso elinikiweyo uze usombulule ngo-$a$. Imeko yokuba $a$ yi-positive integer iyayiqinisekisa.
ca2_trigLimitUnknown.explanation: Ixabiso lomda yi-${wk}$ kwaye lilingana nexabiso elinikiweyo. I-positive integer eyanelisa oku yi-$a={ans}$, kwaye ngokufaka kuyinyani ngokuthi ${chk}$.

ca2_velocityIntegral.prompt: Isantya senqaku P ehamba kumgca wenombolo ngexesha $t$ ($t\ge0$) yi-$v(t)={vt}$. Fumana umgama ohanjwe yinqaku P ukusuka kwixesha $t=0$ ukuya ku-$t={T}$. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Umgama ohanjiweyo yi-integral yesantya $|v(t)|$, oko kukuthi $\int_{0}^{T}|v(t)|\,dt$.
Fumana amaxesha apho uphawu lwesantya lutshintsha, wahlule ithuba, uze umisele uphawu lwe-$|v(t)|$ kwithuba ngalinye ngaphambi kokudibanisa.

ca2_volumeRotate.prompt: Ngokuthi $V$ ibe yivolyum yesiqinileyo sokujikeleza esenziwa ngokujikeleza ingxenye ebotshelelwe ziigrafu ezimbini $y={f}$, $y={g}$ nemigca emibini $x={a}$, $x={b}$ ejikeleze i-$x$-axis, fumana ixabiso le-${ask}$. (Qaphela: i-$x$-axis yi-$y=0$.) (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ivolyum yesiqinileyo sokujikeleza yi-$V=\pi\int_{\alpha}^{\beta}\{(\text{outer radius})^{2}-(\text{inner radius})^{2}\}\,dx$.
Beka igrafu engaphezulu njengerediyasi yangaphandle, kwaye igrafu engaphantsi njengerediyasi yangaphakathi. $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ kwaye $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos 2x}{2}$.

cm1_absIneqCount.prompt: Phakathi kwezisombululo zokungalingani ${expr}$, zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: $|A|<c$ kuthetha okufanayo ne-$-c<A<c$ ($c>0$, kwaye kunjalo nakwi-$\le$).
Qokelela intetho enophawu lexabiso elipheleleyo ngecala elinye uze uyibeke kwifom $|A|<c$, uze ususe uphawu lexabiso elipheleleyo.
cm1_absIneqCount.explanation: Emva kokulungisa, ${norm}$, oko kukuthi ${chain}$, ngoko ${sol}$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ ezenelisa oku ziyi-${ints}$, zonke zi-${ans}$.

cm1_absIneqRep.prompt: Xa isisombululo sokungalingani $|{mx}-a|{op}c$ yi-${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, ixabiso le-$a+c$ lithini kwii-constants $a$, $c$? (Kodwa, $c>0$) (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: $|A|{op}c$ kuthetha okufanayo ne-$-c{op}A{op}c$.
Emva kokutshintshela ku-$a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$, thelekisa iziphelo zombini zoluhlu lwe-$x$ nesisombululo esinikiweyo, ukwenza i-linear equation system ngo-$a$, $c$.
cm1_absIneqRep.explanation: Ukusuka ku-$-c{op}{mx}-a{op}c$, $a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$ kwaye isisombululo yi-${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, ngoko $a-c={mlo}$, $a+c={mhi}$. Ngoko $a={a}$, $c={c}$ kwaye $a+c={ans}$.

cm1_coloring.prompt: Kukho imimandla engu-${n}$ enamanani ${regs}$. Yimimandla kuphela yezibini ezilandelayo ebamba omnye komnye: ${edges}$. Imimandla emibini ebambeneyo ifuna ukufakwa imibala eyahlukileyo. Zikhona iindidi ezingu-${k}$ zemibala, kwaye umbala ofanayo unokusetyenziswa kwimimandla emininzi, kwaye omnye umbala ungasetyenziswa. Zingaphi iindlela zokufaka umbala kuyo yonke imimandla? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Misela ulandelelwano lokufaka umbala, uze xa ufaka umandla ngamnye ubale inani lemibala ngaphandle kweyo isetyenzisiweyo kwimimandla ebamelene ekhe yafakwa umbala.
Ukuba inani lemibala enokusetyenziswa litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni imimandla ebamelene eyafakwa kuqala inombala ofanayo okanye owahlukileyo, yahlula iimeko uze usebenzise umgaqo wesixa.
cm1_coloring.explanation: Xa ufaka umbala ngolandelelwano, ukubala inani lemibala enokusetyenziswa ngomgaqo wemveliso nowesixa kunika ${work}={ans}$ iindlela.

cm1_combCommittee.prompt: Kwabafundi abangamakhwenkwe abangu-${m}$ nabafundikazi abangu-${w}$ kufuneka kukhethwe amalungu ekomiti angu-${r}$. Umfundi omnye othile oyinkwenkwe kufuneka akhethwe, umfundikazi omnye othile akakhethwa, kwaye kufuneka abafundikazi ubuncinane abangu-${a}$ bakhethwe. Zingaphi iindlela zokukhetha? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba umntu omnye okhethwa ngokuqinisekileyo nomnye ongakhethwa bamiselwe kuqala, kuba ngumbuzo wokukhetha inani eliseleyo kwabanye.
Yahlula ngeemeko apho inani labafundikazi li-${a}$, ${a}+1$, $\ldots$, uze udibanise (iindlela zokukhetha abafundikazi)$\times$(iindlela zokukhetha amakhwenkwe).
cm1_combCommittee.explanation: Kuba inkwenkwe enye sele ikhethiwe kwaye umfundikazi omnye ukhutshiwe, phakathi kwamakhwenkwe angu-${m1}$ nabafundikazi abangu-${w1}$ kufuneka kukhethwe abangu-${r1}$ ngaphezulu, kodwa ubuncinane abafundikazi abangu-${a}$. ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_complexCond.prompt: Kwinombolo entsonkothileyo $z={zs}$ kwinombolo yokwenyani $x$, lixabiso lini lika-$x$ elenza ukuba $z$ ibe yi-imaginary ecocekileyo? (Qaphela: i-imaginary ecocekileyo yinombolo entsonkothileyo enecandelo lokwenyani elilingana no-$0$ kunye necandelo le-imaginary elingalingani no-$0$.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Misela $z$ ibe sisimo (icandelo lokwenyani)$+$(icandelo le-imaginary)$i$. $i^2=-1$.
Emva kokufumana u-$x$ owenza ukuba icandelo lokwenyani libe ngu-$0$, qinisekisa ukuba kwelo xabiso icandelo le-imaginary alilingani no-$0$.
cm1_complexCond.explanation: Icandelo lokwenyani lika-$z$ yi-${re}$, kwaye icandelo le-imaginary yi-${im}$. Icandelo lokwenyani kufuneka libe ngu-$0$, ngoko ${roots}$. Ngoko ixabiso lecandelo le-imaginary yi-${chk}$, ngoko ukuba yi-imaginary ecocekileyo kuxhomekeke ku-$x={ans}$.

cm1_cubicOneReal.prompt: Kwi-equation ${eq}=0$, ukuba isixa sezimvo zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ngu-$S$, kwaye imveliso yazo zonke izimvo ezintsonkothileyo ezahlukeneyo ngu-$T$, lixabiso lini lika-$S+T$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kwi-equation enee-coefficient ezipheleleyo apho i-coefficient yelona gama liphezulu ngu-$1$, izimvo ezipheleleyo ziphakathi kwabahluli beqela elingatshintshiyo. Qinisekisa ngethiyori yefaktha.
Fumana isimvo esinye uze wahlule ngendlela ye-synthetic division, ukuze kusale intetho yomgangatho ophantsi. Qinisekisa ngediscriminant yequadratic eseleyo ukuba izimvo zintsonkothile.
cm1_cubicOneReal.explanation: Ngokufactor, ${eq}={fac}$. I-discriminant ye-quadratic ${quad}$ yi-$D={D}<0$, ngoko inezimvo ezimbini ezintsonkothileyo kwaye imveliso yazo yi-$T={q}$, kwaye isixa sezimvo zokwenyani yi-$S={S}$. Ngoko $S+T={ans}$.

cm1_discrimCount.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ kwi-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ ezenza zombini izimvo ze-quadratic equation ${eq}=0$ zibe zintsonkothileyo? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuze i-quadratic equation ibe nezimvo ezintsonkothileyo, i-discriminant kufuneka ibe $D<0$.
Ukuba i-coefficient ye-$x$ yinani elilinganayo, lula ukusebenzisa $\frac{D}{4}=\left(\frac{b}{2}\right)^2-ac$. Sombulula le ntetho njengenxaki ye-$k$.
cm1_discrimCount.explanation: Kufuneka $\frac{D}{4}={d4}<0$, ngokuyisombulula kuba ${kr}$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ ezifezekisa oku zi-${ks}$, ngoko zingaphakathi kwe-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ zizonke zi-${ans}$.

cm1_divisorCount.prompt: Phakathi kwabahluli abalungileyo benani lendalo $N={fac}$, mangaphi aziphindaphindo ze-${m}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Abahluli aziphindaphindo ze-${m}$ banokubhalwa ngesimo se-${m}\times t$. Cinga ukuba $t$ unokuba ngamanani athini.
Abahluli abanjalo bayi-${m}\times t$, kwaye $t$ ngumahluli we-$\frac{N}{{m}}$.
cm1_divisorCount.explanation: Abahluli aziphindaphindo ze-${m}$ bayi-${m}\times t$ ngesimo, kwaye $t$ ngumahluli we-$\frac{N}{{m}}={Nm}$. Inani labahluli abo li-${prod}={ans}$.

cm1_factorEval.prompt: Ngokusebenzisa ukwahlula ibe zizinto, ixabiso le-${expr}$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Thatha inani elikhulu njengonobumba $N$, wahlule i-numerator ibe zizinto, uze unciphise nge-denominator.
Umzekelo, $N^3-1=(N-1)(N^2+N+1)$, $N^4+N^2+1=(N^2+N+1)(N^2-N+1)$, $N^4-1=(N^2+1)(N^2-1)$, intetho efana ne-denominator ivela njengento ye-numerator.
cm1_factorEval.explanation: Xa $N={N}$, ukwahlula i-numerator ibe zizinto kunika ${fac}$, kwaye ukunciphisa nge-denominator kunika ${simp}$. Ngoko ixabiso li-${ans}$.

cm1_gridPaths.prompt: Kwi-coordinate plane, phakathi kweendlela ezimfutshane ukusuka kwiqhosha $(0,0)$ ukuya kwiqhosha $({a},{b})$ ngokuhamba nge-$+1$ ngexesha elinye kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ okanye le-axis ye-$y$, zingaphi iindlela ezidlula kwindawo A$({p},{q})$ kodwa ezingadluli kwindawo B$({u},{v})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Inani leendlela ezimfutshane ukusuka ku-$(0,0)$ ukuya ku-$(m,n)$ linani lokumisela ulandelelwano lokuya ngasekunene amaxesha angu-$m$ nokuya phezulu amaxesha angu-$n$, ${}_{m+n}\mathrm{C}_{m}$.
Kwiindlela 'ezidlulayo', phindaphinda amanani eendlela zecandelo ngalinye; kwezo 'ezingadluli', susa iindlela ezidlula nakwindawo B kuzo zonke iindlela ezidlula kwindawo A.
cm1_gridPaths.explanation: Iindlela ezidlula kwindawo A zi-${t1}$. Phakathi kwazo, ezidlula nakwindawo B zi-${t2}$. Ngoko inani leendlela elifunwayo li-${ans}$.

cm1_iPower.prompt: Xa $z={z}$, sisixa sini secandelo lokwenyani necandelo le-imaginary le-${expr}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Amandla e-$i$ aphindaphindeka ngolu ludwe: $i,\ -1,\ -i,\ 1$. Ukuba $z$ unesimo esintsonkothileyo, qala ululalise libe sisimo se-$a+bi$.
Kuba $z^4=1$, amandla e-$z$ aphindaphindeka ngamaxabiso afanayo emva kwama-$4$ ngamnye. Jonga kuphela intsalela yesikhululi emva kokwahlula nge-$4$.
cm1_iPower.explanation: Qala ululalise, $z={zs}$ kwaye $z^4=1$. Ngokutshintsha isikhululi sibe yintsalela emva kokwahlula nge-$4$, ${work}$. Ngoko isixa secandelo lokwenyani necandelo le-imaginary si-${ans}$.

cm1_iPowerSum.prompt: Xa $z={z}$, sisixa sini secandelo lokwenyani necandelo le-imaginary le-${expr}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ululalise u-$z$ abe sisimo se-$a+bi$, uze uqinisekise ukuba $z^4=1$. Ngoko unokwazi ixabiso lesixa samandla amane alandelelanayo $z+z^2+z^3+z^4$.
Ukudibanisa amagama amane ngamane, isixa seqela ngalinye siyafana. Amagama aseleyo ekupheleni ngala ayintsalela yenani lamagama emva kokwahlula nge-$4$.
cm1_iPowerSum.explanation: Qala ululalise, $z={zs}$, ngoko $z^4=1$ kwaye $z+z^2+z^3+z^4=0$. Ngokudibanisa amagama amane ngamane, isixa seqela ngalinye si-$0$, kwaye kuba ${n}={q4}\times4+{rm}$, amagama aseleyo yala ali-${rm}$ okuqala kuphela, ngoko ${work}$. Ngoko isixa secandelo lokwenyani necandelo le-imaginary si-${ans}$.

cm1_identity.prompt: Kwi-identity ${lhs}={rhs}$ ye-$x$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${ask}$ kwiinombolo ezingatshintshiyo ${consts}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: I-identity yi-equation ebamba nokuba ufaka ixabiso elithile lika-$x$. Ungandisa icala lasekhohlo uthelekise ii-coefficient zamandla afanayo.
Xa $x={p}$ intetho engaphakathi kwebhrakethi iba ngu-$0$. Ukufaka eli xabiso kunika ixabiso lenombolo engatshintshiyo ngokuthe ngqo.
cm1_identity.explanation: Ngokuthelekisa ii-coefficient okanye ngokufaka ixabiso elifanelekileyo lika-$x$, ${sol}$. Ngoko ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_linIneqCount.prompt: Phakathi kwesisombululo seenxaki ezidityanisiweyo ${i1}$, ${i2}$, zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Sombulula inxaki nganye ngokwahlukeneyo ukufumana uluhlu lwe-$x$, uze ufumane inxalenye eqhelekileyo. Ukuphindaphinda okanye ukwahlula macala omabini ngenani elingalunganga kujika uphawu lwenxaki.
Zoba ulu hlu lubini kumgca wamanani uze ubale iinombolo ezipheleleyo kwinxalenye ehlangeneyo. Qaphela ukuba kukho uphawu lokulingana na.
cm1_linIneqCount.explanation: Isisombululo senxaki yokuqala si-${s1}$, esenxaki yesibini si-${s2}$, ngoko uluhlu oluqhelekileyo li-${s}$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ ezifezekisa oku zi-${ints}$, zizonke zi-${ans}$.

cm1_linIneqParam.prompt: Kwisisombululo seenxaki ezidityanisiweyo ${i1}$, ${i2}$, ukuba iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ zingqo-${n}$, sisixa sini sawo onke amaxabiso enombolo epheleleyo $k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala usombulule inxaki engenayo $k$ ukuze ufumane uluhlu lwe-$x$, uze uchaze uluhlu lwe-$x$ lwenye inxaki ngo-$k$.
Ukuze kubekho iinombolo ezipheleleyo ezingqo-${n}$ kwisithuba apho uluhlu oluthe lwahlangana, cinga ukuba isiphelo sesithuba kufuneka sibe phakathi kweziphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo.
cm1_linIneqParam.explanation: Isisombululo senxaki yokuqala yi-${s1}$, esenxaki yesibini yi-${s2}$. Ukuze iinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ zibe ngqo-${n}$, kufuneka ${kr}$, ngoko iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ zi-${ks}$ kwaye isixa sazo si-${ans}$.

cm1_matCayley.prompt: Kwiimatriki $A={A}$, $E={Emat}$, kukho amanani okwenyani $p$, $q$ afezekisa $A^{{n}}=pA+qE$. Lingakanani ixabiso le-${ask}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Bala $A^{{n}}$ ngokuthe ngqo ngokuphindaphinda iimatriki ukuze ufumane amalungu.
Ukuchaza amalungu e-$pA+qE$ ngo-$p$, $q$ nokuwathelekisa namalungu e-$A^{{n}}$ kunika iseti ye-equations ye-$p$, $q$.

cm1_matWord.prompt: Evenkileni ezimbini A, B kuthengiswa iintlobo ezingu-${ni}$ zezinto. Ilungu (i, j) lematriki $P={mp}$ lixabiso (ngerhando) lento enye yoku-j evenkileni i (umqolo 1: ivenkile A, umqolo 2: ivenkile B), kwaye ilungu (j, l) lematriki $Q={mq}$ linani lezinto zoku-j ezifunwa ngumntu l phakathi kuka-Gap (ikholamu 1) no-Eul (ikholamu 2). U-Gap no-Eul bathenga zonke izinto ezifunekayo evenkileni enye, kwaye bobabini bakhetha ivenkile enexabiso eliphantsi. Isixa semali abayibhatalayo bobabini yimalini ngerhando? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Imali ebhatalwa ngumntu l evenkileni i yisixa semveliso yamalungu omqolo i we-$P$ nekholamu l ye-$Q$ aphindaphindwe ngokulandelelana.
La maxabiso ayamalungu ematriki $PQ$. Emva kokufumana i-$PQ$, khetha ixabiso elincinci kwikholamu nganye uze uwadibanise.
cm1_matWord.explanation: $PQ={pq}$. U-Gap ubhatala i-${pq11}$ rhando evenkileni A, i-${pq21}$ rhando evenkileni B, ngoko ixabiso eliphantsi yi-${m1}$ rhando, kwaye u-Eul ubhatala i-${pq12}$ rhando evenkileni A, i-${pq22}$ rhando evenkileni B, ngoko ixabiso eliphantsi yi-${m2}$ rhando. Ngoko isixa si-${ans}$ rhando.

cm1_omega.prompt: Xa isimvo esinye esintsonkothileyo se-quadratic equation ${eq}$ singu-$\omega$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${expr}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuphindaphinda macala omabini e-equation nge-$x-1$ okanye i-$x+1$ kuyakubonisa ixabiso le-$\omega^3$.
Ukuba $\omega^3=\pm1$, ngoko $\omega^6=1$. Jonga kuphela intsalela yesikhululi ngokwesangqa.
cm1_omega.explanation: Kuba $\omega$ sisimvo se-${eq}$, ${rel}$. Ngoko amandla abuya kwixabiso elifanayo emva kwe-${per}$ ngamnye, kwaye ukuba ucinga kuphela intsalela yesikhululi emva kokwahlula nge-${per}$, ${step}$. Ngoko ixabiso elifunwayo li-${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLine.prompt: Xa le parabola nomgca zichukumisa, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo engatshintshiyo $k$? (iparabola $y={f}$, umgca $y={g}$) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuchukumisa kuthetha ukuba i-quadratic equation evela ekudibaniseni ii-equation ezimbini inesimvo esiphindiweyo.
Yenza ukuba i-discriminant ye-quadratic equation emva kokususa u-$y$ ibe ngu-$0$.
cm1_parabolaLine.explanation: Ukusuka ku-${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, kwaye kuba zichukumisa, i-discriminant $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)=0$. Ukuyisombulula kunika $k={ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLineCount.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ kwi-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ ezenza ukuba le parabola nomgca zingadibani? (iparabola $y={f}$, umgca $y={g}$) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukungadibani kwemigca emibini kuthetha ukuba i-quadratic equation evela ekudibaniseni ii-equation ezimbini ayinazo izimvo zokwenyani.
Fumana uluhlu lwe-$k$ apho i-discriminant ye-quadratic equation emva kokususa u-$y$ ingu-$D<0$, uze ubale iinombolo ezipheleleyo ngaphakathi.
cm1_parabolaLineCount.explanation: Ukusuka ku-${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, kwaye ukuze zingadibani, i-discriminant kufuneka ibe $D<0$. Ukusuka ku-$D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)={dk}<0$, ${kr}$, ngoko iinombolo ezipheleleyo ngaphakathi kwe-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ zi-${ks}$, zizonke zi-${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaXaxis.prompt: Ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi wesikwere $y={f}$ inqamleza i-$x$-axis kumanqaku amabini ahlukeneyo kwaye umgama phakathi kwala manqaku mabini ngu-${d}$, lithini ixabiso lommiselo ongatshintshiyo $k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ii-$x$-coordinate zamanqaku amabini okunqamlezana ziimpande ezimbini ze-equation ${f}=0$.
Ukuba iimpande ezimbini zi-$\alpha$, $\beta$, umgama phakathi kwamanqaku amabini ngu-$|\alpha-\beta|$, kwaye $(\alpha-\beta)^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-4\alpha\beta$.
cm1_parabolaXaxis.explanation: Ii-$x$-coordinate zamanqaku okunqamlezana $\alpha$, $\beta$ ziimpande ezimbini ze-${f}=0$, ngoko $\alpha+\beta={sm}$. Kwi-$(\alpha-\beta)^2=({sm})^2-4\alpha\beta={d}^2$, $\alpha\beta={ab}$, kwaye ngokobudlelwane beempande nezinto ezandulelayo $\alpha\beta=\frac{k}{{p}}$, ngoko $k={ans}$.

cm1_permArrange.prompt: Xa kumi abafana abayi-${m}$ kunye namantombazana ayi-${w}$ emgqeni, zingaphi iindlela zokubenza bame ukuze kungabikho namabini amantombazana asondeleneyo? (Bonke abafundi bangabantu abahlukeneyo.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kulula ukufaka icala elingafanele ukusondelelana (amantombazana) kamva. Qala umise abafana emgqeni.
Kukho iindawo phakathi kwabafana nakwiziphelo zombini apho amantombazana angangena khona. Khetha iindawo ezahlukeneyo kuzo ukumisa amantombazana.
cm1_permArrange.explanation: Iindlela zokuqala zokumisa abafana abayi-${m}$ zi-${m}!={mf}$. Iindlela zokukhetha iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezi-${w}$ kwii-${m1}$ phakathi kwabafana nakwiziphelo zombini ukumisa amantombazana zi-${}_{{m1}}\mathrm{P}_{{w}}={pv}$. Ngoko ${mf}\times{pv}={ans}$.

cm1_permNumbers.prompt: Kukho amakhadi angama-${nc}$ anamanani ahlukeneyo abhalwe kwikhadi ngalinye, kwaye amanani abhaliweyo ngu-${digs}$. Xa uthatha amakhadi angama-${r}$ kuwo uwacwangcise emgqeni wenza inani lendalo elinamanani angama-${r}$, zingaphi iziphindaphindi zika-${m}$? (Inani $0$ alinakubakho kwindawo yokuqala.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba linani eliphindaphindo lika-${m}$ nqunywa linani lendawo yamanani amnye. Qala ukumisela amanani anokubakho kwindawo yamanani amnye.
Emva kokumisela indawo yamanani amnye, khetha eyokuqala kumanani angengo-$0$, kwaye ugcwalise ezinye iindawo ngamakhadi aseleyo (umthetho wokuphindaphinda).
cm1_permNumbers.explanation: Amanani anokubakho kwindawo yamanani amnye ngu-${Lstr}$. Kwenye nganye, fumana (inani leendlela zokukhetha indawo yokuqala)$\times$(inani leendlela zokugcwalisa ezinye iindawo) uze udibanise, ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_polyDivQR.prompt: Kwi-polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, xa isiphumo sokwahlula $P(x)\div({dv})$ si-$Q(x)$ kwaye insalela yi-$R(x)$, lithini ixabiso le-$Q({t})+R({t})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Yahlula amagama aphezulu kakhulu ukufumana igama lokuqala lesiphumo, uphindaphinde isahluli uze unciphise, uphinde ukwenze oku.
Igama lokuqala lesiphumo li-${qlead}$, kwaye inqanaba lensalela liphantsi kunenqanaba lesahluli.

cm1_polyProdCoef.prompt: Kwii-polynomial ezimbini $A={pa}$, $B={pb}$, lithini i-coefficient ye-$x^{{k}}$ xa $AB$ iyandiswa? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Akuyomfuneko ukuyandisa yonke i-$AB$. Fumana kuphela izibini zamagama apho isiphumo siba yi-$x^{{k}}$.
Kwibini ngalinye apho isiphumo sokudibanisa samanqanaba egama le-$A$ nelegama le-$B$ singu-${k}$, phindaphinda ii-coefficient, uze udibanise onke amaxabiso.
cm1_polyProdCoef.explanation: Ukudibanisa iziphumo zokuphindaphinda ii-coefficient zamagama apho isiphumo siba yi-$x^{{k}}$, ${terms}={ans}$. (Ukuba uyandisa ngokwenene, $AB={prod}$.)

cm1_quadFence.prompt: Ngocingo olunobude be-${L}$ m, kwenziwa ucingo olumile okwengxande apho elinye icala lichukumisa udonga, kwaye kumiswa izahluli ezingu-${j}$ ezithe nkqo kudonga ukwahlula indawo. Ucingo alusetyenziswa ecaleni ledonga, kwaye izahluli zenziwa ngocingo olufanayo. Lelona xabiso likhulu lendawo yocingo lonke liyintoni ngee-$\mathrm{m}^2$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Thatha ubude becala elithe nkqo kudonga njenge-$x$ m, uze ubale ukuba zingaphi ezo cala zonke.
Chaza ubude becala elihambelana nodonga ngo-$x$, wenze indawo ibe yi-quadratic ye-$x$, uze ufumane iqhosha eliphezulu.
cm1_quadFence.explanation: Amacala athe nkqo kudonga ngama-2 asekupheleni kunye nezahluli ezingu-${j}$, zizonke zingu-${k}$, ngoko ubude becala elihambelana nodonga bu-$({L}-{k}x)$ m. Indawo $S(x)=x({L}-{k}x)$ inobuninzi kwi-$x={u}$ kwaye ixabiso elikhulu li-${ans}$ $\mathrm{m}^2$.

cm1_quadIneqAlways.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ ezenza ukuba isisombululo senxaki ${ineq}$ sibe ngamanani onke okwenyani? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuba i-coefficient ye-$x^2$ ngu-$k$, yahlula kwimeko apho $k=0$ nalapho kungenjalo. Ukuba $k\ne0$, kufuneka ivulekele phezulu kwaye i-discriminant $D<0$ (okanye $D\le0$).
Bhala i-discriminant $D$ njengentetho ye-$k$ uze usombulule inxaki. Imeko ebheka ezantsi ($k<0$) ayinakubamba kuwo onke amanani okwenyani.
cm1_quadIneqAlways.explanation: Ukuba $k=0$, icala lasekhohlo linenombolo engatshintshiyo enye kuphela ${n}$ kwaye eli xabiso likhulu kuno-$0$, ngoko inxaki ihlala ibamba. Ukuba $k\ne0$, kufuneka ivulekele phezulu, ngoko $k>0$ kwaye $\frac{D}{4}={d4}{rel}0$, kwaye ukuyisombulula kunika ${kr}$. Ngoko ngokubandakanya $k=0$, iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ zi-${ks}$, zizonke zi-${ans}$.

cm1_quadIneqSol.prompt: Xa isisombululo se-quadratic inequality ${mx2}+ax+b{op}0$ si-${sol}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${ask}$ kwiinombolo ezingatshintshiyo $a$, $b$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Amaxabiso asekupheleni kwesisombululo senxaki zizimvo ezimbini ze-quadratic equation ${mx2}+ax+b=0$.
Chaza i-quadratic njenge-(coefficient ye-$x^2$)$\times(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)$ uze uyithelekise nesimo esandisiweyo.
cm1_quadIneqSol.explanation: Kuba isisombululo si-${sol}$, izimvo ezimbini zi-${lo}$, ${hi}$, kwaye kuba i-coefficient ye-$x^2$ yi-${m}$, ${mx2}+ax+b={fac}={full}$. Ngoko $a={a}$, $b={b}$ kwaye ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_quadRange.prompt: Kumsebenzi $y={f}$, lingakanani isixa sexabiso eliphezulu nelona lincinci kwi-${m}\le x\le {n}$? (Qaphela: $x$ linani lokwenyani.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kumsebenzi we-quadratic, qala uqinisekise ukuba i-$x$ yeqhosha eliphezulu iphakathi kwesithuba esinikiweyo.
Ukuba iqhosha liphakathi kwesithuba, thelekisa amaxabiso omsebenzi kwiqhosha nakwiziphelo zombini; ukuba lingaphandle, thelekisa kwiziphelo zombini.
cm1_quadRange.explanation: Iqhosha eliphezulu lalo msebenzi li-$({h},{kv})$, kwaye amaxabiso e-$y$ kwiziphelo zesithuba yi-${fm}$ xa $x={m}$, ${fn}$ xa $x={n}$. Ngokujonga ukuba i-$x$ yeqhosha iphakathi kwesithuba ${m}\le x\le {n}$ na, nokufumana ixabiso eliphezulu nelona lincinci, isixa sazo si-${ans}$.

cm1_quadRevenue.prompt: Into enexabiso lokuqala le-${w}$ won, ukuba ithengiswa nge-${a}$ won enye, kuthengiswa ezingu-${b}$ ngosuku. Ixesha ngalinye xa ixabiso lokuthengisa linyuswa nge-${s}$ won, ukuthengisa kwemihla ngemihla kuncitshiswa ngezingu-${c}$. Ukuba ixabiso lokuthengisa linganyuswa ngamaxesha apheleleyo e-${s}$ won (kubandakanywa amaxesha angu-$0$), lelona xabiso likhulu lenzuzo yosuku liyintoni ngewon? (Inzuzo ibalwa njenge-(ixabiso lokuthengisa $-$ ixabiso lokuqala)$\times$(inani elithengisiweyo).) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Thatha inani lamaxesha okunyusa ixabiso njenge-$t$, uze uchaze ixabiso lokuthengisa nenani elithengisiweyo ngo-$t$.
(Inzuzo yento enye)$\times$(inani elithengisiweyo) yi-quadratic ye-$t$. Qinisekisa ukuba i-$t$ yeqhosha eliphezulu yinombolo epheleleyo.
cm1_quadRevenue.explanation: Ukuba inani lamaxesha okunyusa li-$t$, inzuzo yento enye yi-$({e1}+{s}t)$ won, inani elithengisiweyo li-$({b}-{c}t)$, ngoko inzuzo yi-$({e1}+{s}t)({b}-{c}t)$ won. Le quadratic inobuninzi kwi-$t={tstar}$, kwaye inzuzo ngelo xesha yi-${ans}$ won.

cm1_remQuadDiv.prompt: Kwi-polynomial $P(x)$, intsalela ye-$P(x)\div({dv1})$ yi-${r1}$ kwaye intsalela ye-$P(x)\div({dv2})$ yi-${r2}$. Ukuba intsalela ye-$P(x)\div\left(({dv1})({dv2})\right)$ yi-$R(x)$, ixabiso le-$R({c})$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Intsalela yokwahlula ngequadratic yi-expression yodidi lokuqala okanye ingaphantsi. Beka $R(x)=px+q$.
Kwi-$P(x)=({dv1})({dv2})Q(x)+R(x)$, faka amaxabiso amabini enza isahluli sibe $0$.
cm1_remQuadDiv.explanation: Ukuba $R(x)=px+q$, ke $R({a})=P({a})={r1}$, $R({b})=P({b})={r2}$. Ukusombulula ezi equations zimbini kunika $p={p}$, $q={q}$, ngoko $R(x)={Rx}$ kwaye $R({c})={ans}$.

cm1_remUnknown.prompt: Kwi-polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, intsalela ye-$P(x)\div({dv})$ yi-${R}$. Ixabiso lekhonstanti $k$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Remainder theorem: intsalela xa i-polynomial $P(x)$ yahlulwa ngo-$x-a$ ilingana no-$P(a)$.
Ixabiso lika-$x$ eliyenza isahluli sibe $0$ ngu: $x={t}$. Ukufaka eli xabiso kuna-$P(x)$ kunika i-linear equation ka-$k$.
cm1_remUnknown.explanation: Ngokwe-remainder theorem, kufuneka $P({t})={R}$. Ekubeni $P({t})={lhs}$, ngoko ukusuka ku-${lhs}={R}$ sifumana $k={ans}$.

cm1_rootSignCond.prompt: Kwi-quadratic equation ${eq}=0$, linani elincinane eliphelele $k$ elenza zombini iingcambu zokwenyani ezahlukileyo zibe zinkulu kuno-${t}$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba icala lasekhohlo yi-$f(x)$, igrafu ye-$y=f(x)$ idibana ne-$x$ axis kwiindawo ezimbini ezahlukileyo, zombini ngasekunene ko-$x={t}$.
Hlola zozithathu iimeko: i-discriminant $D>0$, indawo ye-axis (axis $x>{t}$), kunye no-$f({t})>0$.
cm1_rootSignCond.explanation: Ukuze iingcambu zombini zibe zinkulu kuno-${t}$ kwi-$f(x)={eq}$, kufuneka kuzaliseke zozithathu iimeko: (i) $\frac{D}{4}={d4}>0$, (ii) axis $x=k$ ngoko $k>{t}$, (iii) $f({t})={ft}>0$. Inani elincinane eliphelele $k$ eliyanelisayo ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricEval.prompt: Kwiinombolo zokwenyani $x$, $y$ xa ${cond}$, ixabiso le-${expr}$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Bonisa i-expression efunwayo ngokwesibalo $x+y$ nemveliso $xy$. Umzekelo $x^2+y^2=(x+y)^2-2xy$.
Kwi-cube sebenzisa $x^3+y^3=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)$, kwi-fourth power fumana kuqala $x^2+y^2$ emva koko usebenzise $x^4+y^4=(x^2+y^2)^2-2(xy)^2$.
cm1_symmetricEval.explanation: Ngokuguqula iifomula zokuphindaphinda, ${expr}={work}$. (Apha $(x-y)^2=(x+y)^2-4xy={dd}\ge0$, ngoko iinombolo zokwenyani $x$, $y$ ezanelisa imeko zikhona.) Ngoko ixabiso elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricInv.prompt: Kwinombolo yokwenyani $x$, xa $x+\frac{1}{x}={k}$, ixabiso le-${expr}$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Imveliso ka-$x$ no-$\frac{1}{x}$ ngu-$1$. Ngoko ukwazi isibalo $x+\frac{1}{x}$ kuphela kwanele ukufumana isibalo samagunya.

$x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2-2$, $x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^3-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)$, kwaye eyesine ifunyanwa ngokuphinda ubeke isikwere $x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}$.
cm1_symmetricInv.explanation: Ngokuguqula iifomula zokuphindaphinda, ${expr}={work}$. (Kwinombolo yokwenyani $x$, $\left|x+\frac{1}{x}\right|\ge2$, ngoko kukho inombolo yokwenyani eyanelisa le meko.) Ngoko ixabiso elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_sysReal.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ kwi-$-{M}\le k\le {M}$ ezenza ukuba kubekho izisombululo zokwenyani $(x, y)$ zeseti ye-equation ${e1}$, ${e2}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukusebenzisa enye i-equation ukususa u-$y$ kwenza i-quadratic equation ye-$x$.
Ukuze ibe nezisombululo zokwenyani, i-discriminant yaloo quadratic equation kufuneka ibe ngaphezulu okanye ilingane no-$0$.
cm1_sysReal.explanation: Ukususa u-$y$ ngenye i-equation kwenza i-quadratic equation ye-$x$, kwaye ukuze ibe nezisombululo zokwenyani kufuneka ${dcond}$. Oko kukuthi ${kr}$, ngoko iinombolo ezipheleleyo ezingaphakathi kwe-$-{M}\le k\le {M}$ zizonke zi-${ans}$.

cm1_sysTwo.prompt: Xa amanani okwenyani $x$, $y$ ayisisombululo seseti ye-equation ${e1}$, ${e2}$, lelona xabiso likhulu lika-$x$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Yenza enye i-equation ibe zizinto okanye ubonise enye ichaphaza ngenye ukunciphisa inani lezinto ezingaziwayo.
Fumana zonke izisombululo zokwenyani ezinokubakho $(x, y)$, uze ukhethe elona xabiso likhulu lika-$x$.
cm1_sysTwo.explanation: Ukusombulula iseti ye-equation kunika $(x,\ y)={sols}$. Phakathi kwazo, elona xabiso likhulu lika-$x$ li-${ans}$.

cm1_vietaExpr.prompt: Xa izimvo ezimbini ze-quadratic equation ${eq}=0$ zingu-$\alpha$, $\beta$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${expr}$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Kwi-quadratic equation $ax^2+bx+c=0$, isixa sezimvo ezimbini si-$-\frac{b}{a}$ kwaye imveliso yi-$\frac{c}{a}$.
Chaza intetho efunwayo ngo-$\alpha+\beta$ no-$\alpha\beta$, uze ufake amaxabiso.

cm1_vietaUnknown.prompt: Masibe izimvo ezimbini ze-quadratic equation $x^2-kx{cs}=0$ zingu-$\alpha$, $\beta$. Xa ${cond}$, lingakanani ixabiso elilungileyo le-$k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ngobudlelwane phakathi kwezimvo nee-coefficient, isixa sezimvo ezimbini si-$k$ kwaye imveliso yazo yi-${c}$.
Chaza imeko enikiweyo ngo-$\alpha+\beta$, $\alpha\beta$, okanye uthathe isimvo esinye njengonobumba uchaze esinye ngenxa yaso ukufumana u-$k$.

cm2_amgmMin.prompt: Xa ${dom}$, lelona xabiso lincinci le-${ex}$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kwiinombolo ezimbini ezilungileyo $A$, $B$, $A+B\ge 2\sqrt{A\,B}$ (ukulingana xa $A=B$).

Dibanisa ukuze imveliso ibe yinombolo engatshintshiyo, usebenzise ubudlelwane be-arithmetic mean ne-geometric mean, uze uqinisekise ukuba ixabiso lika-$x$ apho kulingana kuphakathi koluhlu lemeko ${dom}$.
cm2_amgmMin.explanation: ${work}$, kwaye ukulingana kuyenzeka xa $x={xe}$, nelixabiso eliphakathi koluhlu lemeko ${dom}$. Ngoko elona xabiso lincinci li-${ans}$.

cm2_chordLength.prompt: Isangqa $C$: ${circ}$, umgca $l$: ${line}$. Ubude be-chord enqunyulwa ngu-$l$ kwi-$C$ bungakanani? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Umgca othe nkqo osuka kwiziko lesangqa ukuya kumgca uyayinqumla i-chord ibe yiziqingatha ezilinganayo. Qala ufumane umgama phakathi kweziko nomgca.
Ukuba iradiyasi ngu-$r$, umgama phakathi kweziko nomgca ngu-$d$, ubude be-chord bu-$2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}$.
cm2_chordLength.explanation: Iziko lesangqa li-$({cx}, {cy})$, iradiyasi yi-${rad}$. Umgama phakathi kweziko nomgca ngu-$d=\frac{|{la}\times({cx})+({lb})\times({cy})+({lc})|}{\sqrt{({la})^2+({lb})^2}}=\frac{{dh}}{{h}}={d}$, ngoko ubude be-chord bu-$2\sqrt{{rad}^2-{d}^2}=2\times{half}={ans}$.

cm2_circleGeneral.prompt: Umfanekiso omelwe yi-equation ${eq}$ sisangqa. Xa ulungelelwaniso lweziko laso lu-$(a, b)$ kwaye ubude beradiyasi bu-$r$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b+r$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Guqula ibe sisikwere esipheleleyo se-$x$ ne-$y$ esinesimo se-$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$.
Wahlula macala omabini nge-coefficient ye-$x^2$, $y^2$, uze ubuthe u-$x$ kunye no-$y$ kunye ukwenza izikwere ezipheleleyo.
cm2_circleGeneral.explanation: Kuba i-coefficient ye-$x^2$ yi-${kk}$, wahlula macala omabini ngale coefficient uze uguqule ube sisikwere esipheleleyo, ${std}$. Iziko li-$({cx}, {cy})$ kwaye iradiyasi yi-${rad}$, ngoko $a+b+r={cx}+({cy})+{rad}={ans}$.

cm2_circleTangentAxes.prompt: Phakathi kwamacangca anesiko kwi-quadrant yokuqala kwaye achukumisa zombini i-$x$-axis ne-$y$-axis, kukho amacangca amabini kuphela adlula kwindawo $P({p}, {q})$. Irediyasi yelona licangca likhulu phakathi kwala mabini ithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Iziko lecangca elichukumisa zombini i-axes kwi-quadrant yokuqala ngu-$(r, r)$ kwaye irediyasi ngu-$r$.
Faka ulungelelwaniso lwendawo kwi-circle $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ usombulule i-quadratic equation ka-$r$.
cm2_circleTangentAxes.explanation: I-equation yecangca ngu-$(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ($r>0$) kwaye idlula kwi-$P$, ngoko $({p}-r)^2+({q}-r)^2=r^2$, oko kukuthi $r^2-{u}r+{t}=0$. Ukuyisombulula kunika $r={rs}$ okanye $r={rl}$, ngoko irediyasi enkulu ngu-${ans}$.

cm2_compFindG.prompt: Kwimisebenzi emibini $f$, $g$, $f(x)={f}$ kwaye i-composite function $(f\circ g)(x)={comp}$, ixabiso le-$g({t})$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuba $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, beka $g(x)$ kwindawo ka-$x$ kwi-expression ye-$f$.
Ukusuka ku-$f(g(x))={comp}$ sombulula i-expression ka-$g(x)$ ukufumana $g(x)$, emva koko faka $x={t}$.

cm2_compTable.prompt: Imisebenzi emibini $f$, $g$ ukusuka kwiseti $X=\{{xset}\}$ ukuya ku-$X$ imi ngolu hlobo. $f$: ${ft}$, $g$: ${gt}$. Zingaphi izinto $x$ ze-$X$ ezanelisa $(f\circ g)(x)=(g\circ f)(x)$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$. Fumana amaxabiso omabini ngokwahlukeneyo kwi-$x$ nganye.
Yenza itheyibhile ye-$f(g(x))$ ne-$g(f(x))$ ku-$x=1, 2, \dots$ ngokulandelelana uze uthelekise.
cm2_compTable.explanation: Ukufumana i-$f(g(x))$, $g(f(x))$ ku-$x$ ngamnye kunika ${work}$. Izinto $x$ apho amaxabiso omabini alinganayo zi-${ans}$.

cm2_divPoint.prompt: Kwiindawo ezimbini $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, kukho indawo $P$ ehlula ngaphakathi isiqephu $AB$. Xa $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={m}:{n}$, isibalo se-$x$-coordinate ne-$y$-coordinate yendawo $P$ sithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ulungelelwaniso lwendawo ehlula isiqephu $AB$ ngaphakathi nge-$m:n$ ngu-$\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Fumana i-$x$-coordinate ne-$y$-coordinate ngokwahlukeneyo uze uyongeze. I-$x$-coordinate ngu-$\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}}$.
cm2_divPoint.explanation: $P\left(\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}},\ \frac{{m}\times({y2})+{n}\times({y1})}{{m}+{n}}\right)=({px}, {py})$, ngoko isibalo sezo coordinates zombini ngu-${px}+({py})={ans}$.

cm2_divRatioFind.prompt: Kwiindawo ezintathu $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, $P({px}, {py})$, indawo $P$ iyindawo esiqwini $AB$ kwaye $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=m:n$. Xa $m$, $n$ ziinombolo zendalo ezingenakwahlulwa ngomnye (coprime), ixabiso le-$m+n$ lithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $P$ ihlula $AB$ ngaphakathi nge-$m:n$, i-$x$-coordinate ngu-$\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n}$. Ngokubuyela umva, fumana umlinganiselo kuma-coordinates e-$P$.
Ngokwahlukana kwee-$x$-coordinate fumana $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=|p_x-x_1|:|x_2-p_x|$ uze ulinciphise.
cm2_divRatioFind.explanation: Ukuthelekisa ii-$x$-coordinate, $|{px}-({x1})|={u}$, $|({x2})-({px})|={w}$, ngoko $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={u}:{w}$, kwaye ngendlela ye-coprime yi-${m}:{n}$. (I-$y$-coordinate inika umlinganiselo ofanayo.) Ngoko $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_existsInterval.prompt: $U$ yiseti yazo zonke iinombolo ezipheleleyo eziphezulu okanye ezilingana no-${p}$ nangaphantsi okanye ezilingana no-${q}$. Lelona xabiso likhulu lenombolo epheleleyo $k$ eliyenza ukuba umhlathi othi 'kwilungu elithile $x$ le-$U$, ${form}$' ube yinyani liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: 'Kwi-$x$ ethile' ithetha ukuba ichanekile ukuba ikhona ubuncinane enye i-$x$ efezekisa imeko.
Guqula inxaki ibe sisimo se-$k<g(x)$ uze ufumane elona xabiso likhulu le-$g(x)$ phakathi kwamalungu e-$U$.
cm2_existsInterval.explanation: ${form}$ ingatshintshelwa kwisimo se-$k<{gx}$. Phakathi kwamalungu e-$U$, u-${gx}$ unexabiso eliphezulu li-${gm}$ xa $x={xm}$, kwaye ukuba $k<{gm}$ ichanekile kule $x$. Ngoko elona xabiso likhulu lenombolo epheleleyo $k$ li-${ans}$.

cm2_funcInjective.prompt: Phakathi kwemisebenzi emnye-kumnye $f$ ukusuka kwiseti $X=\{{xset}\}$ ukuya kwiseti $Y=\{{yset}\}$, mingaphi enalo $f(1)\le {t}$ kwaye $f(2)\ge {u}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Umsebenzi omnye-kumnye uhambelanisa amalungu ahlukeneyo e-$X$ namaxabiso omsebenzi ahlukeneyo. Qala umisele u-$f(1)$, $f(2)$.
Bala inani lamanani $(f(1), f(2))$ apho $f(1)\ne f(2)$, uze uphindaphinde ngenani leendlela zokumisela amaxabiso omsebenzi amalungu aseleyo.
cm2_funcInjective.explanation: $f(1)$ unezindlela ezingu-${t}$, $f(2)$ unezindlela ezingu-${n}-{u}+1$, kwaye kukho iimeko ezingu-${ov}$ apho $f(1)=f(2)$, ngoko $(f(1), f(2))$ ngeendlela ezingu-${pairs}$. Amalungu aseleyo angu-${mr}$ ahambelaniswa mnye-kumnye namaxabiso aseleyo angu-${nr}$, ngoko iindlela zi-${rest}$, kwaye inani elifunwayo li-${pairs}\times{rest}={ans}$.

cm2_funcMonotone.prompt: Phakathi kwemisebenzi $f$ ukusuka kwiseti $X=\{{xset}\}$ ukuya kwiseti $Y=\{{yset}\}$, mingaphi enalo ${chain}$ kwaye $f(1)\ge {u}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $f(1)<f(2)<\cdots$, onke amaxabiso omsebenzi ahlukile, kwaye ukuba amaxabiso amiselwe, ukuhambelana ngokobukhulu kumiselwa ngokungqongqo.

Amanani anokuba ngamaxabiso omsebenzi ziinombolo ezipheleleyo eziphezulu okanye ezilingana no-${u}$ nangaphantsi okanye ezilingana no-${w}$, kwaye inani leendlela zokukhetha ${m}$ ahlukeneyo phakathi kwazo.
cm2_funcMonotone.explanation: Amaxabiso omsebenzi akhethwa ngokukhetha amanani angu-${m}$ ahlukeneyo phakathi kweenombolo ezipheleleyo ezingu-${k}$ eziphezulu okanye ezilingana no-${u}$ nangaphantsi okanye ezilingana no-${w}$. Ukuhambelanisa amaxabiso akhethiweyo no-$f(1), f(2), \dots$ usuka kwelincinci kumiselwa ngokungqongqo, ngoko inani li-$_{{k}}\mathrm{C}_{{m}}={ans}$.

cm2_inclusionParam.prompt: Kwiiseti ezimbini $A=\{x\mid {Ac}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {Cc}\}$ ($x$ linani lokwenyani), zingaphi iiseti $B=\{x\mid a\le x\le b\}$ ($a$, $b$ ziinombolo ezipheleleyo) ezifezekisa $A\subset B\subset C$? (Qaphela: $\subset$ iquka imeko apho iiseti zibini zilingana.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ubonise u-$A$ no-$C$ njengezithuba zesimo se-$\alpha\le x\le\beta$.

Ukuba $A\subset B$, u-$a$ uphantsi okanye ulingana nesiphelo sasekhohlo se-$A$, u-$b$ uphezulu okanye ulingana nesiphelo sasekunene se-$A$, kwaye ukuba $B\subset C$, u-$a$, $b$ kufuneka babe ngaphakathi kwesithuba se-$C$. Bala amaxabiso anokubakho ka-$a$ no-$b$ ngokwahlukeneyo.
cm2_inclusionParam.explanation: $A=\{x\mid {al}\le x\le {ar}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {cl}\le x\le {cr}\}$. Ukuze $A\subset B\subset C$, kufuneka ${cl}\le a\le {al}$, ${ar}\le b\le {cr}$, ngoko u-$a$ unamaxabiso angu-${na}$, u-$b$ unamaxabiso angu-${nb}$ kwaye inani le-$B$ li-${na}\times{nb}={ans}$.

cm2_inverseQuadDom.prompt: Xa umsebenzi ochasayo womsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ (${dom}$) ungu-$g$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$g({t})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ngokunqanda indawo (${dom}$), u-$f$ ngumsebenzi omnye-kumnye kwaye unomsebenzi ochasayo.
Ukuba $g({t})=x$, ngoko $f(x)={t}$. Fumana izimvo ze-quadratic equation $f(x)={t}$ uze ukhethe isimvo esihambelana nendawo.
cm2_inverseQuadDom.explanation: Unokuguqulwa ube sisimo se-$f(x)={vf}$ kwaye kwi-$f(x)={t}$, ${sq}={s2}$, ngoko ${xp}=\pm{s}$. Kuba indawo yi-${dom}$, ${xp}={rt}$ kwaye $g({t})={ans}$.

cm2_inverseRational.prompt: Xa umsebenzi ochasayo womsebenzi $f(x)=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ungu-$g$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$g({k})$? (Qaphela: indawo ye-$f$ yonke inani lokwenyani elingenguye elo lenza i-denominator ibe ngu-$0$.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $g({k})=x$, ngoko $f(x)={k}$.
Phindaphinda macala omabini e-$\frac{{num}}{{den}}={k}$ nge-denominator uze usombulule njenge-equation yomgca ye-$x$.
cm2_inverseRational.explanation: Ukuba $g({k})=x$, $f(x)={k}$, ngoko ${num}={k}\times({den})$. Ukulungisa ngo-$x$ kunika $({coef})x={rhs}$, ngoko $x={ans}$, oko kukuthi $g({k})={ans}$.

cm2_irrLineCount.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ ezenza ukuba ikhaphu $y=\sqrt{{fr}}$ nomgca $y=x+k$ zibe namanqaku amabini okudibana? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Chaza unobumba omtsha $t$ ngolu hlobo. $t=\sqrt{{fr}}$ ($t\ge 0$). Ngoko ungachaza u-$x$ ngo-$t$. Inani lamanqaku okudibana lilingana nenani lezimvo zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ezingeyonegative ze-quadratic equation ye-$t$.
Imeko yokuba i-quadratic equation ye-$t$ ibe nezimvo ezimbini zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ezingeyonegative yi-$D>0$, (isixa sezimvo ezimbini)$\ge 0$, (imveliso yezimvo ezimbini)$\ge 0$.
cm2_irrLineCount.explanation: Ukuchaza unobumba omtsha $t$ njenge-$t=\sqrt{{fr}}\ (t\ge 0)$, $x=\frac{t^2-({b})}{{a}}$ kwaye ukusuka ku-$t=x+k$, $t^2-{a}t+({a}k-({b}))=0$. Ukuze kubekho izimvo ezimbini zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo ezingeyonegative, $D={a}^2-4({a}k-({b}))>0$ kwaye imveliso ${a}k-({b})\ge 0$ (isixa ${a}>0$), ngoko ${lt}\le k<{ht}$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo $k$ ezifezekisa oku ziqala ku-${lo}$ ukuya ku-${hi}$, zizonke zi-${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalMinMax.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, lelona xabiso likhulu kwi-${lo}\le x\le {hi}$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuba intetho engaphakathi komsantsa yi-linear, xa u-$x$ ekhula, u-$f(x)$ utshintsha kwicala elinye kuphela. Ngoko uthelekisa amaxabiso kwiziphelo zombini zesithuba.
Fumana amaxabiso omsebenzi xa $x={lo}$ naxa $x={hi}$ ngokwahlukeneyo uze ukhethe elikhulu.
cm2_irrationalMinMax.explanation: $f({lo})=\sqrt{{rl}}+({c})={flo}$, $f({hi})=\sqrt{{rh}}+({c})={fhi}$. Kuba kwesi sithuba u-$f$ wanda okanye wehla kuphela, elona xabiso likhulu phakathi kwala mabini yi-${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalPass.prompt: Xa inqaku elisegrafini yomsebenzi onomsantsa $y=\sqrt{a({xp})}{qs}$ ($a$ yinombolo engatshintshiyo engeyiyo $0$) li-$P({x0}, {y0})$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Faka ulungelelwaniso lweqhosha kwi-equation. Qaphela ukuba ingcambu yesikwere ingaphezulu okanye ilingana no-$0$.
Shiya umsantsa kuphela uze usike macala omabini ukusombulula njenge-equation yomgca ye-$a$.
cm2_irrationalPass.explanation: Ukufaka iqhosha $P$, ${y0}=\sqrt{a({x0}-({p}))}+({q})$, ngoko $\sqrt{a\times({d})}={s}$. Ukusika macala omabini kunika $a\times({d})={s2}$, ngoko $a={ans}$.

cm2_lineCircleCount.prompt: Isangqa $C$: ${circ}$, umgca $l$: ${line}$. Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo ezilungileyo $k$ ezenza ukuba u-$C$ no-$l$ badibane kumanqaku amabini ahlukeneyo? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba umgama phakathi kweziko lesangqa nomgca mncinci kuneradiyasi, bayadibana kumanqaku amabini ahlukeneyo.
Lungisa le nxaki yomgama $\frac{|{u}\times({cx})+({w})\times({cy})-k|}{\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}}<{rad}$ ibe yinxaki ye-$k$.
