cm2_lineCircleCount.explanation: Kuba umgama ukusuka kwiziko $({cx}, {cy})$ ukuya kumgca kufuneka ube mncinci kuneradiyasi ${rad}$, $|{K0}-k|<{rad}\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}=\sqrt{{R2}}$. Iinombolo ezipheleleyo ezifezekisa oku zi-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, kwaye phakathi kwazo inani leenombolo ezipheleleyo ezilungileyo li-${ans}$.

cm2_lineThroughPerp.prompt: Umgca ocatshulwe usuka kwichaphaza $P({px}, {py})$ ukuya kumgca $l$: ${line}$ ngokuthe nkqo (umgca odlula kwi-$P$ kwaye ume nkqo kwi-$l$) udibana ne-axis ye-$y$ kwichaphaza elineekhowudinethi ze-$y$ ezingakanani? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba imigca emibini imi nkqo, imveliso yamathambeka ngu-$-1$.
Qala ufumane ithambeka le-$l$, wenze ulingano lwe-point-slope ngethambeka lomgca omi nkqo, uze ufake u-$x=0$.
cm2_lineThroughPerp.explanation: Ithambeka lomgca $l$ li-${ms}$, ngoko ithambeka lomgca omi nkqo li-${mp}$. Kuba udlula kwi-$P$, $y-({py})={mp}\left(x-({px})\right)$, kwaye ngokufaka u-$x=0$, $y={ans}$.

cm2_necessaryDiv.prompt: Kumanani aphelele $x$, iimeko ezimbini ngu-$p$: $x$ siphindaphindi ka-$m$. $q$: $x$ siphindaphindi ka-${n}$. Linani lini lamanani endalo $m$ apho u-$p$ eyimeko efunekayo kodwa hayi eyaneleyo kuba u-$q$?
hints: Ukuba u-$p$ yimeko efunekayo kuba u-$q$, $q\Rightarrow p$. Ngeeseti zenyaniso, $Q\subset P$.
Ukuze zonke iziphindaphindi ze-${n}$ zisiphindaphindi ka-$m$, u-$m$ kufuneka abe ngumhlukanisi we-${n}$. Ukuze ingabi yimeko eyaneleyo, u-$p\Rightarrow q$ akufanele abe yinyaniso.
cm2_necessaryDiv.explanation: Kuba yimeko efunekayo, $q\Rightarrow p$, oko kukuthi zonke iziphindaphindi ze-${n}$ kufuneka zisiphindaphindi ka-$m$, kwaye oku kuyinyani xa u-$m$ engumhlukanisi we-${n}$. Ukuze ingabi yimeko eyaneleyo, u-$p\Rightarrow q$ kufuneka abe ngobuxoki, kodwa xa u-$m$ engumhlukanisi we-${n}$, u-$p\Rightarrow q$ uyinyaniso kuphela xa $m={n}$. Kuba i-${n}$ inabahlukanisi abangu-${nd}$, inani elifunwayo lika-$m$ li-${nd}-1={ans}$.

cm2_perpParam.prompt: Kwimigca emibini $l_1: {l1}$, $l_2: {l2}$, isimbuku samaxabiso onke amanani anyanisileyo $k$ okwenza imigca emibini ilingane okanye ime nkqo kuyo yintoni? (Kodwa, imeko apho imigca emibini ihambelana ayithathwa njengelingeneyo.) (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Imigca emibini $ax+by+c=0$, $a'x+b'y+c'=0$ ilingene (okanye ihambelana) xa $ab'-a'b=0$, kwaye imi nkqo xa $aa'+bb'=0$.
Imeko yokulingana ibe lulingano lwequadratic ngo-$k$, imeko yokumi nkqo ibe lulingano olulayini. Sombulula zombini uze uqokelele onke amaxabiso.
cm2_perpParam.explanation: Iikoyifishienti ze-$x$, $y$ ze-$l_1$ zi-${p}$, $k$ kwaye iikoyifishienti ze-$l_2$ zi-$k{qs}$, ${rr}$. Imeko yokulingana: ${p}\times({rr})=k(k{qs})$, oko kukuthi ${eqPar}=0$ kunika $k={k1}$ okanye $k={k2}$ kwaye kuzo zombini iimeko imigca ayihambelani. Imeko yokumi nkqo: ${p}(k{qs})+({rr})k=0$ kunika $k={k3}$. Ngoko isimbuku si-${k1}+({k2})+({k3})={ans}$.

cm2_pointLineDist.prompt: Umgama osuka kwichaphaza $P({x0}, {y0})$ ukuya kumgca ${line}$ uyintoni? (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjenge-3/4)
hints: Umgama phakathi kwechaphaza $(x_0,y_0)$ nomgca $ax+by+c=0$ ngu-$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
Bala inani elingasentla $|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|$, inani elingaphantsi li-$\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}$.
cm2_pointLineDist.explanation: Kwi-$\frac{|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|}{\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}}$, inani elingasentla li-${N}$ kwaye $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}={h}$, ngoko umgama ngu-$\frac{{N}}{{h}}={ans}$.

cm2_rationalAsym.prompt: Xa ii-asymptote ezimbini zegrafu yomsebenzi onengqiqo $y=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ngumgca $x=p$, $y=q$, ixabiso le-$p+q$ liyintoni? (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjenge-3/4)
hints: Ixabiso le-$x$ apho inani elingaphantsi libangu-$0$ yi-asymptote engqamene.
Ixabiso apho u-$y$ asondela kulo xa ixabiso eliqinisekileyo le-$x$ likhula kakhulu yi-asymptote engqamene nomhlaba. Ngumlinganiselo weekoyifishienti ze-$x$ zenani elingasentla nelingaphantsi.
cm2_rationalAsym.explanation: I-asymptote engqamene ngumgca $x={px}$ kuba lixabiso le-$x$ apho inani elingaphantsi libangu-$0$. Xa $x\to\infty$, $y\to\frac{{a}}{{c}}={qy}$, ngoko i-asymptote engqamene nomhlaba ngu-$y={qy}$. Ngoko $p+q=({px})+({qy})={ans}$.

cm2_rationalIntersectCount.prompt: Zingaphi iinombolo ezipheleleyo $n$ kwi-$-{N}\le n\le {N}$ ezenza ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi $y={fr}$ nomgca ${line}$ zibe namanqaku amabini okudibana?  (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Dibanisa ii-equation ezimbini ukwenza i-quadratic equation ye-$x$, uze ucinge ngemeko yokuba ibe nezimvo ezimbini zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo (i-discriminant).
Ngenxa yokuba uphindaphinde ngentetho ye-$x$ ukususa i-denominator, qinisekisa nokuba izimvo ze-quadratic equation azenzi i-denominator ibe ngu-$0$.
cm2_rationalIntersectCount.explanation: Ngokudibanisa, ukusuka ku-$\frac{{k}}{{den}}{qs}={mx}+n$, emva kokususa i-denominator, i-discriminant ye-quadratic equation elungisiweyo yi-$D=({nstr})^2{ds}$. (Izimvo azenzi i-denominator ibe ngu-$0$.) Kuba $D>0$ kufuneka, ngokukhupha iinombolo ezipheleleyo $n$ ezingafezekisi oku, kwezi-${tot}$ zoluhlu zikhutshwa ezi-${bad}$, ngoko zi-${ans}$.

cm2_rationalParam.prompt: Inqaku elinye kwigrafu efunyenwe ngokuhambisa igrafu yomsebenzi $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k$ yinombolo engatshintshiyo engeyiyo $0$) nge-${p}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-${q}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$ yi-$P({x0}, {y0})$. Yeyiphi i-$x$ yendawo apho le grafu ihlangana ne-axis ye-$x$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuhambisa kutshintsha u-$x$ abe sisimo se-$x-({p})$ no-$y$ abe sisimo se-$y-({q})$ kwintetho.
Faka ulungelelwaniso lweqhosha elinikiweyo ukufumana u-$k$, uze ufake u-$y=0$.
cm2_rationalParam.explanation: Igrafu ehanjisiweyo yi-$y=\frac{k}{{xsh}}{ysh}$. Kuba inqaku $P$ likwigrafu, ukusuka ku-${y0}=\frac{k}{{dx}}{ysh}$, $k={kk}$. Xa $y=0$, $\frac{{kk}}{{xsh}}={nq}$, ngoko $x={ans}$.

cm2_reflectChainOrder.prompt: Inqaku $P(a, b)$ lihanjiswa nge-${m}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-${n}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$ ukwenza inqaku $Q$, inqaku $Q$ lijongwa ngokwesiseko ukwenza inqaku $R$, kwaye inqaku $R$ lijongwa ngokwe-axis ye-$x$ ukwenza inqaku $S$. Xa ulungelelwaniso lwe-$S$ lu-$({sx}, {sy})$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukujonga ngokwesiseko kunika $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, nokujonga ngokwe-axis ye-$x$ kunika $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$.
Ukuhambisa kwenziwa kuqala, emva koko ukujonga, ngoko nesixa sokuhambisa siyatshintsha uphawu. Buyela emva inyathelo ngalinye usuka ku-$S$ okanye uchaze ngo-$a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectChainOrder.explanation: Ukuchaza ngo-$a$, $b$, $Q(a+({m}), b+({n}))$, $R(-a-({m}), -b-({n}))$, $S(-a-({m}), b+({n}))$. Ukusuka ku-$-a-({m})={sx}$, $a={pa}$, kwaye ukusuka ku-$b+({n})={sy}$, $b={pb}$, ngoko $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectCurve.prompt: Emva kokujonga igrafu yomsebenzi $y={orig}$ ngokwesiseko, uze uyihambise nge-${m}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-${n}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$, xa ulungelelwaniso lweqhosha eliphezulu leparabola efunyenweyo lu-$(s, t)$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$s+t$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukujonga ngokwesiseko kunika $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, ngoko tshintsha u-$x$ abe ngu-$-x$ no-$y$ abe ngu-$-y$ kwintetho.
Ungafumana iqhosha eliphezulu leparabola yokuqala uze usebenzise ukuhambisa kabini ngokulandelelana, okanye ubhale intetho ehanjisiweyo ngokuthe ngqo.
cm2_reflectCurve.explanation: Iqhosha eliphezulu leparabola yokuqala li-$({h}, {k})$. Ukujonga ngokwesiseko kwenza iparabola yesimo se-$y=-({orig2})$ kwaye iqhosha eliphezulu li-$({nh}, {nk})$. Ukuyihambisa nge-${m}$ kwi-axis ye-$x$ nge-${n}$ kwi-axis ye-$y$ kunika $(s, t)=({s}, {t})$, ngoko $s+t={ans}$.

cm2_reflectPointChain.prompt: Inqaku $P(a, b)$ lijongwa ngokomgca $y=x$ ukwenza inqaku $Q$, inqaku $Q$ lijongwa ngokwe-axis ye-$y$ ukwenza inqaku $R$, kwaye inqaku $R$ lihanjiswa nge-${m}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-${n}$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$ ukwenza inqaku $S$. Xa ulungelelwaniso lwe-$S$ lu-$({sx}, {sy})$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$a+b$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukujonga ngokomgca $y=x$ kunika $(x,y)\to(y,x)$, nokujonga ngokwe-axis ye-$y$ kunika $(x,y)\to(-x,y)$.
Buyela emva inyathelo ngalinye usuka ku-$S$, okanye uchaze ulungelelwaniso ukusuka ku-$P(a,b)$ ukuya ku-$S$ ngo-$a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectPointChain.explanation: Ukuchaza ngo-$a$, $b$, $Q(b, a)$, $R(-b, a)$, $S(-b+({m}), a+({n}))$. Ukusuka ku-$-b+({m})={sx}$, $b={pb}$, kwaye ukusuka ku-$a+({n})={sy}$, $a={pa}$, ngoko $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectShortest.prompt: Kwi-coordinate plane, kumanqaku $A({a1}, {a2})$, $B({b1}, {b2})$ nakwiqhosha $P$ elihamba kwi-axis ye-$x$, lelona xabiso lincinci le-$\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuba amanqaku amabini akwicala elinye le-axis ye-$x$, ukujonga iqhosha elinye ngokwe-axis ye-$x$ kunokutshintsha u-$\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ abe bubude bomgca omnye.
Ukuthatha iqhosha $B'$ elijongwe ngokwe-axis ye-$x$ kwi-$B$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ kwaye $\overline{A P}+\overline{PB'}\ge\overline{AB'}$.
cm2_reflectShortest.explanation: Ukuba iqhosha elijongwe ngokwe-axis ye-$x$ kwi-$B$ li-$B'({b1}, {nb2})$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$, ngoko $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}\ge\overline{AB'}$, kwaye ngenxa yokuba u-$A$ no-$B'$ bakumacala achasayo e-axis ye-$x$, icandelo $AB'$ lidibana ne-axis ye-$x$, ngoko ukulingana kuyabamba. $\overline{AB'}=\sqrt{({b1}-({a1}))^2+({a2}-({nb2}))^2}=\sqrt{{dx}^2+{ss}^2}={ans}$.

cm2_setOpSum.prompt: $U$ yiseti yawo onke amanani endalo aphezulu okanye alingana no-1 nangaphantsi okanye alingana no-${N}$, $A$ yiseti yazo zonke izahluli ze-${da}$ phakathi kwamalungu e-$U$, $B$ yiseti yazo zonke iziphindaphindo ze-${mb}$ phakathi kwamalungu e-$U$. Sisixa sini samalungu onke eseti ${ex}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ubhale u-$A$ no-$B$ ngokubhala amalungu.
I-complement $X^c$ yinto eseleyo ngokususa amalungu e-$X$ kwi-$U$. Bala ngokulandelelana usuka ngaphakathi kwebhrakethi.

cm2_setSumCount.prompt: Kwiiseti ezimbini $A=\{{sa}\}$, $B=\{{sb}\}$, sisixa sini samalungu onke eseti $C=\{x+y\mid x\in A,\ y\in B\}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Khetha ilungu elinye le-$A$ nelinye le-$B$ uzidibanise, uze wenze onke amaxabiso.
Nokuba ixabiso elifanayo livela amaxesha amaninzi, ilungu leseti libalwa kanye kuphela.
cm2_setSumCount.explanation: Ukufumana zonke izixa ezinokubakho, amaxabiso ahlukeneyo yi-${sc}$. Ngenxa yokuba iseti ibhala ilungu elifanayo kanye kuphela, isixa samalungu si-${ans}$.

cm2_sufficientQuad.prompt: Kwiimeko ezimbini ze-$x$ yenombolo yokwenyani $p$: $x>a$, $q$: ${quad}>0$. Lelona xabiso lincinci lenombolo epheleleyo $a$ eyenza ukuba $p$ ibe yimeko eyaneleyo ye-$q$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $p$ yimeko eyaneleyo ye-$q$, $p\Rightarrow q$, oko kukuthi iseti yenyaniso ye-$p$ iqukiwe kwiseti yenyaniso ye-$q$.
Qala usombulule i-quadratic inequality ${quad}>0$ ukufumana iseti yenyaniso ye-$q$.
cm2_sufficientQuad.explanation: Isisombululo se-${quad}>0$ yi-$x<{Rs}$ okanye $x>{Rl}$. Ukuze iseti yenyaniso ye-$p$ ethi $\{x\mid x>a\}$ iqukiwe kule seti, kufuneka $a\ge {Rl}$. Ngoko elona xabiso lincinci lenombolo epheleleyo $a$ li-${ans}$.

cm2_tangentAtPoint.prompt: Inqaku elisetangent kwiqhosha $({x1}, {y1})$ kwisangqa ${circ}$ li-$Q({t}, k)$, lingakanani ixabiso le-$k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Itangenti kwiqhosha elisesangqeni ithe nkqo kwiradiyasi edibanisa elo qhosha neziko.
Qala wenze i-equation yetangenti, uze ufake ulungelelwaniso lweqhosha $Q$.
cm2_tangentAtPoint.explanation: I-equation yetangenti yi-${tang}$. Ngenxa yokuba iqhosha $Q$ lisetangent, ukufaka $x={t}$, $y=k$ kunika $k={ans}$.

cm2_translateCurve.prompt: Xa igrafu yomsebenzi $y={orig}$ ihanjiswa nge-$m$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-$n$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$, ingqamana negrafu yomsebenzi $y={img}$. Lingakanani ixabiso le-$m+n$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuhambisa nge-$m$ kwicala le-axis ye-$x$ nge-$n$ kwicala le-axis ye-$y$, faka u-$x-m$ endaweni ka-$x$ no-$y-n$ endaweni ka-$y$.
Andisa i-$y-n=f(x-m)$ uze uqale uthelekise i-coefficient ye-$x$ ukufumana u-$m$.
cm2_translateCurve.explanation: I-equation ehanjisiweyo yi-$y-n={shift}$. Ukuyandisa nokuthelekisa i-coefficient ye-$x$, ${b}-({tw})m={b2}$, ngoko $m={m}$, kwaye ukuthelekisa inombolo engatshintshiyo kunika $n={n}$. Ngoko $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_truthRange.prompt: Kwiimeko ezimbini ze-real number $x$, $p$: ${quad}\le 0$, $q$: $|{cx}|\le a$, ukuba ixabiso elincinci kakhulu lenombolo yendalo $a$ eyenza i-contrapositive yesindululo $p\to q$ ibe yinyani yi-$\alpha$, kwaye ixabiso elikhulu kakhulu lenombolo yendalo $a$ eyenza i-converse yesindululo $p\to q$ ibe yinyani yi-$\beta$, ixabiso le-$\alpha\beta$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Isindululo ne-contrapositive yaso zihlala zinyani okanye zingeyonyani ngokufanayo. I-converse $q\to p$ kufuneka ihlolwe ngokwahlukileyo kwisindululo sokuqala. Ukuba iiseti zenyaniso ngu-$P$, $Q$, xa $p\to q$ iyinyani, $P\subset Q$.
Qala ubhale u-$P$ njengothuba, kwaye u-$Q$ ngokusombulula $|{cx}|\le a$ ngo-$a$. Fumana uluhlu lwe-$a$ olwenza i-contrapositive $P\subset Q$, kwaye i-converse $Q\subset P$.
cm2_truthRange.explanation: $P=\{x\mid {m}\le x\le {n}\}$ kwaye $|{cx}|\le a$ kuthetha $-a\le {cx}\le a$. Ngenxa yokuba i-contrapositive inyani okanye ayiyonyani ngokufanayo nesindululo sokuqala, kufuneka $P\subset Q$, kwaye ekupheleni kwe-$P$ ku-$x={m}$, $x={n}$ amaxabiso e-${cx}$ ngu-${u}$, ${w}$, ngoko $a\ge {d1}$, $a\ge {d2}$. Ngoko $\alpha={al}$. I-converse kufuneka $Q\subset P$ kwaye u-$Q$ yi-${lowS}\le {kx}\le {highS}$, ngoko ${lowS}\ge {km}$, ${highS}\le {kn}$, oko kukuthi $a\le {d1}$, $a\le {d2}$. Ngoko $\beta={be}$ kwaye $\alpha\beta={al}\times{be}={ans}$.

cm2_vennReverse.prompt: Kwiiseti ezingaphantsi ezimbini $A$, $B$ zeseti jikelele $U$, $n(U)={nu}$, $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n((A\cup B)^c)={nc}$. Ixabiso le-$n(A^c\cup B)$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane inani lamalungu e-union nge-$n(A\cup B)=n(U)-n((A\cup B)^c)$.
Ukusebenzisa ukuba $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$, $n(A^c\cup B)=n(U)-n(A-B)$.
cm2_vennReverse.explanation: $n(A\cup B)={nu}-{nc}={un}$ kwaye $n(A\cap B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-{un}={ab}$. $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$ kwaye $n(A-B)={na}-{ab}$, ngoko $n(A^c\cup B)={nu}-({na}-{ab})={ans}$.

cul_bordaMax.prompt: Oku kukunyula kweBorda ukukhetha omnye phakathi kwabagqatswa A, B, C. Indawo yokuqala ifumana amanqaku angu-$2$, indawo yesibini amanqaku angu-$1$, kwaye indawo yesithathu amanqaku angu-$0$. Xa iishedyuli zokubeka ziyi-'{b1}' ngabantu aba-${n1}$, '{b2}' ngabantu aba-${n2}$, '{b3}' ngabantu aba-${n3}$, lingakanani inani eliphezulu lamanqaku onke phakathi kwabagqatswa abathathu? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Fumana indawo yomgqatswa ngamnye kwishedyuli nganye yokubeka uze ugqibe amanqaku.
Fumana amanqaku onke abagqatswa abathathu uze ukhethe elona likhulu.
cul_bordaMax.explanation: Amanqaku onke ka-A ngu-${eA}$, ka-B ngu-${eB}$, ka-C ngu-${eC}$. Inani eliphezulu lamanqaku onke yi-${ans}$.

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: Oku kukunyula kweBorda ukukhetha omnye phakathi kwabagqatswa A, B, C. Indawo yokuqala ifumana amanqaku angu-$2$, indawo yesibini amanqaku angu-$1$, kwaye indawo yesithathu amanqaku angu-$0$. Xa iishedyuli zokubeka ziyi-'A>B>C' ngabantu aba-${n1}$, 'B>C>A' ngabantu aba-${n2}$, 'C>A>B' ngabantu aba-${n3}$, amanqaku onke omgqatswa A ngawaphi? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane indawo ka-A kwishedyuli nganye yokubeka.
Dibanisa (inani labantu)×(amanqaku endawo) lonke.
cul_bordaTotal.explanation: U-A uyindawo yokuqala (amanqaku ama-2) kwishedyuli yokuqala, indawo yesithathu (amanqaku angu-0) kweyesibini, kunye nendawo yesibini (inqaku eli-1) kweyesithathu, ngoko ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$.

cul_brailleAtMost.prompt: Kwiseli enye yeBraille kukho iindawo ezingu-${d}$ apho amachokoza angabekwa khona, kwaye indawo nganye iyaphakama okanye ayiphakami. Zingaphi iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwiseli enye, ezinamachokoza aphakanyisiweyo ukusuka kwelinye ukuya kuma-${k}$? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Inani lezimilo ezinamachokoza aphakanyisiweyo angu-$j$ ngqo lilingana nenani leendlela zokukhetha u-$j$ phakathi kweendawo ezingu-${d}$.
Fumana nganye ukusuka ku-$j=1$ ukuya ku-$j={k}$ uze udibanise.
cul_brailleAtMost.explanation: Inani lezimilo ezinamachokoza aphakanyisiweyo angu-$j$ yi-$_{{d}}\mathrm{C}_{j}$, ngoko ${terms}={ans}$.

cul_pitchFifth.prompt: Isantya yesandi esiyisiseko yi-${f}$ Hz. Kwisandi esenyuselwe ngee-octave ezingu-${k}$ ngaphezu kwesi sandi, yeyiphi isantya sesandi esiphezulu ngee-perfect fifth (umlinganiselo wesantya $3:2$) ngeHz? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Isandi esiphezu kwe-octave sinesantya esiphindwe kabini.
Ukuya phezulu nge-perfect fifth, phindaphinda isantya nge-$\frac{3}{2}$.
cul_pitchFifth.explanation: Ngee-octave ezingu-${k}$ phezulu: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz, ngee-perfect fifth phezulu: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_stringLength.prompt: Ngomtya wesixhobo somculo, okufutshane kobude, kokuphezulu kwesantya, kwaye xa ubungqingqwa nokuqina komtya kufana, isantya silingana ngokuchasene nobude bomtya. Xa umtya onobude be-${L}$ cm uvelisa isandi se-${f}$ Hz, ukuba ubude bendawo evuthuzayo yomtya ofanayo xa uwucinezele buncitshiswa bube yi-${L2}$ cm, lungakanani isantya sesandi esivelayo ngeHz? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ixabiso le-(isantya)×(ubude) aliguquki.
Wahlula ixabiso le-${f}\times{L}$ ngobude obutsha be-${L2}$ cm.

cul_voteGuarantee.prompt: Abaviwa u-A, u-B no-C bakhuphisana kuvoto apho omnye ofumana amavoti amaninzi ephumelela. Iziphumo zexesha lokubala zi-A ${a}$ amavoti, B ${b}$ amavoti, C ${c}$ amavoti, kwaye kusele amavoti angu-${m}$ angekabalwa. Nokuba amavoti aseleyo ahlulwa njani phakathi kuka-A no-B, ukuze u-C aqinisekise ukuba uyoyena uphambili yedwa, u-C kufuneka afumane ubuncinane amavoti amangaphi kumavoti aseleyo angu-${m}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba u-C ufumana amavoti angu-$x$ kwaseleyo, amavoti ${m}$−$x$ aseleyo aya kwabanye abaviwa. Imeko engakhuselekanga kakhulu yeyo apho onke la mavoti aya kumviwa ophambili ngoku.
Amavoti ka-C kufuneka abe ngaphezulu (hayi alinganayo) kuneamavoti omviwa ophambili. Misela inxaki uze ufumane elona nani lipheleleyo elincinci $x$.
cul_voteGuarantee.explanation: Amavoti amaninzi ngoku yi-${M}$. Xa u-C efumana amavoti angu-$x$ kwaseleyo kwaye onke amavoti ${m}-x$ aseleyo aya komviwa onamavoti angu-${M}$, kufuneka ${c}+x>{M}+({m}-x)$. Ukuyilungisa kunika $x>{half}$, ngoko elona nani lipheleleyo elincinci yi-${ans}$.

econ_annuityPV.prompt: Kukho umhlala-phantsi owamkelwa ekupheleni konyaka ngamnye nge-${A}$ rhando kwiminyaka engu-${n}$ (intlawulo yokuqala emva konyaka omnye, eyokugqibela emva kweminyaka engu-${n}$). Ngenzala yonyaka ye-${r}$%, kubalwa ngenzala edityanisiweyo yonyaka ngamnye, ixabiso lale annuity ngoku liyintoni ngerhando? (Phosa ngaphantsi kwerhando. Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Intlawulo nganye yehliswa ngokwexesha layo lentlawulo ibe lixabiso langoku, uze uzidibanise zonke.
Xa izinga lenzala li-$i=\frac{{r}}{100}$, ixabiso langoku li-$A\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}$.
econ_annuityPV.explanation: Kuba $i={r}/100$, ixabiso langoku li-${A}\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}\approx{ex}$ rhando, kwaye ukuphosa ngaphantsi kwerhando kunika ${ans}$ rhando.

econ_compoundFV.prompt: Kwi-akhawunti yenzala edityanisiweyo ene-${r}$% yonyaka, apho inzala yongezwa kwimali esekwe amaxesha angu-${m}$ ngonyaka, kubekwa i-${P}$ rhando iminyaka engu-${n}$. Izinga lokubala nganye li-(izinga lonyaka)$\div{m}$, kwaye imali ayikhutshwa phakathi. Isixa esipheleleyo emva kweminyaka engu-${n}$ siyintoni ngerhando? (Phosa ngaphantsi kwerhando. Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Inani lamaxesha okubala lilonke yi-(amaxesha ngonyaka)×(iminyaka).
Ukusebenzisa izinga lokubala nganye i-${rp}$%, isixa esipheleleyo yimali esekwe iphindaphindwe nge-$(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})$ ngamaxesha okubala.
econ_compoundFV.explanation: Inani lamaxesha okubala yi-${m}\times{n}={k}$, izinga lokubala nganye yi-${rp}$%, ngoko isixa esipheleleyo si-${P}\times(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})^{{k}}\approx{ex}$ rhando, kwaye ukuphosa ngaphantsi kwerhando kunika ${ans}$ rhando.

econ_elasticityPoint.prompt: Umsebenzi wemfuno yi-$q={D}$ ($p$ lixabiso, $q$ yinani elifunwayo). Xa ixabiso li-$p={p0}$, lingakanani ixabiso lokuguquguquka kwemfuno ngokwexabiso $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane i-$q'(p)$, uze ufumane ixabiso layo xa $p={p0}$.
Fumana nenani elifunwayo $q$ xa $p={p0}$, uze ulifake kwi-formula ye-$e$.
econ_elasticityPoint.explanation: Ixabiso le-$q'(p)$ xa $p={p0}$ li-${dqv}$, inani elifunwayo li-$q={qv}$, ngoko $e=\frac{{adq}\times{p0}}{{qv}}={fr}$.

econ_elasticityUnit.prompt: Kumsebenzi wemfuno $q={D}$, yeyiphi inani lexabiso $p$ apho ukuguquguquka kwexabiso $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ kuba ngu-1? (Cinga ngoluhlu apho $p>0$ kwaye ubungakanani bemfuno $q>0$.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Emva kokufumana i-$q'(p)$, bhala $\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|=1$ njengesiqinisekiso se-$p$.
Kuluhlu apho $q>0$, $q'(p)<0$, ngoko ukususa ixabiso elipheleleyo kunika $-q'(p)\times p=q$.
econ_elasticityUnit.explanation: Ekubeni $q'(p)={dq}$, kwi-$-q'(p)\times p=q$ kuba ${eqn}$, kwaye isisombululo apho $p>0$ ngu-$p={ans}$.

econ_equilibriumTable.prompt: Imfuno yemveliso ethile ingamasuntswana angama-${qd1}$ xa ixabiso li-${p1}$ won, nama-${qd2}$ xa li-${p2}$ won, kwaye ubonelelo lungamasuntswana angama-${qs1}$ xa ixabiso li-${p3}$ won, nama-${qs2}$ xa li-${p4}$ won. Ukuba imfuno nobonelelo zombini ngemisebenzi yomgca wexabiso, lithini ixabiso lokulingana apho imfuno nobonelelo zilinganayo, ngee-won? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa umqondiso womgca odlula kumanqaku amabini ukufumana ukuba imfuno nobonelelo ziyatshintsha njani ngexabiso.
Beka imfuno njenge-$Q_d$ nobonelelo njenge-$Q_s$, uze ufumane ixabiso apho $Q_d=Q_s$.
econ_equilibriumTable.explanation: Izinga lokutshintsha kwemfuno ngu-$\frac{{qd2}-{qd1}}{{p2}-{p1}}={md}$, ngoko $Q_d={qd1}{md}(p-{p1})$, kwaye izinga lokutshintsha kobonelelo ngu-${ns}$, ngoko $Q_s={qs1}+{ns}(p-{p3})$. Ukusombulula $Q_d=Q_s$ kunika $p={ans}$ won.

econ_exchangeCross.prompt: Izinga lenkcenkceshelo lingu-1 yidola $={d}$ won, 1 yuro $={e}$ won. Ukuba utshintsha ii-yuro ezingama-${n}$ zibe ziidola ngaphandle kwentlawulo, zingaphi iidola? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane ukuba ii-yuro ezingama-${n}$ zingaphi kwi-won.
Yahlula loo mali yeWon ngexabiso lenye idola ${d}$ won.
econ_exchangeCross.explanation: Ii-yuro ezingama-${n}$ zingama-${n}\times{e}={won}$ won, kwaye ${won}\div{d}={ans}$ idola.

econ_inverseEntry.prompt: Kwimatrikisi ephambeneyo $A^{-1}$ ye-matrix $A={M}$, yintoni into ye-$({i}, {j})$? (Into ye-$(i, j)$ yinto ekumqolo wokuqala $i$ nakwikholam $j$.) (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: I-determinant ye-matrix ${G}$ ngu-$ad-bc$. Ukuba ayizero, kukho imatrikisi ephambeneyo.
Imatrikisi ephambeneyo ngu-${H}$.
econ_inverseEntry.explanation: I-determinant ngu-${ap}\times{dp}-{bp}\times{cp}={det}$, kwaye into ye-$({i}, {j})$ ye-$A^{-1}$ ngu-$\frac{{num}}{{det}}$, oko kukuthi ${fr}$.

econ_leontief.prompt: I-matrix yobungakanani bokufakwa kwiindawo zemveliso ezimbini 1, 2 ngu-$A={M}$ (into ye-$(i, j)$ ye-$A$ bubungakanani bemveliso yeshishini $i$ efunekayo xa ishishini $j$ lenza iyunithi enye). Ukuba iimveliso zizonke zamashishini omabini zingu-$x_1$, $x_2$ (iyunithi: ii-won ezili-100 lezigidi), kwaye imfuno yokugqibela ngu-$d_1={d1}$, $d_2={d2}$, ngoko ${XV}=A{XV}+{DV}$ iyabakho. Yintoni i-$x_1$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Guqula isiqinisekiso sibe yi-$(I-A){XV}={DV}$.
Fumana imatrikisi ephambeneyo ye-$I-A$ uze uyiphindaphinde nge-${DV}$. Imatrikisi ephambeneyo ye-matrix ye-$2\times2$ yi-$\frac{1}{ad-bc}$ iphindaphindwe yimatrikisi enezinto ezicwangciswe ngokutsha.

econ_marginalRevenue.prompt: Ijika lemfuno yemveliso ethile ngu-$p={a}-{b}q$ ($p$ lixabiso (won), $q$ bubungakanani bentengiso (amasuntswana)). Ingeniso iyonke ngu-$R(q)=pq$, kwaye ingeniso engaphezulu ngu-$R'(q)$, okuyimveliso ye-$R(q)$ ngokubhekisele ku-$q$. Bungakanani bentengiso $q$ xa ingeniso engaphezulu ingu-${m}$ won? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Faka i-$p={a}-{b}q$ kwi-$R(q)=pq$ ukubonisa i-$R(q)$ njengentetho ye-$q$.
Fumana i-$q$ apho ixabiso lentetho ehlukaniswe ye-$R(q)$ lingu-${m}$ won.

econ_presentValue.prompt: Kubalwa ngenzala edityanisiweyo yonyaka ye-${r}$%. Lingakanani ixabiso langoku le-${F}$ won eliza kufunyanwa emva kweminyaka engu-${n}$? (Phosa ngaphantsi kwewon. Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ixabiso langoku $P$ lixabiso apho imali $P$ edityaniswe iminyaka engu-${n}$ iba yi-${F}$ won.
econ_presentValue.explanation: $P={F}\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}\approx{ex}$ won, kwaye ukuphosa ngaphantsi kwewon kunika ${ans}$ won.

econ_profitCubic.prompt: Ixabiso eliphelele lokuvelisa iimveliso ezingu-$q$ yi-$C(q)=q^3-{b}q^2+{c}q+{f}$ (won), kwaye ixabiso lokuthengisa lizinzile kwi-${p}$ won kwinto nganye. Ukuba zonke iimveliso ezivelisiweyo ziyathengiswa, lelona xabiso likhulu lenzuzo (ingeniso epheleleyo ukususa iindleko ezipheleleyo) liyintoni ngewon? ($q$ linani lokwenyani eliphezulu okanye elilingana no-0.) (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Inzuzo yi-$\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$. Yahlula ukufumana u-$q$ apho $\pi'(q)=0$.
Kwisimvo esilungileyo se-$\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=0$, uphawu lwe-$\pi'(q)$ lutshintsha ukusuka ku-+ ukuya ku--.
econ_profitCubic.explanation: Kuba $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$, $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=-3(q-{q0})(q+{s})$. Kwi-$q\ge0$, u-$\pi'$ unexabiso elilungileyo phambi kwe-$q={q0}$ kwaye elingalunganga emva kwayo, ngoko ubuninzi bukwi-$q={q0}$ kwaye $\pi({q0})={ans}$ won.

econ_regionLP.prompt: Kukho ifektri eyenza iimveliso A ezingu-$x$ neemveliso B ezingu-$y$ ($x$, $y$ ziinombolo ezipheleleyo eziphezulu okanye ezilingana no-0). Izixhobo nexesha lomsebenzi elifunekayo ukwenza eyodwa yimveliso A i-${a1}$ kg, ${t1}$ iiyure, kwaye imveliso B i-${b1}$ kg, ${t2}$ iiyure. Izixhobo ezinokusetyenziswa ngosuku zi-${M}$ kg okanye ngaphantsi, isixa seeyure zomsebenzi zabasebenzi bonke zi-${T}$ iiyure okanye ngaphantsi, kwaye inzuzo yimveliso A ye-${pa}$ iiyunithi ze-10 000 won ngenye, kwaye imveliso B ye-${pb}$ iiyunithi ze-10 000 won ngenye. Yeyiphi inzuzo enkulu ngosuku ngee-yunithi ze-10 000 won? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Bhala iimeko njengenxaki, uze uzibonise njengommandla kwi-coordinate plane kunye no-$x\ge0$, $y\ge0$.
Inzuzo ${pa}x+{pb}y$ ifikelela kwisona sikhulu kwelinye lamakhona ommandla. Qala ujonge indawo yokudibana yemigca emibini yomda.
econ_regionLP.explanation: Iinxaki zi-${a1}x+{b1}y\le{M}$, ${t1}x+{t2}y\le{T}$, $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$. Ikona enenzuzo enkulu yindawo yokudibana yemigca emibini yomda $({x0}, {y0})$, kwaye le ndawo yinqaku eliyinombolo epheleleyo, ngoko inzuzo enkulu yi-${pa}\times{x0}+{pb}\times{y0}={ans}$ (iiyunithi ze-10 000 won).

econ_taxBracket.prompt: Kwilizwe elithile, irhafu yengeniso yahlula isiseko sirhafu sibe zizigaba zaze kusetyenziswe amazinga ahlukeneyo kwisigaba ngasinye. Kwinxalenye ye-${b1}$ iiyunithi ze-10 000 won okanye ngaphantsi kusetyenziswa i-${r1}$%, kwinxalenye engaphezulu kwe-${b1}$ yaye i-${b2}$ okanye ngaphantsi kusetyenziswa i-${r2}$%, kwaye kwinxalenye engaphezulu kwe-${b2}$ kusetyenziswa i-${r3}$%. Xa isiseko sirhafu si-${x1}$ iiyunithi ze-10 000 won, irhafu ekufuneka ibhatalwe yeyiphi ngeeyunithi ze-10 000 won? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Izinga lisetyenziswa kuphela kwimali ekwisigaba ngasinye. Qala ufumane imali ekwisigaba ngasinye.
Dibanisa (imali yesigaba)×(izinga) zonke.
econ_taxBracket.explanation: Imali yesigaba ngasinye yi-${s1}$, ${s2}$, ${s3}$ (iiyunithi ze-10 000 won), ngoko irhafu yi-${s1}\times\frac{{r1}}{100}+{s2}\times\frac{{r2}}{100}+{s3}\times\frac{{r3}}{100}={ans}$ (iiyunithi ze-10 000 won).

econ_taxEquilibrium.prompt: Ikhephu lemfuno yemveliso ethile yi-$p={a}-{b}q$, kwaye ikhephu lokunikezela yi-$p={c}+{d}q$. Apha $p$ lixabiso (won), $q$ linani (iziqwenga). Ukuba urhulumente ubeka irhafu ye-${t}$ won kumnikezeli xa athengisa into nganye, umnikezeli ufumana imali ethe yaba lixabiso elihlawulwe ngumthengi ukususa irhafu. Emva kokubeka irhafu, ixabiso elihlawulwa ngumthengi kwi-equilibrium lingakanani ngewon? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ixabiso elifunyanwa ngokwenene ngumnikezeli yi-$p-{t}$.
Faka i-$p-{t}$ endaweni ye-$p$ kwikhephu lokunikezela, uze ufake ikhephu lemfuno $p={a}-{b}q$ ukufumana u-$q$.
econ_taxEquilibrium.explanation: Ixabiso elifunyanwa ngumnikezeli yi-$p-{t}$, ngoko $({a}-{b}q)-{t}={c}+{d}q$. Ukusombulula oku kunika $q={qn}$, kwaye ixabiso elihlawulwa ngumthengi yi-$p={a}-{b}\times{qn}={ans}$ won.

econ_utilityBundle.prompt: Impahla x ixabisa ${a}$ won enye, impahla y ixabisa ${b}$ won enye. Ngokusebenzisa lonke uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwe-${I}$ won ngaphandle kosalela, ufuna ukuthenga amasuntswana angama-$x$ empahla x nama-$y$ empahla y ($x$, $y$ ngamanani aphelele angaphantsi kwe-0). Ukuba usetyenziso lunikwe ngu-$U={U}$, lithini ixabiso eliphezulu lika-$U$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana onke amanani aphelele angengaphantsi kwe-0 $(x, y)$ anelisa i-equation yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali ${a}x+{b}y={I}$.
Bala ixabiso le-$U$ kwisibini ngasinye $(x, y)$ ofumeneyo uze uthelekise.
econ_utilityBundle.explanation: Izibini $(x, y)$ ezanelisa i-equation yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali zi-${pairs}$. Phakathi kwazo, isibini esinexabiso eliphezulu le-$U$ ngu-$(x, y)=({bx}, {by})$ (ukuba zininzi, nguye omnye wazo), kwaye ngelo xesha $U={ans}$.

geo_conicGeneral.prompt: Kwiziko ze-conic ${eq}$, ukuba eyona inexabiso elikhulu le-$x$-coordinate (okanye eso sinye ukuba likhona iziko elinye kuphela) ngu-$(a,\ b)$, lithini ixabiso le-$a+b$? (Bhala inani eliphelele. Ukuba linegethivu, yongeza -)
hints: Guqula ngokwahlukeneyo i-$x$ ne-$y$ zibe zizikwere ezigqibeleleyo ukufumana isimbo esiqhelekileyo.
Funda iziko (okanye incopho) kwisimbo esiqhelekileyo, uze uhambe nge-$c$ (kwi-parabola $p$) ngecala eliphambili, apho lilele khona iziko.
geo_conicGeneral.explanation: Ukuyiguqula ibe zizikwere ezigqibeleleyo kunika ${std}$. Iziko zi-${foc}$, ngoko $a+b={ans}$.

geo_conicParam.prompt: Ukuba umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini zejika ${eq}$ ngu-${fd}$ kwaye ${cond}$, lithini ixabiso le-$k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini ngu-$2c$, ungaqala ufumane ixabiso le-$c$. Nqumamo nokuba sesiphi isihlukanisi esingu-$a^2$.
I-ellipse yi-$c^2=a^2-b^2$, i-hyperbola yi-$c^2=a^2+b^2$. Fumana i-$k$ kule equation.
geo_conicParam.explanation: Ekubeni umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini ngu-$2c={fd}$, $c={c}$, $c^2={c2}$. Ekubeni ${work}$, $k={ans}$.

geo_conicTangentLine.prompt: Kumgca ${ln}$ ochukumisa ijika ${eq}$, lithini ixabiso elilungileyo le-$k$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Faka i-equation yomgca kwi-equation yejika ukwenza i-equation yesikwere ye-$x$, kwaye ukuba iyachukumisa, i-discriminant ngu-$0$.
Fumana intetho ye-$k$ kwi-discriminant $D=0$.
geo_conicTangentLine.explanation: Ukufaka i-equation yomgca kwi-equation yejika kunika i-equation yesikwere ye-$x$, ${quad}$, kwaye ekubeni iyachukumisa, i-discriminant $D=0$. Ekubeni ${work}$, i-$k$ elungileyo ngu-${ans}$.

geo_divPoint.prompt: Kumanqaku amabini $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ egumbini lolungelelwaniso, inqaku P likwisiqwenga somgca AB kwaye $AP:PB={m}:{n}$. Luthini isiphumo sokudibanisa sazo zontathu iikhodineyithi zenqaku P? (Bhala inani eliphelele. Ukuba linegethivu, yongeza -)
hints: Inqaku elahlula isiqwenga somgca AB ngaphakathi nge-$m:n$ lineekhodineyithi $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n},\ \frac{mz_2+nz_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Bala ikhodineyithi nganye ngokwahlukeneyo.
geo_divPoint.explanation: $P=\left(\frac{{n}\,x_A+{m}\,x_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,y_A+{m}\,y_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,z_A+{m}\,z_B}{{mn}}\right)={pp}$, ngoko isiphumo sokudibanisa sazo zontathu iikhodineyithi singu-${ans}$.

geo_divRatioPlane.prompt: Kumanqaku amabini $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ egumbini lolungelelwaniso, vumela i-P libe lelinqaku apho isiqwenga somgca AB sidibana nomphezulu ${pl}$. Ukuba $AP:PB=m:n$ ($m$, $n$ ngamanani endalo angabalwa kunye ngaphandle kwe-1), lithini ixabiso le-$m+n$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Inqaku elikumphezulu ${pl}$ linekhodineyithi enye engu-$0$.
Veza loo khodineyithi yenqaku elahlula isiqwenga somgca AB ngaphakathi nge-$s:t$ ngokuthi $s$, $t$ uze ubeke ilingane no-$0$.
geo_divRatioPlane.explanation: Ukuba $AP:PB=s:t$, ikhodineyithi efanelekileyo yenqaku P kufuneka ibe ngu-$\frac{t\cdot({za})+s\cdot({zb})}{s+t}=0$, ngoko $s:t=|{za}|:|{zb}|={ua}:{ub}$. Emva kokwenza lula ngokungabaleki kunye, i-${m}:{n}$, ngoko $m+n={ans}$.

geo_dotAngle.prompt: Ukuba ubungakanani bekona eyenziwa ziivektha ezimbini $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ buyi-$\theta$ ($0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$), lithini ixabiso le-$\theta$? (Bhala inani kuphela kwiidigri)
hints: I-cosine yekona eyenziwa ziivektha ezimbini ngu-$\cos\theta=\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$.
Fumana i-dot product nobukhulu beevektha ezimbini ngokwahlukeneyo.

geo_dotNormExpand.prompt: Kwiivektha ezimbini $\vec a$, $\vec b$, xa $|\vec a|={na}$, $|\vec b|={nb}$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, lithini ixabiso le-$|{ex}|^2$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ekubeni $|\vec x|^2=\vec x\cdot\vec x$, yandise ${ex}$ ngokuyenza i-dot product nayo ngokwayo.
Yibonise ngokwe-$|\vec a|^2$, $|\vec b|^2$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ uze ufake amaxabiso.

geo_ellipseExtSum.prompt: Vumela iziko elinye le-ellipse ${eq}$ libe yi-$F({fx},\ {fy})$, kwaye ulungelelwaniso lwenqaku elinye ngaphakathi kwe-ellipse lube yi-$A({xa},\ {ya})$. Xa inqaku P kwi-ellipse lishukuma, luthini isiphumo sokuphindaphinda ixabiso eliphezulu nelincinci le-$PA+PF$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba elinye iziko yi-F', $PF=2a-PF'$. Ngoko $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$.
Ngokungalingani kwonxantathu, $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, kwaye ekubeni A ingaphakathi kwe-ellipse, zombini iimeko zokulingana zinokwenzeka.
geo_ellipseExtSum.explanation: Ukuba elinye iziko yi-F', $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$, kwaye $a={a}$, $AF'={dd}$. Ekubeni $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, ixabiso eliphezulu li-$2a+AF'={mx}$, ixabiso elincinci li-$2a-AF'={mn}$, kwaye isiphumo sokuphindaphinda singu-${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFocal.prompt: Vumela iziko ezimbini ze-ellipse ${eq}$ zibe yi-F, F'. Xa inqaku P kwi-ellipse ${cond}$, lithini ixabiso le-${ask}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Isiphumo sokudibanisa semigama esuka kwinqaku kwi-ellipse ukuya kwiziko ezimbini asiguquki, kwaye ixabiso lalo bubude be-major axis.
Ukuba ubude be-major axis bungu-$2a$ kwaye umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini ngu-$2c$, $a={a}$, $c={c}$. Zama ukusebenzisa i-$PF+PF'=2a$.
geo_ellipseFocal.explanation: Ekubeni ubude be-major axis bungu-$2a={tw}$ kwaye umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini ngu-$2c={tc}$, $PF+PF'={tw}$, $FF'={tc}$. Ekubeni ${work}$, ixabiso elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFromEq.prompt: Ungakanani umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini ze-ellipse ${eq}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba uguqula i-equation ye-ellipse ibe sisimbo $\frac{x^2}{\square}+\frac{y^2}{\square}=1$ apho icala lasekunene li-$1$, enkulu kwizihlukanisi ezimbini yi-$a^2$.
Izihlukanisi ezimbini zi-${a2}$ kunye ne-${b2}$, kwaye $c^2=a^2-b^2$.
geo_ellipseFromEq.explanation: Ukuyibonisa kwisimbo ${std}$, $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, ngoko $c^2=a^2-b^2={c2}$, $c={c}$. Umgama phakathi kweziko ezimbini ngu-$2c={ans}$.

geo_ellipseRightTri.prompt: Vumela iziko ezimbini ze-ellipse ${eq}$ zibe yi-F, F'. Xa inqaku P kwi-ellipse lanelisa $\angle FPF'=90^\circ$, indawo yonxantathu PFF' ithini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuchaza kwe-ellipse, $PF+PF'=2a$, kwaye ekubeni unxantathu unekona eyiyo, $PF^2+PF'^2=(FF')^2$.
Sebenzisa $(PF+PF')^2=PF^2+PF'^2+2\,PF\cdot PF'$ ukufumana i-$PF\cdot PF'$.
geo_ellipseRightTri.explanation: Ekubeni $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, $c^2={c2}$, $PF+PF'=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. Ekubeni $PF^2+PF'^2={tc2}$, $2\,PF\cdot PF'=({tw})^2-{tc2}$, oko kukuthi $PF\cdot PF'={pr}$. Indawo ngu-$\frac{1}{2}\times PF\times PF'={ans}$.

geo_hyperAsym.prompt: Phakathi kwee-asymptote ezimbini ze-hyperbola ${eq}$, ithambeka lomgca onethambeka eliyinani elifanelekileyo liyintoni? (Bhala njengeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ii-asymptote ze-hyperbola $\frac{x^2}{a^2}-\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ ngu-$y=\pm\frac{b}{a}x$, kwaye ii-asymptote ze-$\frac{y^2}{a^2}-\frac{x^2}{b^2}=1$ ngu-$y=\pm\frac{a}{b}x$.
Ukuba macala asekunene olingano akayi-$1$, qala ngokwenza macala asekunene abe yi-$1$, uze ufunde u-$a^2$, $b^2$ kwiimpawu ezingaphantsi ze-$x^2$, $y^2$.
geo_hyperAsym.explanation: Kuba ifom ye-${std}$, ii-asymptote zi-${asy}$. Ithambeka le-asymptote enethambeka eliyinani elifanelekileyo li-${ansf}$.

geo_hyperFocal.prompt: Masibize ii-fokhasi ezimbini ze-hyperbola ${eq}$ ngokuthi F, F'. Xa ichaphaza P kwi-hyperbola ${cond}$, ixabiso le-${ask}$ liyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ixabiso eliqinisekileyo lomahluko wemigama esuka kwichaphaza elikwi-hyperbola ukuya kwii-fokhasi ezimbini lilingana nobude bendlela ephambili $2a$.
Kuba $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, kwaye umgama osuka kwichaphaza elikwi-hyperbola ukuya kwifokhasi nganye uyalingana okanye uyancipha kune-$c-a={ca}$.
geo_hyperFocal.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ kwaye $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$. Kuba ${work}$, i-P ikwintsimi eseluhlangothini olusondele ku-F kwaye $PF'>PF$. (Ukuba $PF'=PF-2a$, ${alt}$ iya kuba ngaphantsi kune-$c-a$, oko akunakwenzeka.) Ngoko ke, kuba ${work2}$, ixabiso elifunekayo li-${ans}$.

geo_hyperFocalRel.prompt: Masibize ii-fokhasi ezimbini ze-hyperbola ${eq}$ ngokuthi F, F'. Xa ichaphaza P kwi-hyperbola ${cond}$, ixabiso le-${ask}$ liyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ixabiso eliqinisekileyo lomahluko wemigama esuka kwichaphaza elikwi-hyperbola ukuya kwii-fokhasi ezimbini lilingana nobude bendlela ephambili $2a$.
Kuba $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, kwaye umgama osuka kwichaphaza elikwi-hyperbola ukuya kwifokhasi nganye uyalingana okanye uyancipha kune-$c-a={ca}$.

geo_lineIntersectParam.prompt: Xa imigca emibini esesithubeni ${l1}$, ${l2}$ idibana kwichaphaza elinye, ixabiso lomqondo ongatshintshiyo $k$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani eliphelele. Ukuba liyinegethivu, yongeza -)
hints: Beka ixabiso eliqhelekileyo lomgca ngamnye njenge-$s$, $t$ uze uchaze ikhowudinethi zamachaphaza akumgca ngo-$s$, $t$.
Fumana u-$s$, $t$ kulingano lokuba ikhowudinethi ze-$x$, $y$ ziyalingana, uze uthelekise ikhowudinethi ye-$z$.
geo_lineIntersectParam.explanation: Ukuba ixabiso eliqhelekileyo lomgca wokuqala li-$s$ nelomgca wesibini li-$t$, ikhowudinethi ze-$x$, $y$ kufuneka zilingane, ngoko ${xy}$, kwaye ngokusombulula, $s={ss}$, $t={tt}$. Ikhowudinethi ye-$z$ kufuneka ilingane, ngoko ${eq3}$ kwaye $k={ans}$.

geo_lineSpacePoint.prompt: Phakathi kwamachaphaza akumgca ${ln}$, kukho ichaphaza apho ${cond}$. Isimbuku sezinye ikhowudinethi ezimbini zeli chaphaza siyintoni? (Bhala inani eliphelele. Ukuba liyinegethivu, yongeza -)
hints: Ukuba ixabiso eliqhelekileyo lamaqhezu amathathu li-$s$, onke $x$, $y$, $z$ anokuchazwa ngo-$s$.
Qala ngokufumana u-$s$ ngemeko enikiweyo ${cond}$.
geo_lineSpacePoint.explanation: Ukuba ixabiso eliqhelekileyo li-$s$, $(x,\ y,\ z)=({par})$. Ukususela ku-${cond}$, $s={ss}$, ngoko eli chaphaza li-${pt}$, kwaye isimbuku sezinye ikhowudinethi ezimbini si-${ans}$.

geo_parFocusDir.prompt: Kwichaphaza $P(x,\ y)$ elikwiparabola enefokhasi $F({fx},\ {fy})$ kunye ne-directrix ${dirEq}$, xa ${cond}$, ixabiso eliphezulu le-${un}$ liyintoni? (Bhala inani eliphelele. Ukuba liyinegethivu, yongeza -)
hints: Ichaphaza elikwiparabola linomgama olinganayo ukuya kwifokhasi nokuya kwi-directrix.
Incopho ikumbindi wefokhasi kunye ne-directrix. Qala ngokumisela ulingano lweparabola enencopho $({vx},\ {vy})$ kunye no-$p={pp}$.
geo_parFocusDir.explanation: Kuba incopho li-$({vx},\ {vy})$ kwaye $p={pp}$, ulingano lweparabola li-${eqn}$. Xa ${cond}$, ${un}={sol}$, ngoko ixabiso eliphezulu le-${un}$ li-${ans}$.

geo_parMinSum.prompt: Masibize ifokhasi yeparabola ${eq}$ ngokuthi F, kwaye ikhowudinethi zechaphaza A zibe $({xa},\ {ya})$. Xa ichaphaza P kwiparabola lihamba, ixabiso eliphantsi lika-$PA+PF$ liyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Umgama $PF$ osuka kwichaphaza P kwiparabola ukuya kwifokhasi ulingana nomgama osuka ku-P ukuya kwi-directrix.
Ukuba isiseko somgca omi nkqo osuka ku-P ukuya kwi-directrix si-H, u-$PA+PH$ ubuncinci xa u-A, P, H bekumgca omnye.
geo_parMinSum.explanation: I-directrix i-${dir}$. Kuba ichaphaza A likwingaphakathi yeparabola (${chk}$), ukuba isiseko somgca omi nkqo osuka ku-P ukuya kwi-directrix si-H, ixabiso eliphantsi lika-$PA+PF=PA+PH$ ngumgama osuka ku-A ukuya kwi-directrix, ${ans}$.

geo_planeNormal.prompt: Kwichaphaza $A{pa}$, indawo ethe tyaba edlula ku-A kwaye imi nkqo kwivektha $\vec n=({vn})$ idibana ne-axis ye-${ax}$ kwichaphaza elineekhowudinethi ye-${ax}$ eyintoni? (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjenge-3/4)
hints: Ukuba ivektha yendawo yechaphaza P nayiphi na kwindawo ethe tyaba ngu-$\vec p$, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$.
Qala ufumane ulingano lwendawo ethe tyaba $ax+by+cz=d$, uze usebenzise into yokuba amachaphaza akwi-axis ye-${ax}$ anezinye ikhowudinethi ezimbini ezi-$0$.
geo_planeNormal.explanation: Kwichaphaza P kwindawo ethe tyaba, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$, ngoko ulingano lwendawo ethe tyaba li-${plane}$. Amachaphaza akwi-axis ye-${ax}$ anezinye ikhowudinethi ezimbini ezi-$0$, ngoko ukusuka ku-${solve}$, ikhowudinethi ye-${ax}$ li-${ans}$.

geo_projEllipse.prompt: Kwindawo ethe tyaba $\alpha$ kukho isetyhula eneradiyasi ${rr}$. Ukuyibeka isetyhula ngokuthe nkqo kwindawo ethe tyaba $\beta$ kunika i-ellipse. Xa ubungakanani bekona eyenziwa yindawo ezimbini ethe tyaba $\alpha$, $\beta$ bubizwa ngokuthi $\theta$ kwaye $\cos\theta={cs}$, umgama phakathi kweefokhasi ezimbini zale ellipse uyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Phakathi kweedayamitha zesetyhula, ezo zihambelana nomgca wokudibana kwezindawo ezimbini ethe tyaba azitshintshi bude, kwaye ezo zimi nkqo zincipha ngokuphindwe ngo-$\cos\theta$.
Fumana ubude beaksisi enkulu $2a$ nobude beaksisi encinci $2b$ ye-ellipse ebekwe ngokuthe nkqo uze ubale $c=\sqrt{a^2-b^2}$.
geo_projEllipse.explanation: Ubude beaksisi enkulu ye-ellipse ebekwe ngokuthe nkqo ngu-$2a=2\times {rr}$, ubude beaksisi encinci ngu-$2b=2\times {rr}\cos\theta=2\times {bb}$, ngoko $a={rr}$, $b={bb}$. Kuba $c=\sqrt{{rr}^2-{bb}^2}={cc}$, umgama phakathi kweefokhasi ezimbini ngu-$2c={ans}$.

geo_projPlaneArea.prompt: Indawo yomfanekiso onendawo ye-${ar}$ okwindawo ethe tyaba ${pl}$, ebekwe ngokuthe nkqo kwindawo ethe tyaba ye-${cp}$, iyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba ikona phakathi kwendawo ethe tyaba enomfanekiso nendawo ethe tyaba ye-${cp}$ ngu-$\theta$, indawo ebekwe ngokuthe nkqo yi-(indawo yomfanekiso)$\times\cos\theta$.

Ikona $\theta$ phakathi kwezindawo ezimbini ethe tyaba ithathwa ngo-$0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ$, ngoko $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec n_1\cdot\vec n_2|}{|\vec n_1||\vec n_2|}$ (ixabiso eliqinisekileyo le-dot product yeevektha ezimbini eziqhelekileyo lahlulwe ngemveliso yobukhulu bazo).
geo_projPlaneArea.explanation: Ivektha eqhelekileyo yendawo ethe tyaba ${pl}$ ngu-$({nv})$ kwaye ubukhulu bayo bu-${nn}$. Ivektha eqhelekileyo yendawo ethe tyaba ye-${cp}$ ngu-$({cn})$, ngoko $\cos\theta=\frac{|{ns}|}{{nn}}=\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}$, kwaye indawo ebekwe ngokuthe nkqo yi-${ar}\times\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}={ans}$.

geo_spaceDist.prompt: Umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ esithubeni sekhowudinethi uyintoni? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini $(x_1,\ y_1,\ z_1)$, $(x_2,\ y_2,\ z_2)$ esithubeni sekhowudinethi ngu-$\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2+(z_2-z_1)^2}$.
Qala ufumane umahluko wekhowudinethi ezintathu.

geo_sphereExpand.prompt: Xa i-equation ${eq}$ imela isiqhelo esinobude beradiyasi be-${rad}$, lingakanani ixabiso lenombolo engatshintshiyo $s$? (Bhala ngenani eliphelele. Ukuba ayilunganga, faka -)
hints: Guqula u-$x$, $y$, $z$ ngamnye abe sisikwere esipheleleyo ukuze wenze isimo se-$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2+(z-c)^2=r^2$.
Icala lasekunene kufuneka libe yi-$r^2={rad2}$.
geo_sphereExpand.explanation: Xa kuguqulwa kube zizikwere ezipheleleyo, yi-${std}$. Isikwere seradiyasi yi-${s4}-s={rad2}$, ngoko $s={s4}-{rad2}={ans}$.

geo_sphereSection.prompt: Icandelo lesiqhelo ${eq}$ elinqunyulwe yindiza ${pl}$ lisisangqa. Ukuba indawo yesi sangqa ngu-$m\pi$, lingakanani ixabiso lenani lendalo $m$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Funda iziko lesiqhelo nesikwere seradiyasi kwi-equation.
Ngokufumana umgama $d$ ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kwindiza, iradiyasi $r$ yecandelo yi-$r^2=R^2-d^2$.
geo_sphereSection.explanation: Iziko lesiqhelo li-${cc}$, isikwere seradiyasi yi-$R^2={rr2}$. Umgama ukusuka kwiziko ukuya kwindiza ${pl}$ ngu-$d={dd}$, ngoko isikwere seradiyasi yesangqa secandelo yi-${rr2}-{dd}^2={ans}$ kwaye indawo yi-${ans}\pi$.

geo_sphereTangentPlane.prompt: Kwindiza ${pl}$ echukumisa isiqhelo esinesiko $C{cc}$ nobude beradiyasi be-${rad}$, lelona xabiso likhulu lenombolo engatshintshiyo $k$ liyintoni? (Bhala ngenani eliphelele. Ukuba ayilunganga, faka -)
hints: Ukuba iyachukumisa, umgama ukusuka kwiziko lesiqhelo ukuya kwindiza ulingana neradiyasi.
Umgama phakathi kweqhosha $(x_0,\ y_0,\ z_0)$ nendiza $ax+by+cz=k$ yi-$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+cz_0-k|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
geo_sphereTangentPlane.explanation: Ubukhulu be-normal vector $({nv})$ bungu-${nn}$ kwaye ukufaka iziko kwi-equation yendiza kunika ${dc}$. Ukusuka kumgama $\frac{|{dc}-k|}{{nn}}={rad}$, $|{dc}-k|={rl}$, ngoko $k={dc}\pm{rl}$, kwaye elona xabiso likhulu li-${ans}$.

geo_tangentAt.prompt: Yeyiphi indawo yonxantathu ozaliswe yitangenti kwiqhosha $P({x0},\ {y0})$ kwikhaphu ${eq}$ kunye ne-axis ye-$x$ ne-axis ye-$y$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Itangenti kwiqhosha $(x_1,\ y_1)$ kwikhaphu ifunyanwa ngokutshintsha u-$x^2\to x_1x$, $y^2\to y_1y$ (kwiparabola, $y^2\to y_1y$, $x\to\frac{x+x_1}{2}$).
Fumana i-$x$-intercept ne-$y$-intercept ukusuka kwi-equation yetangenti uze ubale $\frac{1}{2}\times|x\text{-intercept}|\times|y\text{-intercept}|$.
geo_tangentAt.explanation: I-equation yetangenti yi-${tan}$, i-$x$-intercept yi-${xi}$, kwaye i-$y$-intercept yi-${yi}$. Ngoko indawo yi-$\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={ansf}$.

geo_tangentsFromPoint.prompt: Yimalini imveliso yemithambeko yeetangenti ezimbini ezityhilwe kwiqhosha $({x1},\ {y1})$ ukuya kwikhaphu ${eq}$? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Thatha umthambeko wetangenti njenge-$m$ uze ufake umgca ${lnp}$ odlula kwiqhosha $({x1},\ {y1})$ kwi-equation yekhaphu.
Ukusuka kwimeko yokuchukumisa (i-discriminant $=0$) kuvela i-quadratic equation ye-$m$, kwaye imithambeko yeetangenti ezimbini yizimvo zayo.
geo_tangentsFromPoint.explanation: Ukufaka umgca ${lnp}$ kwi-equation yekhaphu, i-discriminant ye-quadratic equation ye-$x$ kufuneka ibe ngu-$0$, ngoko imithambeko $m$ yetangenti zizimvo ezimbini ze-quadratic equation ${quad}=0$. Ngobudlelwane phakathi kwezimvo nee-coefficient, imveliso yemithambeko yeetangenti ezimbini yi-${prod}$.

geo_threePerp.prompt: Kwiqhosha P elingaphandle kwindiza $\alpha$, ukuthe nkqo kwehliswa kwi-$\alpha$ kunesiseko H, ukusuka kwi-H kumgca osendizeni $\alpha$ ongu-$\ell$ ukuthe nkqo kunesiseko K, kwaye iqhosha A elahlukileyo kuK likhethwa kumgca $\ell$. Masibe umgama ukusuka kwiqhosha P ukuya kumgca $\ell$ ngu-$d$. Xa ${giv}$, lingakanani ixabiso le-${ask}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kuba $PH\perp\alpha$, $HK\perp\ell$, ngethiyori yokuthe nkqo kathathu $PK\perp\ell$.
Sebenzisa ithiyori kaPythagoras ngokulandelelana kwonxantathu abanekona ethe ngqo abafunyenwe ngethiyori yokuthe nkqo kathathu.
geo_threePerp.explanation: Kuba $PH\perp\alpha$, $HK\perp\ell$, ngethiyori yokuthe nkqo kathathu $PK\perp\ell$. Ngenxa yokuba ${work}$, ixabiso elifunwayo li-${ans}$.

geo_vecCircleEq.prompt: Masibe ngu-$\vec a$, $\vec b$ ii-position vector zamanqaku $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ngokulandelelana, kwaye u-$\vec p$ ibe yi-position vector yenqaku P. Yintoni ubude berediyasi yesangqa eyenziwa ngamanqaku onke P anelisa $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$? (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjengo-3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kuthetha ukuba ii-vector ezimbini $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ zime ngqo.
Yikona ingakanani eyenziwa ngecandelo AB lijongwa kwinqaku P?
geo_vecCircleEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kuthetha ukuba P ikwisangqa ene-diameter yicandelo AB. Ngenxa yokuba $AB={ab}$, ubude berediyasi yi-$\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

geo_vecDecompose.prompt: Xa $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, $\vec c={vc}$, kwii-real number $m$, $n$ ezenza $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$, ixabiso le-${ask}$ lithini? (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjengo-3/4)
hints: Bhala iindawo ze-$m\vec a+n\vec b$ ngo-$m$, $n$ uze uzibeke zilingane neendawo ze-$\vec c$.
Sombulula iinkqubo zezibalo ngo-$m$, $n$ ezifunyenwe kwiindawo ezimbini.

geo_vecDotParam.prompt: Kwii-vector ezimbini $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, xa $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dd}$, lelona likhulu kakhulu lamaxabiso e-real number $t$ lithini? (Bhala njengenombolo epheleleyo. Ukuba ayilunganga, yongeza -)
hints: Phindaphinda iindawo uze udibanise ukubhala $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ njengentetho ye-$t$.
Sombulula isibalo esifunyenweyo ukufumana onke amaxabiso e-$t$ uze ukhethe elona likhulu.
geo_vecDotParam.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, izisombululo zesibalo ${dexp}={dd}$ zi-${sol}$. Elona lixabiso likhulu kuzo yi-${ans}$.

geo_vecLinComb.prompt: Xa $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, ixabiso le-$|{ex}|$ lithini? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Isixa see-vector nokuphindaphinda ngee-real number kubalwa ngeendawo.
Qala ufumane iindawo ze-${ex}$, uze ufumane ingcambu yesikwere elungileyo yesixa sezikwere zeendawo.

geo_vecOrthoParam.prompt: Xa ii-vector ezimbini $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ zime ngqo omnye komnye, ixabiso le-real number $t$ lithini? (Bhala njengenombolo epheleleyo. Ukuba ayilunganga, yongeza -)
hints: I-dot product yee-vector ezimbini ezime ngqo ngu-$0$.
Phindaphinda iindawo uze udibanise ukubhala $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ njengentetho ye-$t$.
geo_vecOrthoParam.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba ii-vector ezimbini zime ngqo, $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. Ngenxa yokuba $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, ukusombulula isibalo ${dexp}=0$ kunika ${sol}$.

geo_vecSphereEq.prompt: Masibe ngu-$\vec a$, $\vec b$ ii-position vector zamanqaku $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ngokulandelelana, kwaye u-$\vec p$ ibe yi-position vector yenqaku P. Yintoni ubude berediyasi ye-sphere eyenziwa ngamanqaku onke P anelisa $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$? (Ungabhala njengedesimali okanye njengeqhezu elinjengo-3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kuthetha ukuba ii-vector ezimbini $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ zime ngqo.
Yikona ingakanani eyenziwa ngecandelo AB lijongwa kwinqaku P?
geo_vecSphereEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kuthetha ukuba P ikwi-sphere ene-diameter yicandelo AB. Ngenxa yokuba $AB={ab}$, ubude berediyasi yi-$\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

job_boxTunnel.prompt: Kwibloko yomthi eyimilo yebhokisi enobubanzi be-${a}$ cm, ubude be-${b}$ cm, ukuphakama kwe-${c}$ cm, kwenziwe umngxuma oyimilo yebhokisi ongange-${p}$ cm ububanzi nange-${q}$ cm ubude, uthe ngqo usuka embindini wobuso obungaphezulu uye kobuso obungezantsi (umngxuma awuchukumisi macala ebloko). Xa ubuso bangaphakathi bomngxuma buyabalwa kwindawo yobuso, yeyiphi indawo yobuso yebloko enomngxuma ngee-cm²? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Xa kuyilwa umngxuma, ubuso obungaphezulu nobungezantsi bunciphisa ngokomlinganiselo wecandelo lomngxuma.
Endaweni yoko kubakho ubuso obune bangaphakathi bomngxuma obutsha.
job_boxTunnel.explanation: Indawo yobuso phambi kokwenza umngxuma yi-$2({a}\times{b}+{b}\times{c}+{c}\times{a})={s0}$ cm². Susa ${p}\times{q}$ kabini kubuso obungaphezulu nobungezantsi, uze wongeze ubuso obune bangaphakathi $2({p}+{q})\times{c}$, ngoko ${s0}-{pq2}+{inn}={ans}$ cm².

job_boxesCeil.prompt: Iinxalenye ezingu-${n}$ zipakishwa kwibhokisi nganye zibe zingu-${k}$, kwaye iibhokisi zithuthwa zibekwe zibe zingu-${m}$ kwipalethi nganye. Nokuba kusele iinxalenye ezimbalwa zibekwa kwibhokisi enye, kwaye nokuba kusele iibhokisi ezimbalwa zibekwa kwipalethi enye. Zingaphi iipalethi ezifunekayo ubuncinane? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba akuhlulwa ngqo, kufuneka enye ibhokisi (ipalethi) yokubeka eseleyo.
Qala ufumane inani leebhokisi ezifunekayo, uze ufumane inani lamapalethi ngendlela efanayo.
job_boxesCeil.explanation: Kufuneka iibhokisi ezingu-${bx}$, ezifunyenwe ngokuqukumbela phezulu ixabiso le-${n}\div{k}$, kwaye kufuneka iipalethi ezingu-${ans}$, ezifunyenwe ngokuqukumbela phezulu ixabiso le-${bx}\div{m}$.

job_chanceDraw.prompt: Kwibhokisi kukho iinxalenye ezingu-${n}$, kwaye ezingu-${d}$ phakathi kwazo zinemiphunga. Xa ukhupha iinxalenye ezi-2 ngaxeshanye ngokungakhethi, ithuba lokuba ubuncinane enye ibe nephutha yintoni? (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Zonke iimeko ezinokwenzeka yinani lezindlela zokukhetha ezi-2 kwezingu-${n}$.
Okuchasene no 'ubuncinane enye inephutha' yi 'zombini zilungile'.
job_chanceDraw.explanation: Zonke iimeko zi-$_{{n}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={tot}$, kwaye iimeko apho zombini zilungile zi-$_{{g}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={good}$. Ithuba elifunwayo li-$1-\frac{{good}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

job_floorPlan.prompt: Igumbi elimile okwengxande lineebubanzi ezi-${a}$ m nobude be-${b}$ m. Kwelinye icala lodonga olunobubanzi kumbindi kunegumbi elimile okwengxande elinobubanzi be-${d}$ m nobunzulu be-${c}$ m elincamathele ngaphandle (${d}<{a}$ kwaye alichukumisi iikona zegumbi). Kunamathelwa ibhodi lezinyawo ecaleni kodonga lonke lwangaphakathi legumbi, kodwa hayi kwindawo yocango olunobubanzi be-${w}$ m. Ubude beebhodi zezinyawo ezifunekayo bungaphi ngeemitha?  (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Zoba ukuze ucinge ukuba umjikelezo wesimo esinegumbi elincanyathelisiweyo wahluka njani kowendala yengxande.
Ecaleni elinye elinobubanzi be-${d}$ m liyanyamalala, kodwa kuvela amacala amabini anobunzulu be-${c}$ m necala elinye elinobubanzi be-${d}$ m.
job_floorPlan.explanation: Umjikelezo wegumbi lonke yi-$2({a}+{b})+2\times{c}={per}$ m (icala elinobubanzi be-${d}$ m litshintshwa ngamacala amabini anobunzulu be-${c}$ m necala elinobubanzi be-${d}$ m, ngoko kongezeleka amacala amabini e-${c}$ m). Ukuba ususa indawo yocango ye-${w}$ m, ${per}-{w}={ans}$ m.

job_flowUnits.prompt: Kumbhobho wesihluzi samanzi kuphuma amanzi ayi-${r}$ mL kumzuzu omnye ngokuzinzileyo. Ukuba lo mbhobho uvulwa ngokuqhubekayo iiyure ezi-${h}$ nemizuzu emi-${m}$, mangaphi onke amanzi aphumayo ngeelitha (L)? (1 L = 1000 mL, kwaye bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Guqula ixesha lonke libe yimizuzu ukufumana ixesha lokuvulwa.
Fumana ii-mL ngokuthi (isixa ngomzuzu)×(imizuzu), uze wahlule nge-1000 ukuze ube ziilitha.
job_flowUnits.explanation: Ixesha lokuvulwa yi-${h}\times60+{m}={tot}$ imizuzu, kwaye amanzi aphumayo yi-${r}\times{tot}={ml}$ mL. ${ml}\div1000={ans}$ L.

job_markupProfit.prompt: Evenkileni, kuntengiso enexabiso lokuqala le-${c}$ rhando, kongezwa inzuzo ye-${u}$% yexabiso lokuqala ukumisela ixabiso lokuthengisa, kwaye ngokunikezela isaphulelo se-${d}$% yelo xabiso kuthengiswa zonke izinto ezingu-${n}$. Yintoni isixa senzuzo ephela ngokuthelekisa nexabiso lokuqala ngerhando? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ixabiso lokuthengisa yi-$(100+{u})$% yexabiso lokuqala.
Ixabiso lokuthengisa yi-$(100-{d})$% yexabiso lokuthengisa, kwaye inzuzo yento enye yi-(ixabiso lokuthengisa)−(ixabiso lokuqala).
job_markupProfit.explanation: Ixabiso lokuthengisa yi-${c}\times\frac{{100+u}}{100}={lp}$ rhando, kwaye ixabiso lokuthengisa ekugqibeleni yi-${lp}\times\frac{{100-d}}{100}={sp}$ rhando. Inzuzo yento enye yi-${sp}-{c}={g}$ rhando, ngoko inzuzo yezi-${n}$ yi-${g}\times{n}={ans}$ rhando.

job_outfitCount.prompt: Kukho iintlobo ezingu-${s}$ zeempahla zasentla zomsebenzi neentlobo ezingu-${p}$ zeempahla zasezantsi, kwaye kukho iintlobo ezingu-${h}$ zezigqoko. Khetha esinye isinxibo sentla nesinye sezantsi, kwaye isigqoko unokunxiba esinye kwezingu-${h}$ okanye ungasinxibi. Ngenxa yemigaqo yokhuseleko, kukho izibini (esentla, esezantsi) ezingu-${f}$ ezingenakunxitywa kunye. Zingaphi zonke iimpahla ezahlukeneyo ezinokunxitywa? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane inani lezibini (esentla, esezantsi) ezinokunxitywa.
Bala ukuba zingaphi iindlela zokukhetha esinye kwezingu-${h}$ zezigqoko okanye ukungasinxibi, uze uphindaphinde.
job_outfitCount.explanation: Izibini (esentla, esezantsi) zi-${s}\times{p}-{f}={ok}$, kwaye iindlela zesigqoko, kubandakanya ukungasinxibi, zi-${h}+1={hh}$. Ngomgaqo wemveliso, ${ok}\times{hh}={ans}$.

job_planCompare.prompt: Isicwangciso A sinentlawulo esisiseko yenyanga ye-${f1}$ won kunye ne-${p1}$ won ngokusetyenziswa kube kanye, kwaye isicwangciso B sinentlawulo esisiseko yenyanga ye-${f2}$ won kunye ne-${p2}$ won ngokusetyenziswa kube kanye. Ukuba inani lokusetyenziswa kwinyanga linga-$x$ ($x$ linani lendalo), yeyiphi elona $x$ lincinci apho intlawulo yenyanga yesicwangciso B iba ngaphantsi kweyesicwangciso A? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Chaza intlawulo yenyanga yezicwangciso ezibini ngo-$x$.
Sombulula inxaki (intlawulo ye-B)<(intlawulo ye-A) ukufumana uluhlu lwe-$x$.
job_planCompare.explanation: Intlawulo ye-A yi-${f1}+{p1}x$, kwaye intlawulo ye-B yi-${f2}+{p2}x$. Ukusuka ku-${f2}+{p2}x<{f1}+{p1}x$, ${dl}x>{df}$, oko kukuthi $x>\frac{{df}}{{dl}}$. Elona nani lendalo lincinci elifezekisa oku li-${ans}$.

job_ratioChain.prompt: Umlinganiselo wemveliso yemihla ngemihla yeenkqubo ezintathu A, B, C yi-A : B $={a}:{b}$, B : C $={c}:{d}$. Ukuba imveliso epheleleyo yemihla ngemihla yeenkqubo ezintathu ngu-${T}$, imveliso yemihla ngemihla yenkqubo C yimalini? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ngokusebenzisa i-B njengesiseko, dibanisa imilinganiselo emibini ibe ngumqolo omnye ukwenza i-A : B : C.
Wahlula imveliso epheleleyo ${T}$ ngesixa somlinganiselo we-A : B : C ukufumana ubungakanani bomlinganiselo omnye.
job_ratioChain.explanation: Ukulinganisa amaxabiso omlinganiselo we-B, A : B : C $={pa}:{pb}:{pc}$. Isixa somlinganiselo si-${S}$, ngoko inxalenye enye yi-${T}\div{S}={u}$, kwaye i-C yi-${pc}\times{u}={ans}$.

job_scaleDrawing.prompt: Kumzobo onesikali se-$1:{k}$, igumbi elimile okwengxande lizotyelwe linobubanzi be-${w}$ cm nobude be-${h}$ cm. Yeyiphi indawo yegumbi langempela ngee-m²? (1 m = 100 cm, kwaye bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba isikali yi-$1:{k}$, ukuphindaphinda ubude bomzobo nge-${k}$ kunika ubude bokwenyani.
Fumana ububanzi nobude bokwenyani ngee-cm, ubuguqule bube ziimitha, uze uphindaphinde.
job_scaleDrawing.explanation: Ububanzi bokwenyani yi-${w}\times{k}={rw}$ cm$={rwm}$ m, ubude bokwenyani yi-${h}\times{k}={rh}$ cm$={rhm}$ m, ngoko indawo yi-${rwm}\times{rhm}={ans}$ m².

job_tableRule.prompt: Le yitheyibhile yeentlawulo zokuqesha izixhobo. Ixesha lokuqeshisa lonyuka nge-1 iyure nganye, intlawulo yonyuka ngexabiso elithile. Iyure ye-${x1}$ yi-${y1}$ won, iyure ye-${x2}$ yi-${y2}$ won, iyure ye-${x3}$ yi-${y3}$ won. Yeyiphi intlawulo xa uqesha iiyure ezingu-${N}$ ngewon? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Fumana ukuba intlawulo yonyuka kangakanani xa ixesha lonyuka nge-1 iyure kwitheyibhile.
Chaza intlawulo ngesimo se-(imali eyongezwa ngeyure nganye)×(iiyure)+(imali esisiseko), uze ufumane imali esisiseko.
job_tableRule.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba yonyuka nge-${k}$ won ngeyure nganye, intlawulo inesimo se-$y={k}x+{b}$ (imali esisiseko ye-${b}$ won ifunyenwe ukuze kube yi-${y1}$ won kwiiyure ze-${x1}$). Kwiiyure ezingu-${N}$, ${k}\times{N}+{b}={ans}$ won.

job_workTogether.prompt: Umsebenzi A wenza iimveliso ezingu-${a}$ ngeyure nganye, kwaye umsebenzi B wenza ezingu-${b}$ ngeyure nganye ngesantya esizinzileyo. A uqala ukusebenza kuqala, kwaye emva kweeyure ezingu-${h}$ B uyajoyina. Ixesha elisebenzwe ngu-A de isixa semveliso eyenziwe bobabini sibe ngqo ngu-${N}$ liyiyure ezingaphi zizonke? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba ixesha lika-A lingama-$t$ iiyure, ixesha lika-B li-$t-{h}$ iiyure.
Misela i-equation yomgca (inani elenziwe ngu-A)+(inani elenziwe ngu-B)$={N}$.
job_workTogether.explanation: Ukuba A usebenza iiyure ezingu-$t$, B usebenza iiyure ezingu-$t-{h}$, ngoko ${a}t+{b}(t-{h})={N}$. Ukulungisa kunika ${ab}t={tot}$, ngoko $t={ans}$ iiyure.

pst_atLeast.prompt: Kwingxowa enamabhola amhlophe angu-${w}$ namabhola amnyama angu-${bk}$, xa kukhutshwa amabhola angu-${k}$ ngaxeshanye, fumana ithuba lokuba kuphume amabhola amhlophe angu-${r}$ okanye ngaphezulu. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Isiganeko esichasayo sika-'${r}$ okanye ngaphezulu' yimeko apho inani lamabhola amhlophe li-${zs}$.
Inani lamanani onke eendlela zokukhupha li-$\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$.
pst_atLeast.explanation: Isiganeko esichasayo yimeko apho inani lamabhola amhlophe li-${zs}$ kwaye inani leemeko zayo li-${bx}={bad}$. Inani lilonke li-$\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$, ngoko ithuba elifunwayo li-$1-\frac{{bad}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

pst_bayes.prompt: Kuphoswa idayisi efanelekileyo kanye, kwaye ukuba kuphuma inani le-${t}$ okanye ngaphantsi, kukhutshwa ibhola elinye kwibhokisi A, kungenjalo kwibhokisi B. Ibhokisi A inamabhola amhlophe angu-${w1}$ namabhola amnyama angu-${b1}$, kwaye ibhokisi B inamabhola amhlophe angu-${w2}$ namabhola amnyama angu-${b2}$. Xa ibhola elikhutshiweyo belilimhlophe, fumana ithuba lokuba livela kwibhokisi A. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: $P(A\mid \text{ibhola elimhlophe})=\frac{P(A\cap \text{ibhola elimhlophe})}{P(\text{ibhola elimhlophe})}$.
I-denominator yisixa sethuba lebhola elimhlophe elivela kwi-A nethuba lebhola elimhlophe elivela kwi-B.
pst_bayes.explanation: Ithuba lebhola elimhlophe elivela kwi-A li-${tA}$, nelivela kwi-B li-${tB}$, ngoko ithuba elifunwayo li-$\frac{{tA}}{{tA}+{tB}}={fr}$.

pst_bestOf.prompt: Amaqela amabini A, B adlala umdlalo, kwaye iqela eliphumelela kuqala amadlala angu-${w}$ liyawina. Kumdlalo ngamnye ithuba lokuba iqela A liwine li-${fp}$, imidlalo ayixhomekekanga komnye, kwaye akukho moya. Fumana ithuba lokuba iqela A liwine. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Cinga ngokwahlula ngokweyiphi umdlalo apho iqela A liphumelela okwesi-${w}$.
Ukuze liwine kumdlalo we-${w}+j$, kufuneka kubekho ukuphumelela kangu-${wm1}$ nokuphulukana kangu-$j$ kwimidlalo ye-${wm1}+j$ yangaphambili.
pst_bestOf.explanation: Ithuba lokuba iqela A liwine kumdlalo we-${w}+j$ ($j={jr}$) li-$\binom{{wm1}+j}{j}\left({fp}\right)^{{w}}\left(1-{fp}\right)^{j}$. Amaxabiso ngokulandelelana yi-${tm}$, ngoko ukudibanisa konke kunika ${fr}$.

pst_binomCoef2.prompt: Kwi-expansion ye-$({ax}{bs})^{{n}}$, fumana i-coefficient ye-$x^{{k}}$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Igama eliqhelekileyo le-binomial theorem linesimo se-$\binom{N}{j}A^{N-j}B^{j}$.
Fumana igama apho u-$x$ aphindaphindwa amaxesha angu-${k}$.
pst_binomCoef2.explanation: Kuba ligama apho u-$x$ ekhethwa amaxesha angu-${k}$ kwaye inombolo engatshintshiyo ikhethwa amaxesha angu-${nk}$, i-coefficient yi-$\binom{{n}}{{k}}\cdot{a}^{{k}}\cdot({b})^{{nk}}={ans}$.

pst_binomFindN.prompt: Xa i-random variable $X$ ilandela i-binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ kwaye $E(X)={mu}$, $V(X)={vr}$, fumana ixabiso le-$n$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukwahlula u-$V(X)$ ngo-$E(X)$ kunika u-$1-p$.
pst_binomFindN.explanation: Ngenxa yokuba $\frac{V(X)}{E(X)}=1-p$, $1-p={q}$, oko kukuthi $p={pp}$. Ukusuka ku-$np={mu}$, $n={ans}$.

pst_binomNormal.prompt: I-random variable $X$ ilandela i-binomial distribution $B({n},\ {pf})$. Ukusondeza u-$X$ ngokusebenzisa ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo (ngaphandle kokulungisa ukuqhubeka), fumana ixabiso le-$P({ev})$. Kwi-random variable $Z$ elandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo okusemgangathweni, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala ukuya kwindawo yesine yedesimali)
hints: I-binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ ingasondezwa ngo-$N(np,\ np(1-p))$ xa u-$n$ enkulu.
Yenza ube semgangathweni nge-(umndilili, i-standard deviation)=$({mu},\ {sg})$.
pst_binomNormal.explanation: $E(X)={mu}$, $\sigma(X)=\sqrt{{vr}}={sg}$, ngoko u-$X$ ulandela ngokusondeleyo u-$N({mu},\ {sg}^{2})$. Ukwenza ube semgangathweni nge-$Z=\frac{X-{mu}}{{sg}}$ kunika ${zs}$, ngoko $P({ev})\approx P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_binomPmfEq.prompt: Xa i-random variable $X$ ilandela i-binomial distribution $B({n},\ p)$ kwaye $P(X={r})=P(X={r1})$, fumana ixabiso le-$p$. (Qaphela: $0<p<1$) (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Bhala amathuba omabini ngesimo se-$\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ uze wahlule macala omabini ngento eqhelekileyo.
Ukulungisa kunika ixabiso le-$\frac{p}{1-p}$.
Ukusuka kwi-binomial theorem $(1+x)^{N}=\sum_{k=0}^{N}\binom{N}{k}x^{k}$, faka inani elifanelekileyo endaweni ka-$x$.
Misela ixabiso lika-$x$ ukuze $(1+x)^{N}$ ilingane nesixa.

pst_binomTail.prompt: Xa i-random variable $X$ ilandela i-binomial distribution $B({n},\ {pf})$, fumana ixabiso le-$P(X{rel}{t})$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: $P(X=j)=\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ ($N$ linani lamaxesha okuzama). Ukuba kukho amagama amaninzi okudibanisa, cinga ngesiganeko esichasayo.
Dibanisa amagama apho $j=$ ${js}$.
pst_binomTail.explanation: $P(X=j)=\binom{{n}}{j}\left({pf}\right)^{j}\left(1-{pf}\right)^{{n}-j}$ kwaye ithuba elifunwayo yisixa samaxabiso apho $j={js}$, $\frac{{tm}}{{D}}=\frac{{num}}{{D}}={fe}$.

pst_binomUnknown.prompt: Kwi-expansion ye-$(x+a)^{{n}}$, xa i-coefficient ye-$x^{{k}}$ ingu-${V}$, fumana ixabiso elilungileyo le-$a$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Zama ukuchaza i-coefficient ye-$x^{{k}}$ usebenzisa u-$a$.
Kuba $\binom{{n}}{{k}}={C}$, qala ufumane ixabiso le-$a^{{nk}}$.
pst_binomUnknown.explanation: I-coefficient ye-$x^{{k}}$ yi-$\binom{{n}}{{k}}a^{{nk}}={C}a^{{nk}}$, ngoko ${C}a^{{nk}}={V}$, oko kukuthi $a^{{nk}}={q}$. Kuba $a>0$, $a={ans}$.

pst_ciBounds.prompt: Kuhlobo lwabemi olulandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo ne-standard deviation ye-${s}$, kukhethwe isampulu enobukhulu be-${n}$ ngokungakhethi kwaye umndilili wesampulu wawungu-${xb}$. Xa i-confidence interval yomndilili wabemi $m$ ye-${cl}\%$ ingu-$a\le m\le b$, fumana ixabiso le-$b$. (Qaphela: ixabiso elihambelana ne-${cl}\%$ yi-$z={z}$.) (Bhala ngedesimali)
hints: I-confidence interval yi-$\overline{x}-z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\le m\le \overline{x}+z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.
Kuba $\sqrt{{n}}={rt}$, qala ufumane u-$\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.

pst_ciSampleSize.prompt: Kwisampuli ethathwe ngokungakhethiyo kubemi benani abalandela ukusasazwa okuqhelekileyo kunye ne-standard deviation yabemi ${s}$, xa kuqikelelwa isilinganiso sabemi ngokuthembeka kwe-${cl}\%$, fumana ubungakanani obuncinci besampuli $n$ obenza ubude bexesha lokuthembeka bube ngaphantsi okanye bulingane no-${L}$. (Ixabiso elihambelana nokuthembeka kwe-${cl}\%$ ngu-$z={z}$, kwaye u-$n$ linani lendalo.) (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ubude bexesha lokuthembeka ngu-$2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Sombulula esi sinxulumano ngo-$\sqrt{n}$ uze usikwere macala omabini. $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$
pst_ciSampleSize.explanation: Ubude bexesha lokuthembeka ngu-$2\times{z}\times\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$, ngoko $\sqrt{n}\ge\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}$, oko kukuthi $n\ge\left(\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}\right)^{2}{eq}{nq}$. Inani lendalo elincinci elanelisayo oku li-${ans}$.

pst_condDice.prompt: Iidayisi ezimbini ezifanelekileyo ezahlukeneyo ziphoswa ngaxeshanye, kwaye amanani avelayo ngu-$a,\ b$ ngokulandelelana. Masibize isiganeko $A$ ngokuthi '$a+b{rel}{t}$' nesiganeko $B$ ngokuthi '$a{relb}b$'. Fumana ithuba elinemeko $P(B\mid A)$. (Bhala njengeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane zonke iimeko ezikwisiganeko $A$.
$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$.
pst_condDice.explanation: Inani leemeko zesiganeko $A$ li-${nA}$, inani leemeko ze-$A\cap B$ li-${nAB}$. Ngoko $P(B\mid A)={fe}$.

pst_condTable.prompt: Kubafundi aba-${N}$ beklabhu ethile, abafana ngu-${m}$, abafundi abanxibe iiglasi ngu-${g}$, kwaye abafana abanxibe iiglasi ngu-${x}$. Xa kuthathwa ngokungakhethiyo umfundi omnye kweli klabhu engenanxibo yeglasi, fumana ithuba lokuba lo mfundi ngumntwana wentombazana. (Bhala njengeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Yenza itheyibhile uze uzalise abafundi kwiibhokisi ezine zomfana/intombazana, unxibe iiglasi/akanxibanga.
Kwithuba elinemeko $P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$, u-$A$ ngu-'akanxibanga iiglasi'.
pst_condTable.explanation: Zikho iintombazana ezingu-${f}$ kwaye iintombazana ezinxibe iiglasi zingu-${g}-{x}={gy}$, ngoko iintombazana ezingenanxibo yeglasi zingu-${f}-{gy}={fn}$. Abafundi abangenanxibo yeglasi baba-${N}-{g}={ng}$, ngoko ithuba li-${fe}$.

pst_deMorgan.prompt: Kwiziganeko ezimbini $A,\ B$, xa ${gv}$, fumana ixabiso le-$P({ev})$. (Bhala njengedesimali)
hints: Zoba umzobo we-Venn uze uwahlulele kwiindawo ezine: $A\cap B$, $A\cap B^{c}$, $A^{c}\cap B$, $A^{c}\cap B^{c}$.
$P(A\cap B^{c})=P(A)-P(A\cap B)$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)=P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Ungasebenzisa nomthetho ka-De Morgan $(A\cup B)^{c}=A^{c}\cap B^{c}$, $(A\cap B)^{c}=A^{c}\cup B^{c}$ kunye no-$P(E^{c})=1-P(E)$.
pst_deMorgan.explanation: $P(A\cap B)$ li-${der}$. Amathuba eendawo ezine ngu-$P(A\cap B)={pab}$, $P(A\cap B^{c})={ao}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)={bo}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B^{c})={ne}$ kwaye isimbuku ngu-$1$. $P({ev})$ yisimbuku seendawo ezihambelanayo, ngoko ${sumx}$.

pst_diceQuad.prompt: Idayisi efanelekileyo enamanani ukusuka ku-$1$ ukuya ku-${s}$ ephoswa kabini, kwaye amanani avelayo ngu-$a,\ b$ ngokulandelelana. Fumana ithuba lokuba ulingano lwequadratic $x^{2}-{pa}x+{qb}=0$ lube nezimpande ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezinyanisileyo. (Bhala njengeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Imeko yokuba nezimpande ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezinyanisileyo yi-discriminant $D>0$.
$D={d1}-4\times{qb}$, kwaye ngokukhetha u-$a$ omnye ngamnye, bala u-$b$ ohambelana nemeko.
pst_diceQuad.explanation: $(a,\ b)$ eyanelisa i-discriminant $D={d1}-4\times{qb}>0$ ziindlela ezingu-${cnt}$ kwaye zonke ziindlela ezingu-${tot}$, ngoko ithuba li-${fe}$.

pst_diceSum.prompt: Zaphosa ngaxeshanye iidayisi ezimbini ezilungileyo, nganye inamachaphaza asuka ku-$1$ ukuya ku-${s}$. Amanani avelayo ngu-$a,\ b$ ngokulandelelana. Fumana ukubakho kokuba $a+b{rel}{t}$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuba uzahlula iidayisi zombini, onke amathuba angama-${s}\times{s}$.
Tshintsha i-$a$ ukusuka ku-$1$ ukuya ku-${s}$, ubale inani le-$b$ elanelisa imeko, uze ubadibanise.
pst_diceSum.explanation: Onke amathuba angama-${tot}$, kwaye iibini $(a,\ b)$ ezanelisa imeko zingama-${cnt}$. Ngoko ke ukubakho kungu-${fe}$.

pst_expectTable.prompt: Ixabiso elinokuthatyathwa lukhetho olungahleliweyo $X$ ngu-$1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$, kwaye $P(X=x)=k(x+{c})$ ($x=1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$). Fumana ixabiso lomndilili $E(X)$ we-$X$. (Apha $k$ yinto engaguquguqukiyo.) (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane i-$k$ usebenzisa imeko yokuba isiphumo sokudibanisa samathuba singu-$1$.
$E(X)=\sum x\,P(X=x)$.
pst_expectTable.explanation: Ekubeni isiphumo sokudibanisa samathuba singu-$1$, $k({t1})={S1}k=1$, oko kukuthi $k=\frac{1}{{S1}}$. $E(X)=\frac{1}{{S1}}({t2})=\frac{1}{{S1}}\times{S2}={fe}$.

pst_indepFindN.prompt: Kumakhadi angama-$n$ abhalwe amanani endalo asuka ku-$1$ ukuya ku-$n$, ikhadi elinye lithathwa ngokungakhethi. Umcimbi $A$ ‘inani lekhadi liphindaphindo lika-${p}$’, umcimbi $B$ ‘inani lekhadi liphindaphindo lika-${q}$’. Phakathi kwamanani endalo $n$ apho $2\le n\le {M}$, fumana elona xabiso likhulu lika-$n$ elenza imicimbi $A,\ B$ ibe ngezizimeleyo. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba izizimeleyo, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, kwaye $A\cap B$ ziziphindaphindo zika-${l}$. Ukuba kukho $a$ eziphindaphindo zika-${p}$, $b$ eziphindaphindo zika-${q}$, kunye ne-$c$ eziphindaphindo zika-${l}$, imeko yokuzimela ngu-$ab=cn$.
Jonga into eyenzekayo xa $n$ iliphindaphindo lika-${l}$.
pst_indepFindN.explanation: Ukuba $n={l}t$ ($t$ linani lendalo), $P(A)=\frac{1}{{p}}$, $P(B)=\frac{1}{{q}}$, $P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{{l}}$, ngoko izizimeleyo. Phakathi kweziphindaphindo zika-${l}$ ezingade zidlule ku-${M}$, enkulu ngu-${ans}$. Kwi-$n$ enkulu kunoku, jonga ukuba ngaba imeko yokuzimela $\frac{c}{n}=\frac{a}{n}\cdot\frac{b}{n}$, oko kukuthi $ab=cn$, iyabakho xa kukho $a$ eziphindaphindo zika-${p}$, $b$ eziphindaphindo zika-${q}$ kunye ne-$c$ eziphindaphindo zika-${l}$. Ekubeni ${chk}$, azizizimeleyo. Ngoko ke ngu-${ans}$.

pst_indepUnknown.prompt: Imicimbi emibini $A,\ B$ izizimeleyo, kwaye $P(A)={fa}$, $P(A\cup B)={fu}$. Fumana ixabiso le-$P(B)$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuba izizimeleyo, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$.
Hlela umthetho wokudibanisa $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$ ube yintetho ye-$P(B)$.
pst_indepUnknown.explanation: Ekubeni izizimeleyo, $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$, oko kukuthi $P(B)\{1-P(A)\}=P(A\cup B)-P(A)$. Ekubeni $1-{fa}={d1}$ kunye no-${fu}-{fa}={d2}$, $P(B)={d2}\div{d1}={fr}$.

pst_latticePath.prompt: Kwindawo yolungelelwaniso, kwiindlela ezimfutshane ezisuka kwinqaku $(0,\ 0)$ ukuya kwinqaku $({m},\ {n})$ ngokushukuma isikwere esinye kuphela ngasekunene okanye phezulu, zingaphi iindlela ezingadluli kwinqaku $\mathrm{P}({p},\ {q})$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Bala inani lazo zonke iindlela usebenzisa ukucwangciswa kwezinto ezinezinto ezifanayo. Iindlela ezingadluli = zonke - ezidlulayo.
Iindlela ezidlula kwinqaku $\mathrm{P}$ zibalwa njenge-(ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ku-$\mathrm{P}$)×(ukusuka ku-$\mathrm{P}$ ukuya ekugqibeleni).
pst_latticePath.explanation: Zonke iindlela zingama-${tot}$. Ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ku-$\mathrm{P}$ kukho ${via1}$, ukusuka ku-$\mathrm{P}$ ukuya ekugqibeleni kukho ${via2}$, ngoko iindlela ezidlula ku-$\mathrm{P}$ zingama-${via1}\times{via2}={via}$. Ngoko ke ${tot}-{via}={ans}$.

pst_linTransform.prompt: Xa umndilili we-random variable $X$ ungu-${m}$ kwaye i-standard deviation ingu-${s}$, kwi-random variable $Y={ya}$, fumana ixabiso le-$E(Y^{2})$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa u-$E(Y)=aE(X)+b$, $V(Y)=a^{2}V(X)$.

pst_lineUp.prompt: Abafana abangu-${m}$ kunye namantombazana angu-${w}$ ban stand emgceni omnye. Fumana ithuba lokuba akukho mantombazana mabini abakufutshane. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ithuba liyafana nokuba ucinga kuphela ngolungelelwano lwesini ngaphandle kokwahlula abantu besini esifanayo. Qala ubeke abafana, uze ucinge ngemeko apho amantombazana emi phakathi kwabo nasekupheleni kwazo zombini.
Zikho iindawo ezingu-${m1}$ apho amantombazana anokuma khona.
pst_lineUp.explanation: Inani lilonke lolungelelwano lwesini li-$\binom{{nn}}{{w}}={tot}$. Ukukhetha iindawo ezingu-${w}$ phakathi kweendawo ezingu-${m1}$ phakathi kwabafana nasekupheleni kokumisa amantombazana kwenza ukuba angabi kufutshane, ngoko $\binom{{m1}}{{w}}={good}$ iindlela. Ithuba li-${fe}$.

pst_monotoneSeq.prompt: Kwamalungu $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$ eseti $\{1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}\}$, fumana inani lezibini ezilandelelanisiweyo $(a,\ b,\ c,\ d)$ ezifezekisa $a{r1}b{r2}c{r3}d$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Apho uphawu lwe-inequality lu-$<$, amanani amabini kufuneka ahluke. Cinga ngokunciphisa uluhlu lwamanani anokukhethwa ngokwemigaqo yokuhluka.
Xa kukho u-$\le$ kuphela, ukukhetha amanani amane kuyafana ne-combination enokuphinda-phinda.
pst_monotoneSeq.explanation: $a<b$ kuyafana no-$a+1\le b$, ngoko ukususa u-$1$ kwinani lasemva ngophawu ngalunye lwe-$<$ kuyenza loo phawu libe ngu-$\le$. Kule nxaki kukho iimpawu ezingu-${s}$ ze-$<$, ngoko zonke iimpawu ziba ngu-$\le$ kwaye uluhlu lwamanani luqala ku-$1$ ukuya ku-${ms}$. Inani leendlela zokukhetha amanani angu-$4$ ngokuphinda-phinda kolu luhlu li-${}_{{ms}}\mathrm{H}_{4}=\binom{{top}}{4}={ans}$.

pst_multiplesUnion.prompt: Kumakhadi angu-${N}$ abhalwe amanani endalo ukusuka ku-$1$ ukuya ku-${N}$ ngekhadi ngalinye, xa kukhethwa ikhadi elinye ngokungakhethi, fumana ithuba lokuba inani elibhaliweyo lisisiphindaphindi se-${p}$ okanye se-${q}$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane inani leziphindaphindo ze-${p}$ nezeziphindaphindo ze-${q}$. Ezo zinazo zombini ziziphindaphindo zelona nani liphindaphindiweyo eliqhelekileyo elincinci lamanani amabini.
Inani lamalungu e-union = (isixa) - (i-intersection).
pst_multiplesUnion.explanation: Iziphindaphindo ze-${p}$ zingu-${np}$, ezika-${q}$ zingu-${nq}$, kwaye ezilona nani liphindaphindiweyo eliqhelekileyo elincinci ${l}$ zingu-${nl}$. Ngoko ${np}+{nq}-{nl}={cnt}$ kwaye ithuba li-${fe}$.

pst_normalBetween.prompt: Xa i-random variable $X$ ilandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$, fumana ixabiso le-$P({a}\le X\le {b})$. Kwi-random variable $Z$ elandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo okusemgangathweni, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala ukuya kwindawo yesine yedesimali)
hints: Yenza ube semgangathweni nge-$Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$ uze uyiguqule ibe sisimo se-$P(z_1\le Z\le z_2)$.
Igrafu yokuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo okusemgangathweni ilinganayo malunga no-$Z=0$.
pst_normalBetween.explanation: Ukwenza ube semgangathweni nge-$Z=\frac{X-{m}}{{s}}$, $\frac{{a}-{m}}{{s}}={z1}$, $\frac{{b}-{m}}{{s}}={z2}$, ngoko $P({z1}\le Z\le {z2})={expr}$.

pst_normalFindParam.prompt: Ukuba ukwahluka okungahleliweyo $X$ kulandela ukusasazwa okuqhelekileyo $N(m,\ {s}^{2})$ kwaye $P(X\ge {c})={pv}$, fumana ixabiso lommiselo ongatshintshiyo $m$. Kwi-$Z$ elandela ukusasazwa okuqhelekileyo okuqhelekileyo, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Guqula i-$P(X\ge {c})$ ibe lithuba le-$Z$ uze uyithelekise no-$0.5$.
Kwitafile, fumana i-$z_0$ ehambelana nexabiso le-$P(0\le Z\le z_0)$.
pst_normalFindParam.explanation: $P(X\ge {c})=P\left(Z\ge \frac{{c}-m}{{s}}\right)={pv}$. Kwitafile, $P(0\le Z\le |z_0|)=|{pv}-0.5|={tv}$, ngoko $|z_0|={az}$. Ekubeni ${cmp}$, ${zsg}$, kwaye $\frac{{c}-m}{{s}}={zz}$. Ngoko ke $m={ans}$.

pst_normalSymmetric.prompt: Ukuba ukwahluka okungahleliweyo $X$ kulandela ukusasazwa okuqhelekileyo $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$ kwaye $P(X\le {L})=P(X\ge {R})$, fumana ixabiso lommiselo ongatshintshiyo $k$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ijika lokusasazwa okuqhelekileyo lilingana malunga nomndilili $m$.
Amaxabiso amabini aphelele umgama ofanayo ukusuka kumndilili kumacala achasene. Oko kukuthi isiphumo sokudibanisa samaxabiso amabini si-$2m$.
pst_normalSymmetric.explanation: Ekubeni ijika lokusasazwa okuqhelekileyo lilingana malunga ne-$x={m}$, $({L})+({R})=2\times{m}$. Ukwenza lula, ${A}k+({BD})={m2}$, ngoko $k={ans}$.

pst_repCombEq.prompt: Kumanani aphelele angengonegethivu $x,\ y,\ z,\ w$, fumana inani leeseti ezilandelelanisiweyo $(x,\ y,\ z,\ w)$ apho $x+y+z+w={n}$ kwaye ${cond}$. (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Kwiinguquko ezinomda ophantsi omkhulu kune-$0$, susa umda ophantsi ukuze ibe ngu-$0$ nangaphezulu.
I-equation etshintshiweyo yisimbo se-$x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$.
