pst_repCombEq.explanation: Cacisa iinguquko ezintsha ngolu hlobo. ${subs}$. (Ukuba kukho inguquko enomda ophantsi o-$0$, yithathe njenge-$x'=x$.) Ngoko $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$ kwaye inguquko nganye linani eliphelele elingengaphantsi kwe-$0$. Ukudibanisa okuphindiweyo ${}_{4}\mathrm{H}_{{m2}}=\binom{{m3}}{{m2}}={ans}$.

pst_repPermCond.prompt: Phakathi kwamanani endalo anamanani angama-${k}$ enziwe ngamanani $0,\ 1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}$ evumela ukuphindaphinda (inani lokuqala alinakuba ngu-$0$), zingaphi ezo zisebenzise inani ${t}$ kanye okanye ngaphezulu? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba 'isetyenzisiwe kanye okanye ngaphezulu' kulula usebenzisa umcimbi ophikisayo ('ayisetyenzisiwe nakanye'). Inani lokuqala alinakuba ngu-0.
Inani lazo zonke amanani endalo anamanani angama-${k}$ li-${tot}$.
pst_repPermCond.explanation: Onke amanani endalo anamanani angama-${k}$ ayi-${tot}$, kwaye amanani angasebenzisanga inani ${t}$ nakanye ayi-${noExpr}={no}$. Ngoko ${tot}-{no}={ans}$.

pst_sampleMeanDist.prompt: Ngaphakathi kwingxowa kukho amabhola ama-3, kwaye amanani abhalwe kwiibhola ngu-${lst}$. Ukhupha ibhola enye engxoweni, ujonge inani, uze uyibuyisele, uphinda oku izihlandlo ezi-${nt}$. Ukuba umndilili wamanani ama-${nt}$ ajongiweyo ngu-$\overline{X}$, fumana i-$P(\overline{X}\ge {t})$. (Bhala ngokomlinganiselo ongenakwenziwa mncinci. Ukuba linani eligqibeleleyo, bhala eligqibeleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ekubeni ukhetho luyabuyiselwa, zonke iiseti ezilandelelanisiweyo ezinokwenzeka zinethuba elifanayo.
Bala zonke iiseti ezilandelelanisiweyo apho umndilili ungengaphantsi kwe-${t}$.
pst_sampleMeanDist.explanation: Inani lamathuba xa ukulandelelana kuyahlukaniswa li-${tot}$, kwaye amathuba apho umndilili ungengaphantsi kwe-${t}$ ngama-${cnt}$. Ngoko ithuba li-${fe}$.

pst_sampleMeanNormal.prompt: Kwinani labemi elilandela ukwahlulahlula okuqhelekileyo elinomndilili welizwe ${m}$ nokuphambuka okuqhelekileyo kwelizwe ${s}$, kukhethwa isampuli enobukhulu ${n}$ ngokungenamkhethe, kwaye umndilili wesampuli ngu-$\overline{X}$. Fumana ixabiso le-$P({ev})$. Kwitshintsha elingenamkhethe $Z$ elilandela ukwahlulahlula okuqhelekileyo, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. Bhala ukuya kwindawo yesine yedesimali.
hints: Umndilili wesampuli $\overline{X}$ ulandela ukwahlulahlula okuqhelekileyo $N\left(m,\ \left(\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\right)^{2}\right)$.
Ukuphambuka okuqhelekileyo kokusetyenziswa ekuqhelekiseni kufunyanwa ngolu hlobo: $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$
pst_sampleMeanNormal.explanation: $\overline{X}$ ulandela ukwahlulahlula okuqhelekileyo $N({m},\ {h}^{2})$ ($\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$). Xa siqhelekisa ngo-$Z=\frac{\overline{X}-{m}}{{h}}$ sifumana ${zs}$, ngoko $P({ev})=P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_sampleSd.prompt: Kwinani labemi elinomndilili welizwe ${m}$ nokwahlukana kwelizwe ${v}$, kukhethwa isampuli enobukhulu ${n}$ ngokungenamkhethe, kwaye umndilili wesampuli ngu-$\overline{X}$. Fumana ixabiso le-$E(\overline{X}^{2})$. (Bhala njengedesimali)
hints: Umndilili womndilili wesampuli yi-$E(\overline{X})=m$, kwaye ukwahlukana yi-$V(\overline{X})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{{n}}$.
$E(\overline{X}^{2})=V(\overline{X})+\{E(\overline{X})\}^{2}$.

pst_stratified.prompt: Abahlali bendawo ethile bahlulwe kumaqela amathathu A, B, C, anabantu aba-${na}$, aba-${nb}$ nabe-${nc}$ ngokulandelelana. Isampuli yakhethwa ngokukhethwa ngokwamanqanaba ngokulinganayo, apho ubukhulu besampuli bumiselwa ngokulingana nenani lamalungu elinye iqela, kwaye kwakhethwa abantu aba-${sa}$ kwiqela A. Zingaphi izinto ezikhethwe kwiqela C? (Bhala amanani kuphela)
hints: Ngokwabelo olulinganayo, umlinganiselo okhethiweyo kwiqela ngalinye (inani lesampuli ÷ inani lamalungu eqela) uyafana.
Qala ufumane umlinganiselo weqela A.
pst_stratified.explanation: Umlinganiselo okhethiweyo kwiqela A yi-$\frac{{sa}}{{na}}$. Ngenxa yokuba lo mlinganiselo uyafana kuwo onke amaqela, kwiqela C ngu-${nc}\times\frac{{sa}}{{na}}={ans}$.

pst_totalProb.prompt: Kuphoswa idayisi enobulungisa kanye; ukuba kuvela amanqaku angu-${t}$ okanye ngaphantsi, kukhutshwa ibhola enye kwibhokisi A, kungenjalo kwibhokisi B. Ibhokisi A inamabhola amhlophe ama-${w1}$ namnyama ama-${b1}$, kwaye ibhokisi B inamabhola amhlophe ama-${w2}$ namnyama ama-${b2}$. Fumana ukuba ithuba lokuba ibhola ekhutshiweyo ibe mhlophe lithini. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuba ibhola ekhutshiweyo ibe mhlophe kwahlulwa ngokuthi 'ibhola emhlophe evela kwi-A' okanye 'ibhola emhlophe evela kwi-B'.
Nganye ifunyanwa ngo-(ithuba lokukhetha ibhokisi)×(ithuba lokuba ibhola emhlophe kuloo bhokisi).
pst_totalProb.explanation: Ibhola emhlophe evela kwi-A: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}={tA}$, ibhola emhlophe evela kwi-B: $\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={tB}$ (apha $\frac{{t6c}}{6}$ lithuba lokukhetha i-B). Ukudibanisa la maxabiso mabini kunika $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}+\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={fr}$.

pst_urnChain.prompt: Esikhwameni esinamabhola amhlophe ama-${w}$ namnyama ama-${bk}$, amabhola akhutshwa ngokulandelelana nganye, kwaye ibhola ekhutshiweyo ayibuyiselwa. Fumana ithuba lokuba amaxesha okuqala ${r}$ kuvele amabhola amhlophe elandelelana, kwaye ixesha le-${r1}$ kuvele ibhola emnyama. (Bhala njengeqhezu elingenakuncitshiswa. Ukuba yinombolo epheleleyo, yibhale njengenombolo epheleleyo. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Umthetho wokuphindaphinda wamathuba: kwinqanaba ngalinye inani lamabhola asele liyatshintsha.
Ithuba lokuba ibhola yokuqala ibe mhlophe yi-$\frac{{w}}{{nn}}$.

pst_varTable.prompt: Xa ukuhanjiswa kwethuba kwe-random variable $X$ kungu-$P(X={x1})=\frac{{a1}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x2})=\frac{{a2}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x3})=\frac{{a3}}{{d}}$, fumana ixabiso le-variance $V(X)$. (Bhala ngeqhezu elincitshisiweyo. Ukuba linani eliphelele, bhala inani eliphelele. Umzekelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ufumane u-$E(X)$ no-$E(X^{2})$.

stat_ciMean.prompt: Kuhlobo lwabemi olulandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo, kukhethwe ngokungakhethi ezingu-{cnt}. Umndilili wesampulu ngu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$ kwaye i-standard deviation yabemi ngu-$\sigma={sig}$. I-confidence interval ye-${cl}\%$ yomndilili wabemi yi-$\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$, kwaye apha ixabiso le-$z$ li-${z}$. Lingakanani ixabiso eliphezulu (umda ongaphezulu) walo mgama wokuthembeka? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane impazamo esemgangathweni $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$. Kuba u-$n$ yisikwere esipheleleyo, ihlulwa ngqo.
Umda wempazamo yi-$z\times$(impazamo esemgangathweni), kwaye umda ongaphezulu yi-$\bar{x}$ edityaniswe nale.
stat_ciMean.explanation: Impazamo esemgangathweni yi-$\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, umda wempazamo yi-${z}\times{se}={moe}$, ngoko umda ongaphezulu yi-${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$.

stat_ciProp.prompt: Ngomgaqo othile, kukhethwe ngokungakhethi abantu abangu-{cnt}, kwaye abangu-{ag} bavumile. Xa isamples proportion ngu-$\hat{p}$, i-confidence interval ye-${cl}\%$ yomlinganiselo wabemi yi-$\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$, kwaye apha ixabiso le-$z$ li-${z}$. Lingakanani umda ongaphezulu walo mgama wokuthembeka njengenani lepesenti (%)? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane isamples proportion $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ ihlulwa ngqo ibe linani le-rational. Kulula ukubala ngokuyiguqulela kwipesenti.
stat_ciProp.explanation: $\hat{p}={ph}\%$, $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$, ngoko umda wempazamo yi-${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%), kwaye umda ongaphezulu yi-${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%).

stat_linReverse.prompt: Kuvelisiwe i-variable entsha $y$ ukusuka kwi-variable $x$ ($y={eq}$). Umndilili we-$y$ ubu-${my}$ kwaye i-standard deviation ibi-${sy}$. Lingakanani i-standard deviation ye-$x$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $y=ax+b$, i-standard deviation iphindaphindwa ngo-$|a|$.
Inombolo engatshintshiyo $b$ eyongezwayo nomndilili ayinanto yakwenza ne-standard deviation. Wahlula i-standard deviation ye-$y$ ngo-$|a|$.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Ixabiso eliphelele le-coefficient ye-$x$ li-${aa}$, ngoko i-standard deviation ye-$y$ ingamaxesha angu-${aa}$ e-standard deviation ye-$x$. Ngoko i-standard deviation ye-$x$ yi-${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Umndilili we-variable $x$ ngu-${m}$ kwaye i-variance ngu-${vx}$. Xa i-variable entsha $y$ ingu-$y={eq}$, yintoni i-variance ye-$y$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Ukuba $y=ax+b$, i-variance iphindaphindwa nge-$a^2$.
Inombolo engatshintshiyo $b$ eyongezwayo ayitshintshi ukusasazeka, ngoko ayichaphazeli i-variance.
stat_linTransform.explanation: Kwi-$y={eq}$, i-coefficient ye-$x$ yi-${ap}$, ngoko i-variance yi-${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ (inombolo engatshintshiyo nomndilili aziyichaphazeli i-variance).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Emva kokulungelelanisa idatha {data} ngokulandelelana ngobukhulu, i-median yenxalenye esezantsi yiyo i-first quartile $Q_1$, kwaye i-median yenxalenye ephezulu yi-third quartile $Q_3$ ngokusekelwe kwi-median. (Ukuba inani ledatha liyi-odd, i-median ngokwayo ayibekwa kwenye yenxalenye.) Lingakanani ixabiso le-interquartile range $Q_3-Q_1$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ubhale idatha kwakhona ngokulandelelana ngobukhulu usuka kwelincinci.
Yahlula idatha ibe ziinxalenye ezisezantsi nezingaphezulu nge-median epheleleyo, uze ufumane i-median yenxalenye nganye.

stat_rejectN.prompt: Kuvavanywa le hypothesis. $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. I-standard deviation yabemi ngu-$\sigma={sig}$ kwaye umndilili wesampulu kuthiwa ngu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$. Ukuba i-test statistic $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ inkulu kune-${crit}$, i-null hypothesis iyaliwa. Ukuba umndilili wesampulu ofanayo uyafumaneka, lelona nani lincinci lobukhulu besampulu $n$ elenza ukuba i-null hypothesis iyalwe liyintoni? (inani lendalo, bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Guqula inxaki elandelayo ibe yintetho ye-$\sqrt{n}$. $Z>{crit}$
Sika macala omabini ukufumana uluhlu lwe-$n$, uze ufumane elona nani lendalo lincinci elifezekisa imeko. Ukulingana akukuliwa.
stat_rejectN.explanation: Ukusuka ku-$Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$, $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, oko kukuthi $n>{lim}$ (ixabiso eliboniswe ukuya kwindawo yesibini yedesimali). Elona nani lendalo lincinci elifezekisa oku li-${ans}$.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: Kukho itheyibhile yobuninzi apho amaxabiso e-variable $x$ ngu-{xs}, kwaye ubuninzi bexabiso ngalinye ngokulandelelana ngu-{fs}. Ukuthatha le datha njengabemi bonke (idenominator ye-variance yisixa sobuninzi), yeyiphi i-standard deviation? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane isixa sobuninzi $N$ nomndilili $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$.
I-variance $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$, kwaye i-standard deviation yingcambu yesikwere elungileyo yayo.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: $N={tot}$, umndilili $m={mean}$, $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$, ngoko i-variance yi-${var}$, kwaye i-standard deviation yi-${ans}$.

stat_stratified.prompt: Kwiminyaka emithathu enabafundi abangu-{n1}, {n2}, {n3} ngokulandelelana, kufuneka kukhethwe abafundi abangu-{ns} bonke ngokuhlelwa ngamaleko (stratified sampling). Xa kwabelwa ngokulingana nomlinganiselo wonyaka ngamnye kwinani lilonke labafundi, bangaphi abafundi abakhethwa kunyaka we-{i}? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ufumane inani lilonke labafundi $N$.
Inani elikhethwa kunyaka we-{i} li-(inani lilonke labafundi abakhethwayo)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: Kuhlobo lwabemi olulandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo, kukhethwe ngokungakhethi ezingu-{cnt}. Umndilili wesampulu ngu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$, i-sample standard deviation ngu-$s={sd}$. Kuba i-standard deviation yabemi ingaziwa, kusetyenziswa i-$t$ distribution, kwaye kwitheyibhile ye-$t$ distribution enamanqanaba enkululeko ayi-${df}$, $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$. Lingakanani ixabiso elisezantsi (umda ongezantsi) we-confidence interval ye-$95\%$ yomndilili wabemi $m$, $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$)? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Amanqanaba enkululeko yi-$n-1$, kwaye impazamo esemgangathweni yi-$\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Umda ongezantsi yi-$\bar{x}-t_0\times$(impazamo esemgangathweni).
stat_tCiLower.explanation: Impazamo esemgangathweni yi-$\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, umda wempazamo yi-${t0}\times{se}={moe}$, ngoko umda ongezantsi yi-${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$.

stat_zStat.prompt: Kuyaziwa ukuba ubomi obumndilili bemveliso ethile bungu-${mu0}$ iiyure. Emva kokukhetha ngokungakhethi iimveliso ezingu-{cnt} ezenziwe ngenkqubo entsha, umndilili wobomi wawungu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$ iiyure. Ukuba ubomi bulandela ukuhanjiswa okuqhelekileyo kwaye i-standard deviation yabemi $\sigma={sig}$ iiyure ayitshintshanga, lingakanani ixabiso le-test statistic $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ye-null hypothesis $H_0: m={mu0}$? (Bhala inani kuphela)
hints: Qala ubale u-$\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Wahlula umahluko phakathi komndilili wesampulu no-${mu0}$ ngelo xabiso. Linokuba linani elingalunganga.
